I half-expected they would disappoint. Abandon you to toil on your own. At least thus far they've honored their commitment, then.", 'Pah.', "Urgh... I'm certain the superficial messages we have exchanged shall taper off, with time. We have always been apart, irrespective of the distance separating us. I know Zeus is content with your mother's version of events. Thus we are at peace, for now.", 'I mean only that our family is prone to causing problems for itself. Never content to leave things well enough alone. But if we have little to do with them... their quarrels, all their nonsense on Olympus... it should be of no consequence.', 'Precisely.', 'The latest reports indicate that mortals are fully twice as fearful of ending up in Tartarus as in our last evaluation period, thanks to the destruction you have caused. You are an unseen power in the Underworld. Commendable.', "I give credit where it's due. But the mortals? They know nothing of what transpires here. Only rumblings we permit to escape our realm... rumblings that reinforce their deepest fears about what shall transpire after their demise.", 'Whatever you may wish to say, I do not wish to hear it.', "You're interrupting me during my time at work.", "I think I've heard more than enough from you lately.", "You're willfully wasting my time, aren't you.", "Go, get out. I'll try not to keep him for as long, next time.", 'Doubtless I shall get you for that one next time.', 'Another satyr outbreak to look out for next you venture there...', 'Be certain to give your regards to your mother as well!', 'Repairs for all the carnage that you sowed are already underway.', 'What else can we do to contain you, I wonder...', 'I have some catching up to do, as you can see.', 'Ah, we ought to reconvene the court now, I suppose.', 'As you can see, I must attend to all this parchmentwork.', 'I must say, you made a hollow mockery of Theseus that time.', 'Our security efforts in Asphodel are evidently lacking.', 'Go rest yourself if need be. Though the Underworld is ready when you are.', 'Against my better judgment, I went easier on you that time.', 'Thus starts and ends our brief exchange of pleasantries.', 'Continue to perform your duties as you have.', 'Cerberus there was anticipating your return.', 'Your mother expected this most recent result of yours.', "Do I appear as though I've time for conversation, boy?", 'Let us discuss your work performance at some other time.', 'Your infamy throughout Elysium has only grown.', 'I must admit... that was a job well done back there.', 'Where did you get this...? You think you can butter me up with such trifles? Give me that, and then get out of here.', "You owe me nothing, certainly not this. And I've nothing to give you in exchange. But fine, I'll honor our custom. Give it here.", "Hrm. I... can dispose of this properly. Speaking of disposal... I've no further need for this, here, so... rid me of it, why don't you? On your way out.", "I don't require beverages in order to enjoy myself, boy. Unlike so many of your kin upon their mountain. Yet this blasted substance somehow finds its way to my domain. Then, fine! You wish for the customs here to be more akin to Olympus, why not?", "Hrm. You're probably correct. You must think it is my age that makes me obstinate. Unable to change my nature. But I have always been inflexible. You think I'm proud of it? You call me 'Father' like it's an insult. I deserve the title only as a technicality, I know.", 'Yes, well... unfortunately, I am a significant impediment. You should be well aware of that. You were able to stop me. I have thus far been unable to do so...', "Enough of this, boy! Even mortals know better. I don't want your Nectar, or Ambrosia, or whichever offerings. You owe me no such thing, and I shall not accept it any longer. In fact, here... you shall take all of it back!", "How dare you lecture me? I mean... urgh... look. As you told me yourself... there's no changing what already transpired. And our memories are warnings. When you have lived as long as I have... you come to understand your weaknesses.", 'Rngh. Listen to me. My attempts at making peace are going to be rather subtle for your tastes. I cannot change the past. And there is only so much I can do about the future. I tell you this because... I shall not lie to you again. That much, I swear.', 'Pathetic.', 'Useless.', 'Not a chance.', 'That almost tickled.', 'Was that supposed to be some sort of joke?', "What is it that you're trying now to do?", "You truly are an idiot, aren't you.", 'To suffer such indignity, from my own kin.', 'A pitiful attempt.', "Don't make me laugh.", 'Do not so much as think about it.', 'I do not think so, boy.', 'All right, where were we?', 'Shall we get back to business?', 'Shall we get back to work?', 'Court is back in session.', 'Court is back in session!', 'Blast. Court is in session!', 'Court is now in session!', 'Court is in session now!', 'Form up, shades!', 'Form up!', 'Shades, form up!', 'Shades! Come forth.', "I'll hear your cases now!", 'Bring forth your cases, shades!', 'A hearing is now in session!', 'I must get back to work.', 'All those with claims, form up!', 'Shades, get back in line!', 'Shades, line up!', 'Shades! Please form a line.', 'Let us hold court!', 'Let us hold court, then!', 'Let us resume court!', "We're holding court!", "Shades of the court! I'll hear your claims for now.", "Shades! We've kept you waiting long enough.", 'If that will be all, then. Shades?', 'Well, shades, what are you waiting for?!', "Come, shades, I don't have all day!", "Come, shades, I don't have all night!", "Come, shades, I don't have all day! Or night?", 'Next.', 'Next...', 'Next!', 'Next...?', 'Next!', 'Who is next.', 'Who is next?', 'Keep it moving.', 'Come forth.', 'Come forth!', 'And, next.', 'And, next?', 'And next!', 'And, next...', 'Next, already.', 'Next, you.', 'Next. You.', 'Keep moving, next.', 'Well? Next?', 'State your business.', 'State your purpose.', 'State your case.', 'Make your claim.', 'What is it.', 'Make it quick.', 'What.', 'Well?', 'Why are you here.', 'Your business?', 'Your claim?', 'State your claim.', 'What is your claim?', 'Quickly.', 'Quickly!', 'Speak up.', 'Speak up!', "I'm listening.", 'Next case.', 'Next claim.', "I'm waiting.", 'What.', 'What brings you here.', 'Explain.', 'Go ahead.', "I'm waiting...!", 'Proceed.', 'Out with it.', 'Mmm-hm.', 'Mmm.', 'Hmph.', 'Go on.', 'Indeed.', 'Indeed?', 'What else.', 'Really.', 'I see.', 'Huh.', 'Hrm.', 'Ngh.', 'Is that all.', 'Is that all?', 'Get to the point.', 'Get to the point!', 'And, so...', 'So?', 'So what.', 'And...?', 'Truly.', 'Truly?', 'Truly...!', 'What else.', 'Is that so.', 'Is that so...!', 'Anything else?', 'Continue.', 'Speak up.', 'Elaborate.', 'What happened then.', 'What happened next.', 'And you did what.', 'Granted.', 'Granted!', 'Granted...', 'Claim granted.', 'Your claim is granted.', 'Fair point. Granted.', 'Very well. Claim granted.', 'Enough, granted.', 'Fine, granted.', 'Granted. This time.', 'I see. Granted.', 'Granted. Go.', 'Granted. Now, go.', 'Granted, then.', 'Claim... granted.', "I've heard enough, granted.", 'Simple. Granted.', '<Sigh> Granted...', 'Denied.', 'Denied!', 'Denied...', 'Claim denied.', 'Your claim is denied.', 'Not a chance. Denied.', 'Laughable. Denied.', 'Waste of time. Denied.', 'Certainly not. Denied.', 'Most certainly denied.', 'Absurd. Denied.', 'Denied, and out with you.', 'I think not. Denied.', 'Denied, again.', 'Categorically denied.', 'No. Denied.', 'Claim... denied.', 'Absolutely denied.', 'Denied. Out.', "I've heard enough. Denied.", '<Sigh> Denied...', 'Pah. Denied.', 'We are adjourned.', 'Court adjourned.', 'Court adjourned!', "I'll hear no more for now.", 'Enough for now.', "That's enough.", 'Enough, disperse.', "That's quite enough for now.", "We'll take a short recess.", 'Wait.', 'Hold.', 'At ease.', 'A moment.', 'Well? What is the latest explanation for your tardiness? Lost track of time admiring the courtyard view? Perhaps you were recuperating from your martial training. Achilles is not prone to holding back.', "It's not at all the same! The hue of Ixion's green light takes on an obviously lighter hue when it is time! You're an embarrassment not just to me, here, boy, but to this entire operation. Now get back to work!", 'Not only were you late, again... but then you also failed to perform even the simplest tasks that I had asked, repeatedly, that you complete. How many chances do you need at this? I am too lenient with you.', "Excuse me?! If I am not mistaken, you're deflecting your incompetence toward me? As though the Goddess of Wisdom herself has come to aid you in your time of need! I could replace you here and now with any number of simple shades, hungry to work here!", "Why are you stuck? You're not. You're fired! I was wrong to think you were prepared to take on any responsibility at all. And, don't you ever invoke your uncles here again. Or I'll have you cast into the lowest pits of Tartarus. Now, get out of my administration, and my sight!", 'Be careful of your tone and temper, Shade. You are in my employ. You could be wandering the pastures of Elysium again instead. Or lesser planes, if I so choose.', 'I shall be giving it some thought. Until then, you just watch that hall. And watch yourself, as well.', '...I understand the terms of your employment have been altered in my name, Shade. Be grateful that you lack the standing for such changes to require my personal approval. Though you remain in my employ, correct?', 'How lenient they make these pacts, today. You are off duty now, is that not so? Go, then, take advantage of the added benefit.', '...You are not to aid him in these matters, Nyx; his foolishness is to be scorned and reprimanded, not indulged. Do we have an understanding?', 'It is not necessary to remind me. Surely all those who once defied my brothers and myself would much prefer a post within my House over eternity within the lowest depths of Tartarus. Not that the darkness there would trouble you.', '...It is plain to me that you are helping him; in spite of my insistence you do not. What do you expect that I should do about this, Nyx? What would you do, in my position? Deception, in my very house and home...! Answer me.', "Tsch. What good is any one of you? He's not even your son; and yet you coddle him. You know as well as I that he cannot succeed. You fill his mind with harmful delusions. If that is what you want for him, then, please! Proceed at pace.", 'Nyx! Gah.', 'Olympus knows of him?! Bestowing on him all their worthless blessings, here, within my realm! Our realm! Explain to me how, exactly, this is possible, Nyx. Either your limitless power has considerably waned, or you are up to something.', "Blood and darkness! Do not speak to me about their influence! I've seen their influence firsthand. You've made a foolish mistake.", 'Grr....', 'What now, Nyx? Do you realize the danger you have put her in? You claim to care for her, but now you threaten to expose her, to them!', 'You take his word for it? How can you trust him not to ruin everything?', 'The honor is mine.', '...What I attempt to tell you, Nyx, is I am grateful. For our long-standing collaboration, here. My rule was thrust upon you and your kin. By all rights, you ought have undermined my every move. I often thought you would. Yet once Olympus and I severed ties... you stood by me still.', 'I shall require no additional reminders. Know, in turn, that I shall always oversee this realm to the full extent of my ability.', "...You're late with your report, Hypnos. Again. Again! The dead of course can wait, but I'm less patient. Now, explain yourself to me.", "Get to the blasted point already, I don't have all day! Or night. Urgh! Your report, where is it?", "Enough!! Blood and darkness, that's enough from you, just... see to it the ledger of the dead is accurate, and get back to your post. Ugh, would that you could be more like your brother.", '...Your reports have been much more punctual of late, Hypnos. That is to be expected. However... the illustrated edges... a clever detail. Ensures certain reports are easily procured from a stack of parchment.', 'Yes, well. Certainly, then, you have a number of such tasks requiring your attention. Continue working diligently, then.', 'No.', 'Hypnos... that shall be all. Lest I rescind your commendation and cast you out of here.', "Such tardiness is oft to be expected from your brother, but from you, Thanatos? You're practically the god of punctuality.", 'Thanatos, even we gods require rest from time to time. Someday we might get it around here, once this accursed House is well in order, finally. Until then, I appreciate your diligence. Do not overextend yourself.', "...You have been rather slow about your duties, lately, Thanatos. And I'm receiving incident reports from Tartarus involving you. Remember your responsibilities. And, remember, I am watching you. Now, get out of my sight.", "You've been abetting him, Thanatos. Behind my back! Betrayal. I would ask you why. Well?", "You dare to lecture me? Tsch. My loyal subjects are too few of late, I think. This is your realm, not mine; I'll not cast you into that wretched pit. It's not like I have someone to replace you here, besides. Now then, begone.", "It has. The last time, what was it you said? That there must be some resolution to the matter, as you called it, with my son? Well it is settled, now. Isn't it, boy?", 'And so you see... I would continue in our mutual good graces, if you please. This House can only function if the upper management is in accord. What do you say?', 'Then, as you were. Dismissed.', '...Would that all my subjects exhibited such promptness. Your report, then, if you please, Dusa?', 'See that we achieve thirty percent before the turn of the aeon, Chief Custodian. Other than that... a satisfactory report. Now, carry on.', "Well, Orpheus... if you're quite finished with your little stint within the depths of Tartarus, I'd like to ask again: Play us a song, already. Or else next time I'll not be quite so charitable with your punishment.", "Is that so...? Why, then, I'll go ahead and wait. I've all the patience in the world.", "Help me to understand something here, Orpheus. Why do I bother keeping such a worthless shadow of a court musician in my House? You prattle ceaselessly, yet I can't get even a single note out of you?", "I used to tolerate your insolence. We're finished here. You find your voice. Immediately! You have one hundred years, and not a moment more.", "Finally returned to your senses, haven't you, Orpheus. A court musician who refused to sing! Such nonsense. I trust there shall be no more insubordination from you, moving forward?", "Still going on about your so-called muse, I see. You had your chance with Eurydice. You squandered it. And now you're here; a deal is a deal. I expect you to comply with your end of our agreement.", 'Nrgh...', "Don't give me such ideas, Orpheus! Instead, you go about your business, there, and play your blasted songs when circumstances call for it.", '...Make certain of it, Megaera. I am finding, lately, that the help within this House is much more lacking than it used to be. I trust that you shall set it back on course.', 'It is already too late for that, Megaera. They have been notified and are en route to Tartarus even as we speak.', 'Megaera, trust me when I say I know the feeling all too well. However, surely, in your ingenuity, you may yet find a way to get your sisters to see eye to eye.', 'Enough! Besides, Megaera, this is not your failing. It is mine. I must attend to these affairs more actively.', 'I am not asking, Megaera.', 'You and your sisters have protected Tartarus unerringly. The Prince has proven uncontainable. The fault is mine, not yours. Your duty to this realm must be commended.', "There is, and isn't, Megaera. I ask only that you remain committed to this realm. Bar passage in and out of Tartarus. And, if the Prince continues to show up... you give him hell.", 'Grr. Persephone, how can you be so certain your request was executed to your satisfaction?', 'This House is not a suitable location for such guests! Dionysus, alone, shall bring ruin to this place! Or... urgh... the faith thing that you said.', 'All right....', "That is what I'm afraid of. Do you truly believe my brothers and the rest shall take the sort of care of them while they draw breath, as we do here after they have expired?", 'But they are never satisfied! Always begging us to provide more, and more.', '...No. No, I suppose not. But they need us!', '...He has.', '...And what of the complaints from Elysium? They wanted the lawns thoroughly manicured for their athletic contests.', 'There have been fewer reports about it as of late. And what of the Satyr problem? Blasted things are rampant up there, still.', 'Our best... that I can promise you.', '...Well, be that as it may... if they pester you at all, do let me know, and I shall have them dealt with quickly.', 'You are certain all your needs have been provided for? Because if there is anything that you require...', "Persephone, I cannot promise you such things, they're... not my strengths. Besides, I have a reputation to uphold! God of the dead! If the wretches do not fear me, or you for that matter... what, then?", 'Indeed.', '...Sometimes, I... still cannot believe that you are here. Returned to us. Your radiance, in all this darkness... you must miss seeing the coast.', 'You have taken much less time adjusting to this place than when first you joined us. Part of my surprise. I, myself, was forced to be here. I never thought anyone would come from the surface here by choice.', 'Grr....', 'Indeed.', 'Euugghh...', 'Family? Death is your only family. Death, and I. Best get accustomed to the both of us.', "Death is inescapable. If you think otherwise... why, then, don't let me stop you.", "Nobody gets out of here, boy, whether alive or dead. You think I jest? You think I haven't tried?!", 'That dog is not your plaything, boy! Cerberus defends our realm so that no-one gets in alive, or gets out either way.', 'You are a weakling, boy! Disgraceful!! Now, strike again, and make it hurt, this time!', 'Watch where you step, you oaf! My House is not a sty through which to track your filth!', "A mortal's life is short, and fraught with pain; is that truly the life you yearn for, boy?", 'What have I wrought, that such a witless, careless brat would be my progeny?', "The fear of death keeps mortals well in check. You'd best learn to fear something yourself, you hear me, boy?", 'How dare you, boy! Learn well to shut that foolish mouth of yours, or I shall shut it for you!', 'You have a tendency to ask too many questions, boy. Would that you had a tendency to wonder silently, instead.', "You're not to speak of that accursed Mount Olympus in this household, do you hear me? Nor shall you invoke the names of its inhabitants.", "Say it: Blood and darkness. It's a curse, boy. Say it with me. Blood. And. Darkness. Each available in high abundance here.", 'Time you learned the bearing of the gods, and to assert yourself. For this I have employed the greatest of the Greeks, or what became of him.', "Where do you think you are? Who do you think you're talking to? Nobody gets out of my domain, whether alive or dead.", "You wish to meet your uncle Zeus someday? Imagine me, with a luxurious white mane, without a modicum of self-control. That's your Zeus.", "In my domain, you either find your place, or learn your place. There's work enough to go around, believe you me.", 'This is where you belong. You feel out of place? Where would you even go, what would you have me do? Your place is here.', 'One thing the mortals have on us is that they quickly become men. This is the Fury, Megaera. She shall accelerate the process in your case.', 'The dead are judged and sent to Asphodel, Elysium, or Tartarus. We keep the process neat and orderly. Everyone gets in, no one gets out.', 'Nyx is the Night herself; her twin sons, Sleep, and Death! But, you? I cannot think of anything, I fear! Except the god of talking back to me.', "Your place is here, and nowhere else. The same as it is mine. There's naught of any worth to see beyond this realm, besides.", "Poseidon's an incomparable fool I am ashamed to call my brother. He can shake the earth up there all he pleases; he is unwelcome here.", "Elysium? It isn't for the good; it's for the great. Great kings or killers. Oft one and the same. They left their mark upon the world. Shall you?", 'For their mistakes in life, the wretched shades of Tartarus are bound to me in death, however hatefully. They answer to me; quite unlike you.', 'How many times must I explain this, boy? Each Pact of Punishment needs to be promptly signed, and sealed, and filed. Rather than pile up!', 'What exactly is it, boy, that makes you feel entitled to show me such disrespect? You dare not say such things to Mother Nyx!', 'Asphodel has flooded once again, with flame! Not quite the afterlife experience promised to the dead residing there, now, is it, boy?', 'Upon my name, you lack the cheerfulness of Hypnos and the competence of Thanatos, but have more willfulness than both, combined!', "Sometimes I think this mess you call your chambers is one which you've cultivated with great pride, is that the way of it?", 'Do not stray far again into the pits of Tartarus, or become lost like all its residents. Content yourself to look upon it from afar.', 'Sulk in your chambers all you like, for I care not! I have eternity to finish with this work, so your assistance is entirely unneeded.', 'Why do you bleed like mortals do? An aberration, nothing more! And nothing to be proud of. I suggest you keep it to yourself.', "Don't you dare look at me like that, boy, with your mismatched eyes. You save it for yourself. You have a mirror in your chambers, don't you?", "How suitably disgusting. Fling your blood at me like that again, boy, and I'll have you cast into the Styx, where you can drown in it.", 'The surface is off limits. And furthermore, you are forbidden from the Temple of Styx, until such time as you are fit to tend the situation there.', 'You wish to feel the breeze against your skin? Perhaps the coolness of the seas? You shall writhe from such sensations, I assure you.', 'You are immortal, boy, but in a manner, you can die; as you now understand. A most unpleasant feeling, is it not?', 'The rivers flowing through this realm divide its regions suitably enough. And every shade knows better than to try and cross them!', "Why are some chambers in my House off limits? Someone deserving access would not ask. You can't always go where you please.", 'The Infernal Arms are sealed away for a reason, boy! Your curiosity exceeds your common sense, but heed my words, you stay away from those accursed things!', 'Heroes? Mere mortals, same as all the rest. Someday you shall visit Elysium and meet some of these heroes, and discover that they are quite different than the songs suggest.', 'How dare you to insinuate Poseidon has the slightest jurisdiction, here! Once waters from the surface flow beneath the earth, they become mine. Each of the rivers, they are mine, not his!', 'You would have better conversation with your chamber-walls than with the boatman Charon, boy. Not all those of the Underworld are prone to ceaseless chatter quite like you.', "Now, fling the blasted thing again, I said! And put your anger into it, this time, like so. Or if you've not anger enough for it yet, you'll learn, I promise you.", 'Never lay hands upon Gigaros, boy, ever again. The power in that spear could tear you to pieces finer than the ones to which some of your ancestors were once reduced.', "All of this realm are born of darkness, boy. It's part of everything you'll ever see. The mortals on the surface, they all fear it, foolish as they are. Unable to even see its power.", "These gemstones that you mock, boy, are a symbol of the power of this realm. To you they're merely trinkets, but to mortals, gemstones hold more value than their very lives.", 'Another vermin outbreak near the surface, then. Would that I had someone dependable to deal with it. Where are those blasted satyrs coming from, and to what end? The vile things.', 'You seek such fame as your great relatives upon their mountaintop? Seek to be valuable, not to be known. Obscurity is not what makes you weak. Worship from mortals is a nuisance, not a boon.', 'You need to learn to hold a spear, observe! A sturdy grip is necessary, here and here. Though, we must find for you an instructor with more time to spare.', "You must accept that you are not like all the others here. Your differences do not make you deficient. They can make you strong. It's up to you.", 'I have no idle time to spare you, boy! Have you observed the parchmentwork upon my desk? Go play with Thanatos, or Hypnos, or the dog. I need to finish this!', 'Your grandparents? The Titans, they were called. Long since passed from this world, boy. You have my assurance, however, that you did not miss much, in having never met.', 'Keep to yourself, then! Our House is not so great in size, thus boundaries must be set. I shall refrain from entering your chambers, as you shall never again try to enter mine.', 'Waste not your time, though it is limitless. Busy yourself in doing things of use. Learn. Learn how to learn. I cannot teach you everything myself.', "The Eldest Sigil shall never work for you, boy. Only a privileged few have unconstrained authority to traverse this realm, and you are not among them, I'm afraid.", 'You call this shouting?! This is not shouting, boy. This is merely having certain expectations, which you have not met. Now, try once again.', 'Look to me for clear instruction, boy! Not for the embodiment of the standard to which you are held. Set your aim higher than to be like me.', 'Forget about the surface, boy! You are not missing much. Here we have warmth, and wealth. Stability! Up there? Nothing of the sort.', 'Speak not to me of failure! Failure is the greatest instructor of all. Your existence is a sequence of mistakes; avoid making the same one twice.', 'Ask Nyx about such things, do not ask me! She is the one born to this realm. I am a foreigner. Moved here to take this job, can you believe it, boy?', 'Mortals believe that there is no return from here. They are correct! And we all must do our part to keep it that way. We have a certain reputation to uphold.', "Why am I never proud of you? Don't take it personally, boy. I'm never proud of anything. Pride is perhaps our family's worst trait. See how many mortals are with us, because of it?", "I suppose that you must hate the very sight of me. You'll understand, then, why I wear the Helm of Darkness.", 'You are blind even to simple truths.', 'Your eyes deceive you, boy.', 'Excuse me for a moment.', 'I shall be right back.', 'Dead souls, restore my strength!', 'Through death, I regain life!', 'Souls of the dead, to me!', 'These mortal souls are mine!', 'You cannot break me, boy!', 'All you damned souls, come on!', 'All you dead souls are mine!', 'I shall be whole again!', 'Now.', 'Now!', 'Here!', 'Here, boy!', 'Observe!', 'You...!', 'Why, you!', 'Prepare!', 'Boy...!', 'You brought this on yourself!!', 'Raauuugghhhh!!', 'Hrryyaaaahhh!', 'Grraaauuuugggghhh!', 'Zagreus...!', 'Go back!', 'Become as darkness, wretches, and destroy him, now!', 'Come, wretches! I shall turn you from our sight!', 'Arise, wretches, and fight without a trace!', 'Come forth, wretches! And dispose of this unfilial oaf.', 'Wretches of the Underworld! Heed me, and rise from the earth to do my bidding!', 'Hear me, wretches! Rise now from my realm, and fight again!', 'On my authority, as Lord of Death! Awaken, wretches, and defend your king!', 'Upon my name, I order all you wretches of the Underworld to attend me, now!', 'To me, wretches! Dialogues: ['Time to go home.', "Can't be helped.", 'You tried.', 'Oh, Zag...', 'What were you thinking.', "You're dead.", "You're dead, Zag.", "You're coming with me.", "That's it.", 'That does it.', 'Well, come along.', 'You had this coming.', 'What did you expect.', 'No escaping Death.', 'I have to take you back.', "Let's go home.", "Let's go, Zag.", "We're heading home.", 'There is no escape.', 'Time to die.', 'Blood and darkness.', 'In the name of Hades.', 'Death has come.', 'Not this time.', "I'm sorry.", 'I have to take you now.', "It's over.", "You're finished.", 'You brought this on yourself.', "Your luck's run out.", 'Nothing I can do.', 'Hmph.', 'What.', 'Well, well.', 'What do you need exactly.', 'Hmph.', 'Hm.', 'Yes?', 'Tsch.', 'What?', 'You.', "It's you.", "What's up.", 'Heh.', 'What is it, Zag.', 'Welcome home.', 'Sorry, Zag.', 'You all right?', 'You OK?', 'Hey Zag.', 'Hey.', 'Welcome back.', 'Hey Zag.', 'Hey.', "You're back.", 'Good work out there.', 'Well done that time.', 'Good work.', 'Heard you made it, Zag.', 'Went all the way again, huh.', "Glad you're back.", 'Back in one piece.', 'Over here.', 'Hm, hello.', "What's going on, Zag.", "You're going back there?", "Don't stay too long in there.", "Looking the other way, don't worry, Zag.", "Didn't see a thing.", 'Hey.', 'Back, huh.', 'You made it.', 'Done snooping?', 'Had enough in there?', 'So be it.', 'What is this, Zag.', 'Heh.', "This can't be...", 'What?', 'Appreciate that.', 'Really?', 'I need to ask something of you.', 'Just tell me one thing, Zagreus. I can't stay there, and frankly I can barely stand it. Do you have any idea how bright it gets, up there?", "Tsch, well. We'll see what the Fates have to say about that. Maybe the shade of Daedalus can make you some protective eyewear or something.", "See what I mean, now, Zag? Nice place to visit on occasion, sure. But I definitely wouldn't want to live there.", 'I met her, you know. Persephone, I mean. You look more like your father, but... you have her eyes. One of them, anyway.', "It's not like that. The work can wait.", "...I somehow knew, you know. I always knew you weren't going to stay. You were... so restless here. You just needed a reason to leave! And I hoped you wouldn't find one this quickly. Eugh. What am I saying? You have no idea.", "Tsk... I've always lacked your optimism, Zag. Anyway... the work has waited long enough, I need to get back to it. Thanks for the drink.", '...Watch yourself out there, Zagreus. I have to go.', "It is, I'm quite feared, up there. Most of them cannot distinguish between me, and, say, Lord Ares, or your father, even. We fill them with despair. No helping it.", "We've all the time to educate them, here. Their ignorance of death is solved almost as soon as they experience their first. Though I suppose they might be better off knowing before the fact.", 'They see it as their one and only chance. Imagine if, after you perished, that was it. Back to the infinite Chaos. Everything about you. Returned to how it was before you were even there.', "I know, right? Some of them know that isn't how it is, and try to tell their kind about what it is we do here, but... it's slow going, getting the information out. Either way! I get to be the bearer of good news.", "They live with all their hearts, or at least try. I think there's something to it, truthfully. Though, some of them, they fall apart. They get here without me. On their own, gripped with despair. If only they knew what your father always says about all this.", "I mean, you can't escape your problems, Zagreus. You can run from your family, but you can't run from everything. You have no choice but to confront it, and work through it, sooner or later, one way or another. You, and all of us.", "I can release them from their decaying bodies. Sometimes, the Fates demand I bring them in sooner. That's about as much as I can do. Some of them get it early on, how to live. It's quite impressive, really, that they learn so quick.", "Most of it, yes. Don't beat yourself up, though, Zagreus. It's a practiced skill but I've apparently been able to do it since birth. Mother Nyx says I was a real handful.", "The River Styx is right in front of you, and you don't see anything, Zag? I can watch it endlessly. Studying the competition, you might say. Most mortals expect to get here by river, with Charon. Not with me.", 'I find it rather soothing as a matter of fact. A break from having to deal constantly with mortal souls. Speaking of which... I have to pick somebody up right now.', "In case you haven't noticed, most of us who sprang from Nyx, we're not exactly close. Nemesis is fully occupied meting out justice on the surface. Our paths are not designed to cross. And based on everything I know, that's fine with me.", "How's that Rail of Adamant been working out for you lately? Always figured the direct approach was more your style. Though, I happened to have a look at your permanent record lately, and turns out you're doing a lot of work with that thing.", "The mortals call her Strife. She and her children... it's thanks partly to their dedicated efforts I'm so busy all the time. Though, it is best we didn't speak of her, I think.", "What can I say? It's... different. I never stay up there for very long, don't think I could, starts making me feel ill. Too many sensations all at once. But I didn't really get to know her until after the whole humiliating affair with Sisyphus.", 'We each had to blow off some steam, yes. Why do you ask?', "The mortals have their customs, yes, indeed. Quite a variety, in point of fact. However, none as yet have stuck with me, I think. So don't concern yourself with things like that.", 'Not any more than usual. Tell her that I said hello when next you meet.', "You don't need to ask me such things, Zagreus. They're your feelings.", 'I do not care for his approach at all. But he has been professionally courteous with me. Although, with Mother Nyx, sometimes it's best to leave her be. As for Dusa... I didn't mean to suggest you should abandon your friend.", "If I were you, I would start getting over it as soon as possible. But, I don't see you doing that. She doesn't need someone like Dusa taking after him.", "I'm rather used to the relationship, thanks, Zagreus. Seems like you got to know him pretty well.", "I don't know what's worse, dying repeatedly or Hypnos. Although, I guess I'm grateful for your patience with him, Zag.", "He's utterly incompetent, Zag. He wouldn't even be here if Mother Nyx wasn't trying to whip him into some sort of shape.", "I know, it's just...! You're right. I catch myself feeling particularly horrid after talking to him. I think my instincts on the subject are just not the same as yours. Miss Nyx, she, I, I'm not supposed to talk to you! I think I really needed the break.", "I love this work too much to get burned out, Prince. But that's me. I know there's more to being alive or being dead than just your work, but... my work happens to be important to me. The same as you!', 'Sorry, not much time to chat more right now, Prince!', "We'll have to catch up in the lounge sometime, huh, Prince?", 'Oh, haha, you startled me, there, Prince!', 'Hold on, Prince! Think I saw some dust I missed up there!', 'Sorry, got to file this report, now, Prince!', "Nice to see you, now I'm off to clean the rafters once again!", "I'm on duty right now, but it's really nice to see you like this, Prince!", 'I know your job gets frustrating sometimes, so please remember to take breaks, all right?', "I hope you're always finding joy in work like I do, Prince!", "From the reports I've seen it looks like you've been doing such great work out there!", "Um, I, I, I, I'm sorry, I, I better get back to my cleaning...!", "Don't work yourself too hard, OK, Highness?", 'Please do remember to take breaks, OK?', 'You get rest from time to time, for me, OK?', 'I hope you get to see Miss Meg out there next time!', "I hope you'll get to see Thanatos again soon!", "Now, here you go, Cerbie! This stuff can't be that bad! I mean... can it?", "P-P-Prince, I'm really grateful for this, really, and I thought, I, kind of got something for you...?", "Wh-whaaaa, b-but, there must be some mistake, I, Prince, you're giving this to me...?", 'Ohh, oh, oh, oh my, Your Highness, are you... are you really sure you want me to have this?', "B-b-but, Prince, I, don't know what to say, I... are you joking around with me, maybe...?", "Oh, Prince, wow, thank you! Thanks so much!! You've been so generous, I... I think I'm speechless! No, can't think of anything to say right now!", "I... I'm glad we've had a chance to know each other, too. Thanks for the Nectar! I can tell it's really, really good! Um, OK, bye!", "I, I, I, I'm really very flattered, Prince, but, I've just been so busy, lately, that I haven't even had a chance to try the last bottle you gave me, so... you want this back, maybe for someone else?", "Oh! I mean, maybe I do? I think maybe I do, except, nobody's told me anything about that, and besides, there's so much work to do around the House still, I just can't leave everything like this!!", "Whoa, I, this, this is Ambrosia, Prince! But, this is for gods...! This isn't for... someone like me? But, wait, wait wait, no, here, I'm going to do it, I am going to do it, here, take this!! I got it, just for you, so, take it, please! Farewell!!", "Oh, I, but, you... really mean that, huh...? But, you're the Prince himself, and I'm just... look, we both know I am just a floating monster head. And a custodian. I just don't understand. Why keep on being nice to me, like this? I thought you'd never even talk to me...", "Ah. If only everybody in this House had yours, Prince Zagreus. You've been so kind to me, and I'm glad we've had a chance to get to know each other more. It's really nice, sometimes... knowing somebody really cares about me here?", "What, because I smile, haha? Smiling's just a little something that I like to do to deal with the day! Though, oh, that's what you meant, I... oh, I see. I, look, this is kind of a lot, I, I had better go...! I'll cherish the Ambrosia, though, OK?!", "...I'm sorry that I flew away last time you brought me something like this, Prince... I mean, Zagreus. It's really strange for me to call you that, I... when I started here, they told me not to even speak with you, and now, uh... here we are...!", "And I enjoy yours, too! Wasn't long ago that I was just a lonely gorgon head, all by myself in the big Underworld, looking for steady work. And then, I heard about the opening here, in your father's House? Well I got it! It seemed too good to be real. And then, there was you...", "I was so embarrassed! Worse... I thought I was done for, here. But, I got another chance! That was your doing, wasn't it? You've been looking out for me, all this time! That's so sweet of you, I... I don't know how to thank you, I... I, I better put this Ambrosia away, for safe keeping, OK?", "Oh! Y-you said your affection, huh, I... wow! I... really like you, also, Zagreus. I liked you from the start! You were so different from your father, and Miss Nyx, I could just tell, but... wait, what am I saying, I am such a dummy! You're just being friendly with me, right...?", "Um... wait, wait. Wait, wait. Did you just say I'm... wonderful?", "I, wow, I, I never thought you'd... have those kinds of feelings, for somebody like me. It's really nice to hear! It makes me feel complete. But, um, Zagreus, I don't know if I can be what you need, I mean? Wait. You weren't, you weren't just being nice to me for all this time, because...?", "Oh, hahaha, I was just checking, don't feel bad, OK? You don't seem capable of hiding what's in your heart. And I mean that in the best possible way. I'm so happy, it's just... all this is a lot, and, I'm on duty right now, but... see you soon...?", 'Oh no, no no no, Your Highness, are you, really giving this to me?', "Oh, Your Highness, Zagreus, come on! Don't even worry about it! I'd already forgotten, really no big deal. It's just, the past me, it's as though... it wasn't even me. This is me, now! I'm glad I'm here."]

But lately I've been keeping them waiting, because of you.", 'Good job, redblood! You made it all this way! But, I have got to send you back to daddy, now. Nothing personal!', "Oh, you know, I'd rather have my eyes put out, but thanks for offering! Now, time to head on home.", "You know, redblood, my appointments usually don't come to me, much less again and again! Think I'm here to show you a good time, huh?!", 'Whaa?! You think dealing with me beats dealing with that weakling? Graaaah!', 'How many times is it going to take, redblood? How many?! Tell me! How can you stand running into me like this, over and over?', "I'll give you one thing... I like it when my prey bites back. Come on, let's see some blood again.", "Tisiphone's started to say the strangest things, lately, redblood. You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?", "Stay out of her head!! You really think she's got something to learn from you? Learn to shut up from her!", "Eugh, still can't believe Megaera got mixed up with you, redblood. For all her weakness, I always thought at least she took her job here seriously. Eh, live and learn!", "Ohh, you might get mad? Defend Megaera's honor, since she's far too weak to do it her damn self? You think she's so pure! Hahaha! You're disgusting! Both of you.", "Oh hey, redblood! You're back for more. I like that stubborn stupidness about you, honestly. If only I could keep you alive even longer this time.", "Haven't decided how just yet. This girl likes a little spontaneity.", "Huh! Normally my marks don't make a habit of seeking me out again after I'm through with them.", "Ugh, I do so hate to let you down like this, redblood. But you're just not my type. Maybe I'll finally get it through your head this time.", "Know something, redblood? Try as I might, I still have not forgiven you for beating me last time. Call it a crippling character flaw, I don't know...", "You think we're making progress? Here? Ah, hah, ha-hah, ha-hah, ha-hah, why you piece of trash! I'll show you progress.", "Redblood, I'm getting awful sick of seeing your smug face, time, after time, after time.", "You see? That is exactly what I mean. To think that Megaera had to put up with you for, I don't know how long.", "Damn you for this, redblood. You're making me look bad, you know? Making me feel bad.", "Ah-hahah-hahaha, hahah, you do know what happens when you make me feel bad, don't you...?", "Huh, it's the god of trash, come once again to filthy up this place! You're getting real predictable, you know.", "Don't want to hear it from you, trash! Just want to see you bleed. Now you come here!", "Ohh, there he is, sisters. It's time to get to work.", "You ready, Megaera? Tisiphone? Let's go.", "Let's tear him into shreds, sisters, come on!", "Hey, check it out, sisters, he's back. You ready?", "He's come crawling back again, sisters. Let's get him, then.", "All right, sisters! Don't screw this up for me!", "I'm taking point against this trash, sisters. You back me up.", 'All three of us against this trash, sisters? All right!', 'The three Furies up against the trash god! What a fight!', "Oh, hohohohoho, look at him, sisters! Don't you just want to whip him all to shreds?!", 'Much as I love chatting with you, Meg, Tisiphone... our prey is here.', "You ready, Sis? This redblood's nothing to the both of us.", "Check it out, Sis! The god of trash is here. Let's get to work.", 'Well, Sis, what do you say we get started on him?', "There he is, Sis! I'm ready if you're ready.", "All right, Sister! Let's rip him all to shreds!", 'You ready for him, Sister? I most definitely am!', "You're never getting through the both of us without losing a lot of blood, trash god.", "My sis and I, we're going to tear you limb from limb, redblood!", 'Think you can scoot right past the both of us, trash god?!', 'All right, Sis! You just back me up against this trash!', "I'll just keep killing you, redblood. Not that I mind!", 'What are we going to do with you this time, now, hm?', "I'm impressed, redblood. You really never learn.", 'Turns out, killing the god of trash never gets old.', 'How would you like to die this time, redblood? Here, let me guess.', "You just don't get it, do you? Though I bet I can make you learn.", "I'm getting real sick of you, trash god. Come on!", 'Bad news for you, redblood. I like dying.', "Come on, redblood, let's see you kill me again!", "You're stuck with me forever, trash. Remember that.", "I'm really starting to hate you. You know that, redblood?", "Why if it isn't the god of trash himself. I'm so honored.", "Good news for you, I'm in a real bad mood right now.", 'Been looking forward to this chance to get you back, redblood.', "Heard you were in the area, and thought I'd take another stab at killing you.", "Redblood, I really don't appreciate what happened here last time.", "You might get through me, trash god, but I'm going to spill your blood before you do!", "Long as I slow you down, redblood, I've done my job.", "You think just 'cause you got through Megaera, you'll get through me?", 'Your daddy never should have given Megaera this job.', "Megaera couldn't make it, redblood, so it's me and you.", "Hah! It's Megaera's hot mess. Let's clean you up.", "You got Tisiphone, so what. Now I'll get you.", 'You mess with Tis, redblood, you mess with me, get it?', "Tisiphone's been having problems with you, huh. Let's get to killing you.", 'This job never gets old, redblood, I can assure you that.', "Well if it isn't the god of trash himself. Fine.", 'Oh, thank the Fates I get to deal with you this time.', "Let's see what you can do, redblood. Come on!", "Well! Look who's back. The god of trash, himself.", 'Get ready for a bunch of pain and suffering, trash god.', 'Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold it right there, redblood.', 'Been waiting here to beat you to a bloody pulp, redblood!', "Don't even open that damn mouth of yours, redblood. Did I hurt your feelings, huh?", "Ohh, I'm going to bleed you till you're dry.", 'You want to mess with me again, redblood?! I've got lots of other trash to whip, you know!", "You want through that door back there, it's going to cost you blood!", "Megaera's not just weak, she's got bad taste to match.", 'Oh good, I was just Title: Hades
Dialogues: ['Chased them away you did!', 'Those shades always come back.', "Oh those shades aren't so bad.", 'Why trouble them, Prince Z.?', 'No need for that here, Prince.', "They'll just come back next time.", 'Those shades are stuck here, Prince.', 'Why shoo those shades away?', 'Erm, Prince...?', 'You show those dusty pots!', 'Nice shot, Prince Z.!', 'That sound never gets old!', 'Thank you for picking up a bit!', 'They keep replacing those.', 'Nice shot, Prince Z.!', "I'm glad that wasn't me!", 'Break all the pots you like!', 'Fraid those are empty, Prince!', "Don't bother with those, Prince.", 'Bouldy is much obliged!', 'Thanks on behalf of Bouldy there!', 'Look how happy Bouldy is!', "That's one good rock, isn't he, Prince!", "You've Bouldy's favor, Prince!", 'I think he likes you!', 'Bouldy is grateful.', 'Your offering has been accepted, Prince!', "I'm sure he's grateful, Prince.", "That's good of you, Prince Z.!", 'Bouldy has got you covered!', 'See that, Bouldy?', "Think Bouldy's warming up to you!", "Bouldy's a good listener isn't he!", 'You have been blessed by Bouldy!', 'Bouldy appreciated that!', 'Oh, look how happy Bouldy is!', "You're most gracious, Prince Z.", 'You see that, Bouldy?', 'You two have a real thing going!', "Bouldy's got your back.", "Sounds good, sounds good, Madam, that's more than equitable really, I'll hold you to that! Be seeing you around!", "I appreciate your vigilance, Madam, and surely I'll be getting Bouldy up this very hill in no time flat, despite the fact that I have never once achieved this!", 'Entirely makes sense to me, Madam, and rest assured that Bouldy, erm, that is to say this boulder here, that I will push it regularly, moving forward, same as ever! Now good-bye!', "Why, absolutely, Master Thanatos, I wouldn't think of it! My mind is fully occupied with all the latest boulder-pushing strategies, besides.", "Well, that's just it, Master Thanatos. I never was terribly fearful of you gods, if you'll forgive my saying so. Far as I can tell, all of you seem to have your struggles much like mortals do. need us!', "Hey, Prince Z. Must look like I'm slacking off with the old boulder, here, but... I was just getting back on my feet. The Fury Sisters don't often leave me be. Where'd they go, anyway? And... what are you doing here?", "Oh I'll let them know, all right, I hear you loud and clear, Your Highness. I'll just go about my business now, and you take care.", "You know, Prince Z., I'd not expected to run into you again, not after all this time. Something amiss down in the House, or what? Not had much company of late, is all.", "Well I am grateful for it, I and the old boulder there, in turn. I'm used to going lengthy stretches on my own, but having visitors from time to time would do me well!", 'If I may be so bold, Your Highness, I was wondering... what brings you back around this way again? Same story as last time?', "Whew, that is quite an undertaking, Prince. If it wasn't you yourself proposing it, I'd like to call it madness, truth be told. Though you're just mad enough to pull it off! Well hey, I hope you make it. Good fortune out there!", 'Hey Prince how goes the old escape plan, any luck?', 'Ah, well, keep your chin up. Me, why I quit trying to get out of here a while back, but, if I was a fire-stepping youngster like yourself, perhaps I would have stuck to it.', 'Hey, Your Highness, anything the matter, or just passing through? Happy that we get to chat like this of late, of course.', "Hah! Come now, Prince Z., that's just the way I am! Besides, you're not your father, thank the gods! You always seemed a decent lad to me, and if you're saying you want out of here, why, I suppose I can relate, is all.", "You know, Prince, it's been good not having to see those Fury Sisters quite as much lately. The main one, what's her name, she's on your case now, isn't she.", "Not seen the other Fury Sisters in some time now that you mention it! Just Megaera, the kindly one, and she is quite a handful on her own. I'll keep an eye out for the other two!", "You push old Bouldy here sufficient times, and you might get a different outlook on things, too. With the Furies all preoccupied and with my running into you from time to time, I'm positively doing great lately. I like to take what pleasures I can get!", 'Look here, Bouldy, Prince Z. himself has come to visit us!', "Oh, Bouldy's not so bad, I mean, he's a good listener, a good shoulder to lean on, doesn't wield a whip... I rightly can't complain! Good having company down here.", "Oh, hah! Well, I just think you're in a tough spot lately, Prince. But you'll get through! As for old Bouldy, why, by all means do not hesitate to lay your troubles on him if you like! Dumped all of mine on him a while back.", "That's truly all it takes to make a friend sometimes, indeed, Highness. Now, here.", "He's a good one, all right, isn't he? Though if you've come to such an understanding with old Bouldy there, why, it must mean you've done some growing on your own as well, I think.", 'Hey, Your Highness, good, old Bouldy there had several things he wanted to tell you.', "Thank you for listening to him! With all that said, I think I've got something for you right here.", "Hey Prince, ah, so... you do know Bouldy's just a plain old rock with a few lines chiseled into him, resembling a face, don't you? Chiseled into it, I mean. Just so you don't get the wrong idea...", "Hahahaha, no. Was just a jest, there, at Bouldy's expense. Look at him! He gets so annoyed when I call him a plain old rock like that. But then he calls me an old lazy lump, and then we're even for a while.", "Ah, fortunately I've not seen too much of her, myself, Prince Z. And based on everything that I have seen and heard, I'd like to keep it that way for a while! I hope she doesn't cause you too much trouble there.", "Tisiphone. Why, yes, I have, in fact, Prince Z. She's visited on multiple occasions, truth be told. So she is back, is she?", "Appreciate it, Prince. Of all the Fury Sisters, she's the one I would least care to see. But if she does stop by, you know, that's how it goes.", "Look, Prince, I don't hold grudges, you know that. Push this boulder long as I have, you move past the petty stuff. So, just want you to know, in case you make it out this time, it's been a real pleasure.", "I get it, Highness, and I didn't mean to pry, it's just... I can't remember what it's like to want something so bad, you know? Whoever's out there, I hope you find them soon.", "Might surprise you, Highness, I've a bit of royalty in me, myself. Not on your level, mind, but I was very much a king. Though I'll be honest, I... I wasn't much of a good man.", "Well that is awful kind of you to say. Though, I would like to think my punishment here wasn't without warrant. At least I've had a lot of time to think it through!", "Well, it's a bit of a long story, Prince. My time had come, though I just wasn't ready, you might say. Your father thought he had me in his clutches, but then, shoom! I gave him the slip. Your father's henchman, Thanatos, he'll back me up on that.", "Turns out your father doesn't like us mortals cheating death. Eventually they found me, so, now I'm stuck here with my boulder friend. I push old Bouldy up the hill to the beat of the Furies' whips, then he tumbles down, and then we go again.", "You save those sympathies for someone else, Your Highness! I could be Prometheus, spending an eternity having my liver gobbled up, but instead I get to stay in shape, and have these chats with you. Now I'd better get back to it!", "Oh, well, you know! I have acquaintances amongst the locals here, try to be neighborly with everyone is all. It's not just Bouldy and myself as you can see. Sometimes I come across things that'd be better off in other hands than mine.", "Well, ah-hah, the thing is that I wasn't, Highness. And that's not modesty from me, all right? All behind me, now. And I'd appreciate it if we left it at that.", "It's more like... this is where I belong. Where my path has taken me, you know? Here in the Underworld, you can't entirely escape your past... and yet, it's like you get another life to live. With all the wisdom that you picked up along the way.", "You know, Prince Z., you really have a look about you that you know exactly where you're going, as of late. I used to think you weren't near as comfortable in your own skin.", "Nor did we have much opportunity to chat back then, but hey! You always struck me as a decent sort. Wasn't accustomed to your father's henchpeople greeting me with a smile.", "Oh, come now, Prince, do Bouldy and I look like we could use your charity? We're planning to stay put within this chamber for a while. It's hardly a predicament, I'd say.", "Ah, yes, the Fury Sisters, well. I wouldn't mind seeing them more infrequently now that you mention it, but either way! So don't you even worry about me. Now, here.", "Oh! Indeed, then, does this mean, Prince, then... the Fury Sisters, they won't come around as often anymore?", "You're much too kind to this old soul, Prince Z. The thing is, this is home. For me and Bouldy, it is what it is. Though, knowing that the Furies won't be visiting with quite their former regularity, that is a load off. Heavier than Bouldy, there.", "Is that so odd, Highness? Don't see myself lugging old Bouldy out of here, besides! And if I were to leave, why, we would not be having these exchanges now and then. I happen to enjoy them quite a bit! Now, here you go, and thank you, very much.", "Must say, Prince Z., the free life sure does have its perks down here! This place really isn't as bad as it's cracked up to be.", "Well, it used to be I'd have to start heaving Bouldy there at any point, if the Fury Sisters decided to show up. But now? I just get to relax, chat a bit with the other shades, and give you one of these when you're in the area!", "Ah, there you are, Prince! I was just thinking about how grateful I am that you got me out of that contract with your father. It's been a real weight off my shoulders, truth be told.", "And I could say the same to you! Look, I know you were concerned for my wellbeing. Now you don't have to be. And I'll still be around to help you out. Good feeling, isn't it?", "You must have seen everything there is to see here in your father's Underworld, haven't you, Prince? I figure that there isn't any place nicer than this!", "I'll take what's coming to me right here, thank you very much. You're the wayfaring sort, but my wayfaring days are over. It's hard to explain, but... this is a much-needed fresh start for me.", 'I will have you know, Prince, that your visits here have become a very important part of my routine!', "Why, the routine of looking forward, of course! I try to appreciate the moment as much as anybody, but you know? It's always nice having something to look forward to. So, see you next time, then?", "I heard straight from the source the Fury Megaera's been giving you a time, there, hasn't she. Trust me I know the feeling, so, I'm grateful that you're here and that she's not. You give her hell for me next time, won't you?", "Hey Prince, I heard you showed that Fury Sister the what-for, is that the truth? Might explain why I've been left here to my own devices for a change.", "Now you be careful out there, Highness. The kindly Megaera is out for blood. She kept on groaning 'bout the last exchange between the two of you. You must have showed her good!", "Hey, Prince Z., I heard the strangest rumor, here's the thing, I'll give it to you straight. I have heard you've been consorting both with Megaera the Fury and with that old stiff, Thanatos, can you believe it?", "I... look, I do appreciate the sentiment, Your Highness, I'm just surprised. I thought we shared a common foe in them, is all. What can I say, I hope that someday I can see them how you see them.", "Look, Prince, it's not for me to judge you, or your friends. The Fury Sisters, Master Thanatos... we got off on the wrong foot, you could say. My fault, entirely. I'd sooner make sure that our correspondence here doesn't make those relationships more difficult.", 'Certainly, Highness. And who knows? Perhaps as you spend more time together, some of your finer qualities will rub off on those two!', "How goes it with old Master Thanatos of late, Prince Z.? Is he at least less stern with you than with the poor mortals he's sent to take in here?", "That's good, I guess! Always appreciated that he ultimately took me in, rather than having to show up here through much more sudden, much more painful means. Didn't stop me from trying to avoid the trip, of course.", "Word is you've caused quite the hubbub in Elysium, Prince Z.! Making the champion up there really work for it, I hear?", "I bet he'd like you better if you were a regular pushover! Ah, well, he'll learn, I'm sure.", "Prince, you've been gone for quite a while, why... I heard-tell you made it all the way outside! And I believed it for a while there, yet here you are. What happened, might I ask?", 'Well, I am certainly delighted to hear that! So long as you achieved what you set out to do. But, what brings you back again this way? More than a social visit I presume.', "Going to try and make it out of here again and again, is it? Well they say repetition is the key to mastery, Prince Z. Now here, I'll send you on your way.", "So, how do you like the surface, hey, Prince Z.? Now that you've finally had a chance to see it for yourself. Not too bad, I hope?", "Oh, you know. I still have almost everything that matters, and the rest? It makes for precious memories I didn't have up there.", "So, all this time, Prince, when you were battling up to the surface, and all that... you were searching for her, weren't you? The Queen?", 'Well, just the one time, briefly, when your father decided to put me here. And, you have my word, of course. About the... surface stuff.', 'Prince Z., my understanding is the Queen herself is back, is that correct? Moreover, I have heard a truly fascinating rumor about her...', "That's wonderful to hear. I'd always heard good things about that one. No wonder such a quality runs in the family.", "Just one thing I don't understand, Prince Z., if you'll indulge me for a moment, here. If everything is all right for you at the House, then... why is it you're fighting to the surface, still?", "Sure, that makes sense! Well, from a certain point of view. Escape over and over to prove it can't be done! I like that. Well, let's both of us keep at it, then!", 'Not working yourself too hard of late, are you, Prince Z.? Remembering to take some breaks from time to time, and all?', "Well, it was work, you know? Even your Father has to work. Of course, I've since retired! But it seems you and he like to keep yourselves occupied. Whatever makes you feel content.", "Say, that's my Shattered Shackle on your person, right, Prince Z.? I'd recognize that clunky thing from anywhere. It serving you all right?", "Bit of an odd story, that. Involved a well-timed accident with the old boulder there. Though, I'd best not get into it so that you're not accomplice to that little crime. Surely you understand?", "My Shattered Shackle's practically like new, there, Prince! Minus the part where it's still broken, and all that. Nice work!", "Hahahahah! Absolutely not, though truly I appreciate the sentiment. I'd rather have a look at the old boulder there than a symbol of the time I first got stuck here, when I wasn't doing quite as well.", "Word is that the most beautiful music's been heard up in Asphodel, lately, Prince! From the sound of it, why... I think that has got to be Eurydice and Orpheus!", "Oh, I've more than heard of them! I'm sure you know how Orpheus once ventured all the way down here, after Eurydice passed on. I'll never forget his song! Even the Fury Sisters gave me a break, they were so captivated by it, then. Ah, good times. For me, at least!", "Prince Z., it seems you've brought my little Shady back to visit me! How very kind. And I can tell he's in good care of late.", "All due respect, Highness, but I've the best friend anyone can ask for to my right just there. And as for little Shady, he was more inclined than I to see the farthest reaches of the Underworld. Safe travels to you both!", "Well, Prince, I told you that we'd be with you in spirit, didn't I? It's not just Shady's power, I suppose, nor is it Bouldy's or my hidden strength. It's testament to our companionship, is all. You gods are capable of anything!", "Oh I'm just fine, thanks, Prince. That Fury Sister, she is quite a lass, I have to say, and very, very strong. Bet she could push old Bouldy here better than I!", "Never got the boulder to the top, not even once. Always tumbles down right at the very end. Lost count after the nineteen thousandth time or so, but you know what? One of these days, I bet it's going to stick.", "Why, I believe you heard just that, Your Highness! Seems the Fates are giving me a break. Although, the Fury Sister did declare that she'll be back to haunting me after she's through with you...", "Oh, I'm doing very well, thanks, Prince. I'm not afraid of him, I mean, what have I got to lose? Now here, I wanted you to have this.", "Can you believe the nerve of that one, Prince? He's nothing but a blowhard, so, I simply tell him what he wants to hear! He can't stop me from helping you, besides. I'm dead already, what's he going to do?", "Prince Z.! Just missed your stern-faced colleague, feel that stillness hanging in the air? Sounds like he won't be checking up on me again anytime soon.", 'Oh, I believe it, Highness. I should think that bringing death must be a lonely job. Perhaps he ought to try pushing a boulder sometime!', 'Good to see you in one piece, Prince Z.!', 'Life treating you all right, I take it, Prince?', "Oh I'm hanging in there, thanks for asking, Prince!", "You'll make it out of here, I've no doubt about it!", 'Nice of you to drop in for a bit!', 'You are a sight for sore eyes, Prince!', "Now you be careful out there, won't you, Prince?", 'You give them hell for me, all right, Prince Z.?', 'Go get them for me, Prince!', 'Got just the thing for you here, Prince!', "It's always good to see you, Prince!", 'You keep your chin up, Prince!', 'Keep fighting the good fight, there, Prince!', 'Hey you take care, you hear me, Prince?', "Let's both of us keep going, that a deal?", "It's good of you to visit me like this!", "Hope everything's been well enough of late.", 'You watch your step out there, all right, Prince Z.?', "Hullo Highness, you're looking well enough!", 'Hey, Your Highness, how goes it, how is everything?', "I have to say it's good to see a friendly face!", 'Always a pleasure, Highness, you take care out there.', "Here's my best friend in all the Underworld, how goes it, Prince?", 'Glad you made it all this way, Prince Z.', "Think I've got just the thing for you right here, Highness!", "A brief hello from time to time does wonders, don't you think, Prince Z.?", "Much as I like the company of Bouldy there, you're always welcome, Prince!", "Stop by whenever you're around these parts, all right, Prince Z.?", "I know it isn't much, Highness, but I do hope this helps!", "Here's something courtesy of me and Bouldy, Prince!", 'How about a little bit of help as you keep on your journey, Prince?', "Let's see if we might make your going slightly easier, there, Prince!", 'Should have something that ought to come in handy for you, Prince!', "No need for these, so take one off my hands, won't you, Prince Z.?", 'Bouldy and I have got the usual for you right here, Your Highness.', 'Highness, please take one of these and go!', "All's well out here in Tartarus, Prince Z.! What will it be?", 'Bouldy and I got our usual selection here, Highness!', "Don't let me keep you, Prince, I know you've plenty of important business here.", 'Before you go, Prince Z., a little souvenir from your fine stay in Tartarus.', "Don't do anything I wouldn't do out there, you hear me, Prince?", "You're looking good and ready for whatever lies ahead up there, Prince Z.!", 'You know approximately where to find me if you happen to be in the area again, Prince Z.!', "Everything's fine as ever here, Prince Z., so you go on ahead, and don't look back!", 'I have a feeling you are going to make it all the way topside this time, Highness!', 'Need a little pick-me-up perhaps?', 'Bouldy and I will always be here in your time of need, Prince Z.!', "Bouldy says whatever we can do to help, we'll do it, Prince!", 'In case words of encouragement are not enough, have one of these here, Prince!', "Let's get you on your way, Prince Z., and in good spirits, too!", "Don't you worry, Highness, we have got you covered here!", "Told old Bouldy here you'd probably be back if only to say hi!", 'Hey Prince, Bouldy and I will not be needing these, but maybe they can help!', "Just do the best you can, if you don't mind me saying so, Prince Z.!", "Speaking for myself and Bouldy there, we're always at your service, Prince.", 'You get all the way up to the top and do whatever it is needs getting done, Highness!', 'I know Bouldy believes in you every bit as much as I do, Prince!', 'Now hold a moment, Highness, I cannot accept something like this... not without giving back a little something in return, that is!', "Oh, my, you're really giving that to me, there, Prince? But, I'm just, why would you...?", 'Why, Prince, you being serious right now, is that for me?', "Wow, Your Highness, you... you really shouldn't have. Thank you for not forgetting about me.", "I'm really very flattered, Highness! You didn't have to get me anything, I mean, your company's more than enough for me!", "Oh, but this is just too much for me, Your Highness, thank you, really. I don't know how I can ever repay you.", "Why, Prince, is this...? It is...! I've not so much as seen a bottle of it, much less sampled it, thank you so much! Although, with all respect, I cannot rightfully accept such a fine gift. Unless...", "This, Highness, is a little friend of mine kept tucked away in Bouldy's care. Wherever you'll be going next, he'll make a worthy traveling companion. And when he's with you, Bouldy and I... we'll be with you in spirit, too.", 'Prince, that vintage Ambrosia bottle that you gave me, my! That was the greatest thing I ever tried, I think! Even Bouldy enjoyed the stuff!', "What? You mean that you've never touched the stuff yourself? You've much more self control than I have, there. Perhaps someday we'll have a chance to share some between us!", 'Prince, that vintage Ambrosia bottle that you gave me, my! That was the greatest thing I ever tried, I think! Even Bouldy enjoyed the stuff!', "Ah, look at what the Prince has brought for us, Bouldy! Perhaps someday we'll have a chance to share some between us!", "All this, for someone such as me. You know I'm down here for a reason, don't you, Prince? Not just because your father and good Thanatos don't care for me. Yet, from the very first, you showed me decency I'd not experienced since I was a king. Perhaps not even then.", "Well, Your Highness, I am honored very much indeed, and having you amongst my list of friends makes it perhaps the greatest such a list a fellow such as I has ever had. Isn't that right, Bouldy?", 'Take it from me, Prince Z., Bouldy concurs.', "Wait, really, this, this is for me, you mean it, Prince? I mean, I won't say no, I can't say no to such a thing, so, thank you! Thank you kindly.", "...I'm really rather speechless, Your Highness. I'm just a shade doing my time. I don't deserve your generosity.", 'Sure thing!', 'You got it.', 'Say no more!', 'Easy does it!', 'Good choice!', 'A fine selection there!', "It's all yours!", 'Sure, here you go!', 'Good idea!', 'Makes sense to me!', 'Most excellent!', 'Not to worry!', 'That I can do!', 'Got just the thing!', 'I got you covered!', 'I got you covered, Prince!', 'Certainly, Highness!', 'Sure thing, Prince Z.!', 'My pleasure, Prince!', 'No worries whatsoever!', 'Think I can do that, Prince!', 'Got that right here, Prince Z.!', 'Then here you go!', 'Ah, certainly, Prince Z.!', 'Here you are!', 'Uh, Prince?', 'Nice try, there!', 'No use in that.', 'Already dead here, Prince.', "Don't bother, Prince.", 'Come on, now.', 'Oh come now.', 'Why bother.', 'Try all you like!', 'Very funny, Prince.', 'Oof, got me good there!', "Nope, can't feel a thing.", "That's it, let all out.", 'Hah, good one, Prince!', 'Augh, you got me, Highness!', 'Oh, please, have mercy and all that!', 'That your best shot, Prince Z.?', "Now don't get frustrated all right?", 'You getting ready for the road ahead?', 'Nice shot there, Prince!', "Augh, I'm hit!", 'Wow you are strong Prince Z.!', 'Whew, most impressive, Prince!', 'No use in that.', "Don't bother, Prince.", 'Come on, now.', 'Oh come now.', 'Why bother.', 'Very funny, Prince.', 'Pick on somebody your own size, Prince!', "That's one fight you aren't going to win!", 'Takes more than that to budge old Bouldy, Prince!', "Sure is heavy, isn't he!", 'Bouldy can take whatever you dish out!', "Now there's no need for that here, Prince.", 'Try all you like, there, Prince!', "Hey that's my friend, Prince Z.", 'No hurting Bouldy, Prince.', "That's one tough rock you're messing with.", "Don't hurt yourself, all right?", 'Come now, Highness!', 'Why, your Highness?', 'Oh what did Bouldy ever do to you?', "Never got the boulder to the top, not even once. Always tumbles down right at the very end. Lost count after the nineteen thousandth time or so, but you know what? One of these days, I bet it's going to stick.", 'I think he likes you!', 'No use in that.', "Don't bother, Prince.", 'Come on, now.', 'Oh come now.', 'Why bother.', 'Very funny, Prince.']

Title: Hades
Dialogues: ['How very thoughtful, child.', 'You are too kind.', 'It is appreciated, child.', 'Here.', 'Child?', 'A word.', 'Did you find her?', 'Wait...', 'Zagreus?', 'A moment.', 'A word, child?', 'Ah.', 'You have done well.', 'You broke free.', 'You reached the surface...', 'Well done.', 'At last.', 'I never doubted you.', 'Excellently done.', 'I knew that you were more than capable.', 'I had envisioned that you would succeed.', 'Skillfully executed work.', 'Well done, child.', 'A commendable result.', 'You have done well.', 'Excellent work.', 'To your continued success.', 'You have come home.', 'Hmm.', 'You are home.', 'Child.', 'My child.', 'You have returned.', 'You are returned.', 'It is you.', 'You are back.', 'You are here.', 'A setback, then.', 'Ah.', 'Be unseen.', 'There you are.', 'Zagreus.', 'The Fates have been unkind.', 'Another setback to be overcome.', 'The realm is strong.', 'The House is in order.', 'Haaaaah.', 'Then, go.', 'Do not despair, child. Such setbacks are inevitable, and may be overcome with effort, and with time. You made contact with the goddess Athena. She shall be true to her word.', 'The risk is not to me. I expected the Olympians would involve themselves in this, eventually. Reveal to them no more than they already know. Are we understood?', 'It pleases me to speak with you at last, child. So the goddess Athena was true to her word. You and she were wise to use discretion in your task.', 'The risk was not to me. It was inevitable that the Olympians would involve themselves in this. The only question was how.', 'I trust that the Mirror in your bedchamber has proved satisfactory, dear child...?', 'I think you are, as well. Then, it shall be as you wish.', "Before you go, my child... your father's mood is rather difficult right now. Perhaps just leave him be.", 'The Three Fates are my daughters, yes, my child. However, I am no more privy to their workings than the naive mortals living up above. Not even the Olympians can know the weavings of the Fates.', 'Darkness guide you, child. You have outgrown this House, of that I am now certain. Should you return again here, I shall keep you safe.', 'It is more than all right, my child.', "I always knew, in turn, that you would learn the truth of it, eventually. And I was fearful of what would occur after that time arrived. I'm grateful it has come and gone. Though, tell me. I still find I call you child. Is your preference that I cease to use such terms, from this point on?", 'That is a question only your father can answer, child. I cannot tell you more than you already know.', '...I was here long before your father. The responsibility to govern fell to me. Yet, I could not manage on my own. I shape the darkness; ensure the integrity of the domain. I am less prone to census-taking and administering rules. I receded from such responsibilities.', 'I was quite skeptical of him, at first. I thought his presence merely a cruel trick of Fate. But... he worked diligently, from the start. Soon there was order where once there was none. I fashioned this House for him, and I maintain it still. We remain in partnership. In interdependency.', 'No, child. He has not. He can be short with me, as you have seen. But that is the extent of it. We have found ways to reconcile disagreements. Though, your relationship with him... it is more complicated than my own, I fear...', 'You need not fear for me, my child. For I am not some underling your father has authority to punish if it pleases him. I am the Night; and it is by my grace that this House stands. Your father knows this. Thus, he and I have certain common goals. We are obligated to cooperate.', 'Please... that is something I am not at liberty to say. When you meet your birthmother eventually... you shall understand.', 'You need not fear for me, my child. For I am not some underling your father has authority to punish if it pleases him. I am the Night; and it is by my grace that this House stands. Your father knows this. Thus, he and I have certain common goals. We are obligated to cooperate.', 'Your father and I... sometimes convince ourselves.', 'They typically do not. But, you are family, child. And I, why... I believed Athena wise enough to understand why someone such as I would seek her, in particular. She has, in turn, made others in her family aware.', 'We have, thank you, my child. Goddess Athena is reputed to be wise, and so she was the one I felt was the most likely to listen to reason, understand my view, and ultimately have a willingness to help. It is most fortunate that I was not mistaken about her.', 'She is wise, child. It is precisely for that reason I expected she would understand.', 'We have, thank you, my child.
