Look, hon, why don't you get on with your business, then. But you can't leave empty-handed, that's the rule, so take your pick, my treat! Nothing for him, though.", "Hey, hon, what's going on, speak up! I know when something's up down to my roots, and something's up.", 'Orpheus said all that, huh? Tell you what, the next time you run into him, you ask him about the time that he came all this way to try and save me, even though I was already dead. Can you guess how that turned out?', 'Yeah, well, neither did he! But you know what? Actions beat intentions, hon. Now, here, how about a treat and you can be on your way.', "Hey, hon, what's going on, speak up! I know when something's up down to my roots, and something's up.", 'Orpheus said all that, huh? Tell you what, the next time you run into him, you ask him about the time that he came all this way to try and save me, even though I was already dead. Can you guess how that turned out?', 'Yeah, well, neither did he! But you know what? Actions beat intentions, hon. Now, here, how about a treat and you can be on your way.', "What is it, hon? Oh no, don't tell me you've come all the way from Tartarus to ask me more about your good-for-nothing court musician friend.", "So let me see if I understand. Orpheus blew it with me like an idiot, but now I'm supposed to be reaching out to him? Sorry, hon, but that's not happening. The two of us are finished. And, you know what? I think we're finished here, too. If you'll excuse me!", "Hey there, hon! So what do you think, pretty good tune, right? Don't know how come everybody doesn't sing. Lightens the mood, passes the time. What's not to like?", "Oh it's not Orpheus' song, you kidding me? This one's all mine. He always did like going on about how I'm his muse, well, that's 'cause I wrote half his songs for him! Bet he didn't mention that, did he.", "He can be a little hard to tolerate. A quality I hope isn't going to rub off on any of his mates. I should get back to practicing, see you.", 'Tsk... and what am I supposed to do with that, Your Royal Majesty...?', "Don't think I will be running into him anytime soon from what I understand. But you're the Hades kid! You want to pull some strings on our behalf, go right ahead, I guess. But I won't hold my breath. Even if I could.", "So, uh, how's Orpheus been doing lately, anyway? Still keeping his hair in those neat little curls? I guess his tan must have faded by now.", "And now he knows I'm out there, still, huh. That's... well, thank you for the update, hon. Music's his gift. Good to know he's not thrown everything away.", "Yeah, sure, hon, what is it? Though you had better not be asking for my recipes. Closely guarded family secret! I'd say I'd take them to my grave, but... yeah.", "Your Royal Majesty, you want my song? You are aware it's called 'Good Riddance', right? Tsk, but sure, why not. If music's going to be playing in your House, it might as well be great. And let me give you something to go with it.", "...What'd he say, hon? I mean about the song. Bet he loved it, didn't he! But, I don't know for sure. And I've been wondering, kind of a lot, I guess.", "Huh. So it's a hit, is what you're saying, then. I had a feeling about that one. Sometimes you put some words together and right then and there, you know that you've got something special.", 'What happens now, hon...? What I mean is... now you got me thinking about Orpheus again, so... what am I supposed to do with that?', "Well, what can I tell you? Thanks, Your Royal Majesty. That means a lot. No pressure, though. I've been all right without him all this time, and I will be all right, no matter what. If only he could say the same.", 'Hey, listen here a moment, Hades kid. Look, I... Thank you. From the bottom of my heart. For bringing Orphy back to me again, and everything.', "Well, you're a real sweetheart, hon. You'll still be seeing Orphy all the time around your House, but now, I get to see him, too. Nice having something to look forward to, you know? Bet someone out there feels that about you.", "Hey! What's the matter, Your Royal Majesty? You're looking kind of down. Normally you're all smiles, for whatever reason!", "Oh, that? Pff, come on, don't even worry about it. If you were being too pushy, you better believe I would have put you back in your place, royalty or not. But hey, can't ever be too careful when it comes to people's past and feelings and stuff, right?", 'Got to tell you, hon. Orpheus sure is different since last he and I met. You know, back when he was still living and breathing and all.', "Oh, we're getting along great! Better than ever. He used to be a bit more of a hotshot, but now it's like, he's a little more... what's the word... sensitive? Now I can always tell exactly what's on his mind.", "Hey, Your Royal Majesty! I must say you've accomplished some truly amazing feats, according to Orphy at least! But don't worry. Your secret's safe with me.", "That modesty won't get you anywhere with me, either, hon, Your Greatness. I'm honored to merely be in the presence of one with so many wild exploits to sing or speak of!", "He did! And a tan is like... well, when you stay out in the hot sun up there long enough, your skin kind of starts to bake a little bit. But nicer than that sounds! Got to say, though, the years have been kind to Orphy, don't you think?", "Say, tell me something, there, Your Royal Majesty. You know a lot of shades. You wouldn't happen to know an Orpheus, would you? Spindly little thing, whiny voice? Heard he's officially serving in your court. Making music!", "You're mates, huh. Just as long as you don't count on him for anything. Hasn't even mentioned me, has he. Well if he ever does, you tell him I am doing great! I'm great.", "What's the latest, hon, anything been happening down in your fancy House lately?", "Not following instructions, huh. Sounds like Orpheus, all right. Well, if that's the most exciting thing you've got going on, then I haven't missed much being out here.", "Hey, what's up, hon? Say, you must know a lot of big shots, don't you? Other gods and all that?", "Oh, that's sweet of him! Nice enough guy, for an Olympian. Yeah, he was the one who dropped me off here in the first place. No hard feelings here, he was just doing his job. It was Orpheus who messed everything up.", "Sure don't see a lot of other nymphs around here, huh! We don't die too easy, most of us. Makes me feel all special!", "That's what I heard! Though it's not like we all hang out, I mean, you've got the dryads, and the naiads, and the nereids, and the oceanids... pretty much every type of terrain up top, there's a kind of nymph who loves it! Maybe we need a name for Underworld nymphs, too.", 'Oh, her? Yeah, she was with Hades Senior, why? Wait. Whoa. Are you...? I thought...', "Didn't get much of an impression, but I can tell you this: She had good taste in music! Orpheus and I, think we won her over with our little duet. Haven't seen or heard from her lately, though. Look, I hope everything's OK.", 'Oh, her? Yeah, she was with Hades Senior, why? Wait. Whoa. Are you...? I thought...', "Didn't get much of an impression, but I can tell you this: She had good taste in music! Orpheus and I, think we won her over with our little duet. Haven't seen or heard from her lately, though.", "Hey, everybody's saying Persephone... she's back? That sounds like a bit of good news, there, isn't that right, hon?", "Well, that's a relief. And, you're still here! So I guess you've got more official business to take care of, which means I've still got somebody to taste-test for me every now and then!", "Orphy tells me the Queen, she's been settling in just fine down at your House! Must be different having a lady like that around. How's Hades Senior taking it, if I may ask?", "Glad to hear it! Orphy always liked singing for an audience more than I did, and it sounds like she's a good one.", "You ever play any music, or sing or anything yourself, Hades kid? It's good for you, you know!", 'Well, might I recommend giving it a shot at some point? Who knows, you might be the next Orpheus!', 'You been snacking on onions or something, there, hon? No offense or anything, but you smell like you ate a whole one of them raw.', "What, are you kidding me? You can grill them, sauté them, fry them, boil them, pickle them, roast them! Oh, hon. You've been missing out.", "You got anyone special in your life, by the way, hon? You seem like you'd be good for somebody out here.", "Know what you mean. And hey, that's great! Long as you can still be yourself. I've known too many nymphs, their whole lives revolved around somebody they loved. I bet whoever it is that loves you... it's because of who you are.", "How long have I been down here, hon? Huh! I don't have the faintest. You lose your sense of time once you're a shade, or maybe once there's not a sun or moon over your head. But yeah, I found myself a decent spot and fixed it up a bit!", "You're just in time, Your Royal Majesty! Got something real good cooking right here that you are going to love. You hungry, yeah?", "What, you think I get a lot of guests, here? Haha, no, but I like cooking anyway! It's like singing, in a way. Keep getting better the more you try, turns out a bit different each time.", "The searing heat? Haha, I am dead, Your Royal Majesty! Searing's just a cooking technique to me. Don't need to sleep, either! I can just keep cooking up a storm. It's not so bad!", "Yeah, gods that can die! How is that fair? Was just a stupid snake bite in my case, can you imagine something more embarrassing? You're just minding your business, and then snap! You're dead, and on your way down here.", "Well, I was going to end up here sooner or later. Might as well while I'm still looking good. Though, I guess you do kind of get to lock in whatever age when you register. Bet everybody dying of old age pushed that one through.", "What's your official business, anyway, Your Royal Majesty? Seems like it's bringing you through Asphodel an awful lot lately.", "Oh really! Say no more, I know how that is. Hope the Fates will look the other way for you. Getting out of here, huh. Not thought of that myself in I don't know how long...", "Of all the lava rocks in Asphodel, the Hades kid found this one once again, wouldn't you know! You got a map or something to this place, or what?", "Coincidence? Come on, hon, you're a god. Someone out there is sending you my way. Maybe it's just the Fates. Ah well! I sure don't mind a little company. And I have lots to eat!", "Oh, not just any plants, hon! Trees! Big gnarled oaks and things. Some of them live hundreds of years! Way up there as mortals go. You take good care of it like that, maybe it'll grow to be something special for you, too!", "Yeah, I'm part oak, that's right. But maybe not the part you're thinking of, I mean, you think I would just hand you one of my babies or something? Hahahaha, that's disgusting!", 'Hold on, hon, is that... huh! Almost felt like Orpheus was with you there. Would you listen to me? Must have been singing too many high notes, or something.', "Oh, that's him in there all right! See, I never should have second-guessed myself. Well, you hang onto that, as I've got plenty memories of him already, thanks!", 'Oh, hon, you look awful. What did you get yourself into? Here, one of these should make you feel a little better.', "Oh, you look like you've been through a lot, Hades kid. Maybe a decent bite to eat will help!", "Oof, you're a mess, there, hon. You save your strength and see if this will do you any good.", "Hey, don't go bleeding on my floor, hon. I just cleaned the place! Take one of these, maybe it'll tide you over.", "Sing when you're happy, sing when you're not, Your Royal Majesty.", "Hey, it's the Hades kid! So what's it going to be this time, Your Royal Majesty?", "I'd say make yourself at home, hon, but you look like you got cooler places to be!", 'You are just in time, Your Royal Majesty! Cooked up something special just for you.', "Why, Your Royal Majesty, you're back! Well, see you later!", "And here I was just thinking it's been too long since the Hades kid stopped by!", "So what'll it be this time, Your Royal Majesty, hmm?", 'Oh you look positively famished, hon! Here let me help with that.', 'You must be hungry, hon. Got something ought to keep you going!', 'How nice of you to stop on by, Your Royal Highness! Here!', "How's it going lately, hon, you eating well and everything?", 'Just singing to myself and cooking up a storm. You know me, hon.', 'Eat up, hon! Not like I got other mouths to feed!', "All's well in Asphodel, Your Royal Majesty! You take care of yourself. I'll be here.", 'You want the best cooking in all of Asphodel, you know where to go!', "Hey, it's the Hades kid! What's it going to be this time, hm?", 'Take care of yourself out there, all right, Your Royal Majesty?', "Don't let Hades Senior get you down, hon. Here.", "I know you've got important business to attend to, so thanks for checking in, Your Royal Majesty.", "You look like you're in a rush, though there's always time for a quick snack, right?", "Hey, welcome back, Your Royal Majesty, you're just in time!", "Been trying to perfect these recipes for I don't know how long!", "You look like you haven't eaten since you were here last!", "You're always welcome here Your Royal Majesty.", 'I get you something for the road there, hon?', "What's it going to be, Your Royal Majesty?", "You just be sure to tell that good-for-nothing Orpheus I'm looking good.", "Hon, I'd ask how old what's-his-name is doing, but I don't even care!", "Bet you Orpheus hasn't had any strokes of musical genius lately, now, has he?", 'Better not be Orpheus putting you up to visiting here all the time like this.', "This song's better than anything Orpheus ever came up with I can tell you that.", "If you'll excuse me, Your Royal Majesty, I'm not exactly in the mood for an extended chat.", 'You best have no more messages from no-good Orpheus this time.', 'Here, have a snack, hon, and tell Orpheus it was delicious.', 'You keep an eye on Orpheus for me, all right, hon?', "Do one thing for me, hon. Make sure Orpheus knows I'll be right here.", "I've got to be honest with you, hon. Sometimes I kind of miss him.", "Sometime you'll visit me like this and Orpheus is going to be here too.", "Don't let Orpheus get into too much trouble, won't you, hon?", "I'm fine here on my own, hon. But, I wouldn't mind if he was here.", 'Hope Orpheus is on the up-and-up down where you live.', "I'd ask you to bring one of these to Orpheus, but they're no good unless they're perfectly fresh.", "Orpheus tells me you've been a good friend. Thanks, hon.", "I love Orpheus and all, hon, but it's nice having a little time here to myself!", "I know you can't stay long, hon, so eat up and stay safe out there, all right?", "I sing when Orpheus is here, I sing when he isn't. Simple!", "Aw, that's awful sweet of you, Your Royal Majesty. Bringing me fresh ingredients like this! Know what, here's something for you, too, help keep you safe out there!", "Just the ingredient I needed, hon, thank you so much! You know, you aren't near as bad as I'd heard!", 'Aw, for me, really, Your Majesty? This will be perfect for my latest recipes.', 'You read my mind, hon! I go through this stuff awful fast sometimes.', 'Hey, mighty generous of you to keep me stocked up on this stuff, Your Royal Majesty!', "Thanks, Your Majesty! Though you're not going to get in trouble bringing me this stuff, are you?", 'Whoa, this is Ambrosia! Hard to come by this stuff around here. You sure I can have this?', "I ever tell you you're a real sweetheart, hon? Because, if not, I'm telling you right now. Where would my culinary practice be if not for you?", "Well, we both know you've done a lot more for me than that. I wasn't expecting to make any new friends here anytime soon, so all the more reason it's been a real treat to get to know you. If I may say? You're a hell of a guy, Your Royal Majesty.", 'Enjoy!', "That one's on me!", 'Here you go!', 'All yours!', 'Freshly made!', 'You got it!', 'Sure thing!', 'Sounds good!', 'For you!', 'You got it, hon!', 'Coming right up!', 'Sure thing, hon.', "It'll be my pleasure.", 'Hah, I knew it!', 'Oh good choice there, hon.', 'You bet!', 'As you wish, Your Royal Majesty.', 'That can be arranged.', 'Sounds good, no problem!', 'Good choice!', 'Excellent.', 'Coming right up!', 'Try this!', 'Sure, here!', "Careful, it's hot!", 'Here, enjoy!', 'Hope you like it!', 'Come on.', 'Come on, now.', 'Not now.', 'Hey!', 'Please.', 'Let me sing.', 'Excuse me!', 'Eh!', 'Whatever!', 'Sorry, singing!', 'Really, hon?', 'Having fun?', 'Well, see you!', 'Careful, hon!', 'Take care, yeah?', 'Farewell Your Majesty!', 'Bye!!', 'OK bye!', 'Later then, yeah?', 'Smooth sailing!', 'Stay cool!', 'See you next time!', 'Come again!', 'You can do it!', 'See you!', 'Take it easy!', 'Take care!', 'Bye, hon!', 'Stay safe!', 'Safe travels!']

But I just couldn't help beating them to the punch this time!", 'Got here just as quickly as I could, Coz. Huh!', "I may not be the god you're looking for right at the moment, boss, but I will get you on your way to them in no time here!", "You heard already from my pop, haven't you, Coz? Wonderful guy. Don't get to spend a lot of time together, though! You know how that is. Well, see you!", "You know, Coz, my pop never gives his lightning blessings to me! He's quite invested in what happens to you, isn't he?", "Want to bring you in on something, boss. Reason that Uncle Poseidon got to you before I did is, I let him. He's under the impression he's as spry as ever! Hah!", "So then Athena's looking out for you, that's good, that's good! She likes to put a lot of thought and stuff in everything, it's all a little much, if you ask me!", 'You know who keeps me awful busy, Coz? Ares. Nothing like a good old war amongst the mortals to create demand for lots and lots of messages to go around!', "Did Artemis manage to locate you already, boss? But when it comes to her, exceptions must be made!", "You ever get the feeling life's been moving all too quickly for you, boss? Well Dionysus doesn't, as you're probably aware. Throws quite a feast, though!", "Been downright chilly up here lately, Coz! We've Demeter to thank for that! Me, I try to stay out of her way, she doesn't think I'm of much help to her. Although I'm sure she's warmed to you at least!", "Say, isn't that your father's blessing on you, Coz?! I almost can't believe it, but you've done such a good job of things, how could he not approve?", "Whoa, what's good, there, Coz? Though, who am I kidding, we can cut the small talk. I don't mind. A little way to stave off competition, masquerading as the wisdom of a sage. Those stupid mortals will buy anything!", "Not that I really know exactly what you're up to, Coz, but! I hand souls over to him, and that's it, you understand?", "Wouldn't you know it, boss! What do you think, Coz?", "I'd tell you not to ask too many questions of my good professional associate nearby, but then, who are we kidding, boss? Not like he'd answer you those questions anyhow!", "Been working with my good professional associate, the boatman there, since I-don't-know-how-long. Though, let me tell you, Coz, we haven't had a job quite like this yet!", "Among the many ways in which you could parlay your earnings into better chances of survival here, I'm flattered you would think of me this time!", "How strange of a coincidence that you keep running into me along the riverside like this, don't you agree, there, Coz?", "Don't normally go selling off my blessings to the highest bidder, boss, but your bid there is good enough for me!", "Oh! Mighty keen of you to leave a tip, there, boss. And I've a tip for you: Don't be slow! Maybe this will help with that.", "Well now, that's awful kind, there, Coz! No need to thank me, though. Not so profusely anyhow!", 'I look like I got the sort of time to sip Nectar, Coz? Well, guess what, I do! So, cheers!', 'Hey, boss, I appreciate the tip. But just as a reminder, all my services are paid in full already! No need for special thanks. Though... cheers.', "You know, Coz, I got to say I had a few concerns when we first met, your father being who he is and all. But you're all right!", "My rule is not to let things get too personal as far as work-related matters are concerned, Coz. But you're family! And, well, you're a right decent chap, I think. Offering up a bit of Nectar to me in the middle of all this!", "You know, the last time anybody offered me Ambrosia from the Underworld was never, before now! That's quite a gesture on your part. You could have just as well taken my services for granted and I'd not have minded in the least! But, thank you, Coz.", "Look, Coz, I am going to accept this choice Ambrosia from you one last time, all right? But from this point, I am doubling down on all professional responsibilities, here. Strictly business between us! Although, secretly, you're one of my best mates. Want you to know."]

Title: Hades
Dialogues: ["I'm ever-grateful, Nephew!", 'I very much appreciated that!', "I'm thankful for the gesture there!", 'Haha, just as I thought!', 'No choice at all, correct?!', 'A good decision there!', 'Ah, hahaha, yes!', 'Well chosen, little Hades!', 'Greatly decided, Nephew!', "Perhaps if you were not so odd, and made more effort to be somewhat more approachable, Ares, then we'd have more in common, you and I! Should you need any tips on that, why, you just let me know!", "Oh, Artemis, you needn't boast to little Hades there on my account! Besides! Whether you're in the sea, above it, or beneath, makes little difference to your measure as a god! You two are young as yet! Keep at it, and you'll soon be practically as great as I!", "Oh, hoh! What do we have here, little Hades? Seems to me that you have company! Well, I'll just leave the two of you alone. My lips are sealed tighter than a warship hull!", 'Ah-hah, there you are, my little nephew! Dionysus showing you the ropes, or what? You want a real feast, though, you just stick with me! Now take my blessing, go!', "Exactly so, Athena! You, with that fine memory of yours! For it isn't everyday I learn my doleful brother Hades sired a fine son! He does not know how good he has it, there! And you, Nephew, could have it even better, here!", "Now, little Hades, you have met my brother Zeus! He's sometimes known as king of all the gods! Although, in many ways, he's not as powerful as I! Nor anywhere as dashing. Why, I, oop!", "Buh, erm, anyway, as I was saying, little Hades! Brother Zeus is king of all the gods! And the most dashing, powerful, and hey, let's face it, godliest of all!", "As you can see by now, we are a big and clever family, little Hades! My niece Athena here being the cleverest of all. You'd never know that she was childless, the way she looks after and cares for all of us!", "Now, little Hades, you must know by now I've other nephews here, don't you? For instance, Ares comes to mind, the god of war! Some mighty wars have taken place at sea, is that not so?", "The thing about me, Nephew, is I get along with everybody, here! A skill apparently that's rather rare! Take my niece Artemis, for instance! Can't ever take a simple jest, at all! You won't easily attract a mate with such a sour look about you, girl!", 'Hahaha! See exactly what I mean, Nephew?', 'My foster-sister Goddess Demeter, despite her stern approach, she often likes to make good sport of me, Nephew! Why, here she is right now!', "Ah-haha! I knew that I could count on you, Nephew! So the ungrateful Theseus, the winsome prize he earned was just some chariot, correct? And he was vanquished on it, anyway! That's what he gets! Boasting his prize was greater than any in his mortal days, pah!", "Ah-haha-hah, little Hades, I was certain you'd the wherewithal to thin the ranks of the betraying river denizens who fled my surface-seas to your father's domain!! I bid you good fish-hunting forevermore!", "What's this, Nephew? Why, isn't this a note? Or, part of one, addressed to me, but it appears there should be other pieces, for the others here? Ah, it's like a sunken treasure, then! Which means I must seek its mysteries at once!", "You know, Nephew, I had a positively raucous time down there, with your old father, and Persephone, was she a sight! I never thought I'd see her again! So then, we're one big happy family, at last! But you've a job to do, and we upon Olympus, we'll do our fair share!", 'So, Nephew, my honored brother Zeus already has endowed you with his thunderous might? Well you shall soon forget about all that, after a taste of this!', "Ahh, you've received a blessing from Athena there already, little Hades! So careful all the time, that one, but here, I'll help you live a little, just in case!", "Oh-hoh, so you've already heard from Aphrodite, have you, Nephew? Understandable, but first things first, now let me add a little something to all that!", "Hoy, Nephew! It's my understanding you've been blessed already by one of my other nephews, Ares! As you can see, not all of us are cut from the same cloth; and thank the Fates for that!", "I sense that you've been marked by the elusive Artemis, correct, Nephew? She shies away from most of us, so if she's taken somewhat of a liking to you, great!", "Whenever Dionysus calls a feast, I'm turning up sooner or later, hear me, Nephew? So make room for one more blessing, and, let's go!", 'Little Hades, it appears that you are moving right along! Almost at an uncanny pace!! I wonder how you got to be so fast! Aquatic exercise?!', "Nephew, how is it you're navigating your cruel father's realm at such a blinding speed?! There's only one Olympian who moves that quick! Besides myself! Where is he, anyway?", "Why, little Hades, there's a certain chill about you, meaning you received an ice-cold blessing courtesy of Elder Goddess Demeter, correct? Now, personally, I think water's best in liquid form, but who am I to judge?", "You've come to know your Uncle Zeus, by now, correct? Just want to let you know, good Zeus gets very busy on the regular, so you just stick with me, I've always time for you, Nephew!", "Nephew, your cruel father, Hades, he's my elder brother, you know that? Not exactly the expressive type, and never was. We seldomly saw eye-to-eye on things!", "I daresay, little Hades, you've some spunk in you! Why, I think you take after me more than my crusty elder brother! You'll get away from that old codger yet!", "My crusty elder brother Hades must have tried to poison you against us lot! I can imagine it as clear as water, Nephew! I'm proud that you've resisted his undoubtedly most-twisted words!", 'Last time your father and I spoke, he told me I was all washed up, can you believe the nerve of it, Nephew? Why, he took the words right out of my mouth!', "It's likely, little Hades, that you currently reside just underneath one of my boundless seas! Normally you'd have to be submerged to use this power, but you know what, close enough!", "You know I've many vitally important things to do besides lending my aid to you repeatedly, Nephew? But, all of that can wait! Family comes first!", "If you should ever make it here, Nephew, know this! I shall be pleased to stand in for the father figure I can tell you never really had. We can engage in all sorts of aquatic competitions, solve riddles, visit the sea-nymphs! Oh, it would be great, wouldn't you think?", "Nephew, why, the seas up here, they're just about as widely feared as your vast Underworld down there! For water can be deadlier than bronze!", 'My oceans, they are filled with danger, not just water, little Hades! Many of the dead you face, they met their mortal end at sea, and not on land!', "Ahh, it seems to me you've had yourself a spot of lady trouble, lately, isn't that correct, Nephew? I mean the Fury down in Tartarus, of course! You going to let her keep on bossing you around?!", "Hah! I heard you showed that good-for-nothing Fury after all, I knew you'd handle that old crone, Nephew! And if she troubles you again, you just remind her who's in charge down there!", "Good tidings, Nephew! I've learned that you have managed to get all the way to Asphodel, fine work! Now, you just keep on going!", "Ohh, Nephew, you've stood against the Bull of Minos, have you? Well I must apologize for any inconvenience there, because, he was a living testament to my revenge! Long story, boring really, rather sordid, too. Stay strong!", "Word reaches us that you've come very far, indeed, Nephew! Striking distance from the surface! You just keep at it like that, and with our help, we'll have you out of there for sure!", "I wonder what monstrosities await you near the surface, little Hades? There's your father's terrifying hell-hound, for one thing! Ah, well, I'm sure you'll find a way to sail past whatever's in your way!", "Now don't lose heart, Nephew! Because in spite of all your efforts, it is probably the case that you still have a long and painful road ahead!", "Ah, I thought for certain you were well on your way out of there last time, Nephew! But, no matter, we'll just get you on another voyage to the top!", "Little Nephew, why, I could have sworn you made it to the surface recently, and yet, you're all the way back there, again? Must be some sort of terrible monstrosity preventing your way out!", "I'll tell you, Nephew, I was quite taken aback to learn Persephone, she was your mother all along! Just disappeared up here, one day! Ran off, I figured, as she's got some mortal blood in her. But she was with your father! That rascal is my brother, after all!", "So how is crusty old Hades faring down there of late, Nephew? Fewer worries there upon his brow? That Underworld of yours all running smoothly, and all that? We'll keep on pitching in from over here. Least we can do!", "Persephone, she says you're really stuck down there, born of the Underworld, something like that? Well, if you ask me, that's no kind of attitude to have! You can do anything you set your mind to, Nephew! Take it from me!", 'If you do ever get the opportunity to spend some time up here, Nephew, know I shall take you on a grand tour of the surface! From the depths of my seas to the height of Olympus! Sure, maybe not today, or tomorrow, or even the next aeon! But sometime, we should go!', "Been nice to see my brothers getting on again, just like old times! Well, not exactly like old times, and come to think of it, there always was a bit of tension there between those two, but still! It's better than before!", "Your good mother Persephone, she's here all safe and sound, thought you should know, there, little Hades! Shame you can't be here with her, too, but ah! Doubtless we'll someday meet again!", 'Ah-hah! I sense you have in your possession that fine shell I sent to you, a little gift plucked straight out of the sea! You keep it close so I can better track you down!', "My, my, little Hades, you brandish Exagryph, the Rail of Adamant! That weapon's power was so terrifying that we sealed it away. Oh well! Surely its mortal-damning secrets shall be safely guarded in your hands!", 'Huh! Why, if my eyes do not deceive me through those murky depths, you brandish Malphon! Let me tell you, little Hades, those old gloves have done some dirty work before your time!', "Why, little Hades, it is awful murky where you are, but if I'm not mistaken, and I never am, you wield fearsome Stygius! She once belonged to me, you know! Not quite my type, but we sure had our times! You take good care of her for me!", "Say, is it me, or do you bear your father's ancient spear, Nephew? I always wanted one a bit like that. And now I have one even better. Hah!", "This time, Nephew, let's really show your father what you're made of: Water! For the most part! Mortals, at least, are mostly made of it. Bet you did not know that!", 'The mortals like to give me thanks for all my generosity, Nephew! But little do they know, I have been saving up a bunch of it for you!', 'Say, word has reached me that you squared against one known as Theseus, now champion there in Elysium? He was a handful even when he lived! So much so that my honored brother Zeus, he took to calling him my son, can you believe the nerve?', "So, little Hades, doubtless you have seen that we upon Olympus also lend our favor to the mighty Theseus, who bars your passage from Elysium! Now, don't you take it personally, there, because our blessings go to all who deserve them. Although, we try to save the best for you!", "That scoundrel Theseus! Apparently he earned himself some sort of winsome prize, for all his blustering there in Elysium! So go do it, surely I'll get word!", "Why, Nephew, you've procured the Rod of Fishing, I detect! Fine handiwork if I say so myself! Good fortune with that thing!", "I'm told a number of the underwater denizens from my domain were captured fair-and-square through your surpassing skill using the Rod of Fishing, little Hades!! They're yours, I've millions more!", "All these river denizens you've caught, little Hades... it can only mean we share a deep connection, don't you think? I, with my power over the entire vastness of the seas! And you, with the power to ensnare a hapless fish with but a flick of the wrist!", "Say, what exactly is that very mighty-looking spear I think I faintly see in your possession there, it's... why, I've not seen a thing like that except on very distant shores! Then, come, let's make some waves!", 'Ahoy, little Hades, it is I! The greatest of your uncles! Here to aid you in your daringest escape attempt! I bet you have your hands full dealing with your enemies down there, so let me see what I can do. And I can do a lot!', "It seems you're getting somewhere, little Nephew! Good, but here, allow your favorite Uncle to bestow a little boost!", "Ah, hahaha! Found you down there, Nephew! Now let's overwhelm your enemies in a typhoon of godly might, what do you say?", 'Little Hades, have I ever told you I detest the dead? Well, I admit it, I just cannot stand a mortal past his due. Big Hades, he is disagreeable with all of us, not just with you, so, don't you take it personal, and stick with me!", "Looks like you could use the power of the sea, wouldn't you say so, little Hades? Good thing I'm here, so that together, we might wash your enemies away!", "Enough kidding around without me, Nephew! I am here, so let's go bust you out, much like a raging river through a frail little dam!", "You're looking somewhat stronger than before, there, little Nephew, but you're much too scrawny still, to be quite blunt. And break our enemies to pieces, like so many ships upon the shoals!", "I'll have you know, the power of the seas themselves is yours once more, Nephew! So how about you put it to its rightful purpose, and go smash some stuff!", 'Are you perchance in need of godlike aid, Nephew? Well, excellent! Because I happen to command the sea, and I shall hereby let you take it for a whirl!', "Who dares to mess with little Hades? You simply point me at them, Nephew, and we'll leave them shivering and sopping wet, you'll see!", "At last I found you once again, Nephew! You eating well and getting strong, correct? I'll help you with the latter category in a moment. Here!", "The awesome bounty of the sea is yours to do with as you please, Nephew! I've mustered forth a sample, anyway!", "Hoh, little Hades! I'd heard you were preparing to rain terrible destruction on your enemies! So I got here as quickly as I could! I'm not too late, am I?", "All of us must sail through troubled waters now and then, correct, Nephew? Fortunately, navigation is my speciality, so let's be on our way!", "Your victory's most certainly at hand now that I'm here, Nephew! So long as you make sure to take advantage of the absolutely awesome power I bequeath!", "Why, if it isn't the most favored of my nephews, stuck as ever though you may yet be! We'll get you from there, little Hades, don't despair, Uncle Poseidon's here!!", "Good tidings, my most favored nephew! All is relatively well, I hope? But hope alone is worthless without action, is it not? So here, let's act together!", "Just wait until you see the seas, Nephew! My underwater realm is the most glorious of the world's habitats. Come to wash away your troubles, here and now!', "Just point me toward your enemies, Nephew, and they'll become sworn enemies of mine!", "Let's get you out from underneath the sea, there, little Nephew!", "Ahoy, my godly Nephew, I've arrived, so set aside your worries and let's drench the dead!", 'How about we set you up here with some real water-power, little Hades?', 'I take it you could use some liquid courage at this time, no, little Hades?', 'How about a swim, there, little Hades? Why not!", 'If you are ever going to get out of there, only the mightiest of all my blessings will suffice!', 'My favorite Nephew ought have access to my greatest blessings, should he not?', 'Ah-hah! But I can teach you yet!', 'Betrayal, little Hades!! Of all my nephews, you should know better than this! Or perhaps I should. Let me remind you, then, the ocean can spit back!', "You wound me, little Hades, with your callous choice! It's fortunate I'm quite impervious to harm. Now remember this!', 'Sometimes I think, surely my nephew takes to heart my strongly worded threats about my distaste for his little acts of treachery, but no!', 'I could have sworn I told you never to take the power of the sea for granted, little Hades? Let us call all that unpleasantness back there water under the bridge, what say you, Nephew?", "My, a show of strength like that deserves a commendation I should think! Although, for next time, know my favor's not a thing to trifle with!", "All right, that's quite enough, I take it you have had about enough of that, correct? You're pretty good! So here, why don't you run along!", "Oh, hoh-hoh, you've got some fire in you, don't you, little Hades? Here! I've just the thing to cool you down, fresh from my own domain!", 'Ah-haha, my fits of anger come and go just like the tides, Nephew! Now take this from me, and get out of here!', "Now that was truly finely fought, indeed, Nephew! And I've a suitable reward here, just for you! Don't even know what I was mad about!", "What can I say, Nephew? Sometimes our tempers get the best of all of us. You're fortunate mine didn't get the best of you back there!", "You weathered the storm, there, little Hades, and the sea is once again at peace. A show of generosity from my most favored nephew! Your gift is mightily appreciated!! I'll just go ahead and add it to the pile.", "For all the times I'm offered gifts or sacrifices, little Nephew, I still always very much appreciate it! I mean, look! Not when I've the sea itself, to do with as I please!", "I thought I told you, Nephew, not to make such offerings to me? Ah, probably forgot! Though, between us, I don't like any one of them as much as you!", "Hohhh, but isn't this a kingly offering, indeed, my little Hades!
