Proud anyway, but you get the idea.", 'Who dares attack my nephew?!', 'You can do this, little Hades!!', 'Engulf them, Nephew!!', 'You got it, Nephew!', 'Of course, Nephew!', 'No problem whatsoever!', "It's time to make a splash!", "Harness the ocean's might!", 'Now ride the wave, Nephew!', 'Here comes some real water-power!', 'My tolerance has limits, little Hades.', 'Why, you tiny little gnat...!', "You're acting like a fool!", 'Who do you think you are!', 'You cannot treat your uncle like THIS!', 'You call for my aid, now?!', 'Have you no shame, Nephew?!', 'Oh, now you want my help?!', 'Ah, haha, how embarrassing!', 'I warn you not to trifle with me, Nephew!', "Oh you shouldn't have done that.", 'Next time, Nephew, best not be such a fool!', 'You disrespect the sea, and it is liable to swallow you!', 'Do not forget yourself with me next time, Nephew!', 'Good tidings, Nephew!', 'Smooth sailing, little Hades?', 'Ahoy, my nephew, it is I!', "Think you're going to like this!", 'Whaaat?', "Ah, hahahah! Excellently stated, venerable Goddess Demeter! I'm reminded once more of your vast experience, though, I think we all prefer our oceans liquidy, isn't that right, Nephew?!", "I have to tell you something, little Hades: My relatives and I, we've been holding back one of our greatest gifts!! To see if you were worthy. And you are! My aid is yours, so call me if you need anything! Especially to smash your enemies to bits.", "Nephew! I'm mightily impressed with your ability to cull those rivers there of all the denizens of my domain! Your crusty father's not entitled to the bounties of the sea! But, on my limitless authority, you are! You have my Rod of Fishing... now have this!"]

Title: Hades
Dialogues: ['How very thoughtful.', 'Why thank you.', 'How very gracious.', 'I shall remember this.', 'A thoughtful gesture.', "You're wise to side with me.", 'Let us wage war together, then.', 'A shrewd decision on your part.', 'Neutrality was not an option here.', 'Then, let us stand together.', 'I knew you would be sensible.', 'It shall be exactly as you say, Lord Father. Your wishes are identical to mine.', "Well, my hellborn kin, I have to say that there are times I wish I could have been acquainted with your father somewhat more, if you'll forgive my saying so. My father and my uncle, here... they're predisposed quite differently than I.", 'I wished only to speak to you in private once again, my kin, except, you see...', 'You interrupt me once again, dear sister. You know I do not care for that. I warn you to stay out of my affairs. I shall aid my kin as I see fit.', 'I so anticipate the day you finally arrive upon Olympus. There are few amongst us here with interests such as those I think we share.', 'Wars waged over love, my kin... can you imagine that? The lady Aphrodite and I can endlessly discuss such circumstances. I trust, from time to time, you stop to ask yourself how come you choose to fight. Not that you need a reason, of course.', 'Ah, my kin! I was just inquiring with Lord Dionysus here, under which circumstances are the greatest mortal feasts of all prepared? Because I have a certain hunch, regarding that...', 'The cold of death is quite becoming of the Goddess Demeter, do you not think so, my death-dealing kin? She is becoming well accustomed to it, too.', 'Ten thousand souls have fallen to you, now, my hellborn kin. I am rather beside myself, I must admit. Fine work.', "My, what is this, my kin? Some sort of invitation for me, I presume. Not just for me... this symbolizes all the others, here? Most intriguing. I shall investigate the meaning of this as quickly as I'm able, then. But first!", "I wish to tell you once again I had a splendid time during our recent shared festivities, my kin. At last, I've finally seen your death-filled realm firsthand! I learned a great deal. And I look forward to learning more from our successful collaboration, hm?", "Lord Zeus has gotten to you first, I see? My father's gifts are generous, indeed, though... I think I can help in my own way.", 'The blessing of your uncle Lord Poseidon might have helped you to this point, but here: My gift shall see you further still.', 'You bear the blessing of Athena, yes? She would protect you from your enemies, whilst I would rather that you slay them, and be done.', "Mm, I see you have the Lady Aphrodite's blessing there already. Love and death, together, hand in hand? Sounds most agreeable to me.", 'So Artemis, my lonely half-sister, got to you first? She merely helps you hunt, whilst I shall help you kill. Observe.', 'That drunkard Dionysus cannot help you near as much as I, my hell-born kin. Compare the gift he gave to what I offer you.', 'Our messenger Hermes has been in contact with you by now, yes? Perhaps you shall not see him very often, for my work keeps him rather preoccupied, shepherding souls and such.', 'I faintly sense the mark of Goddess Demeter upon you, hm? Her power over plentitude is opposite to mine in some respects. But, lately, she has channeled it in manners more agreeable to me.', "Ah, you bear your own father's blessing, my kin? Such a surprise... I know the two of you are now in league, and yet... I am still quite accustomed to the thought that you harbor war-like hatred for one another. Perhaps there's still a trace of that, though, hm?", 'Did you happen to know, my kin, that you have slain more than a hundred foes since you began your quest? You have! For I am keeping count. And I am most impressed.', 'You are a most impressive death-dealer, my kin. For by my estimation, you have slain at least a thousand souls down there! Souls mostly having died before, but still.', 'I know that you have many aspirations, my good kin. To be plain with you about my own motive for a moment: As long as you continue bringing swift and steady death, you shall have my unyielding support.', 'The more you slay your enemies, my kin, the stronger the bond between us, I think. Can you not feel it, too? Though, perhaps your lust for blood overpowers your other senses, hm?', 'Perhaps you know a god called Thanatos? The two of us are very close associates, you know. Do give him my best wishes, should you see him soon.', 'I trust that Thanatos is doing well? Although he brings to mortals merciful release, whilst I most certainly do no such thing, I do appreciate his take on it.', "It is my understanding that you have grown rather close with Thanatos, my kin? A perfect choice of mate; though I confess I'd not expected Death to have affection for another save himself.", 'You traveled rather far down there since last we met, my kin. And that means you have dealt incalculable death. I must commend you thus.', 'Ahh, my kin! I sensed fresh bloodshed from you recently, the real kind! For you have slain the living near the surface, have you not? Mere vermin, yes, but good enough for me.', "Recently, there was a burst of violence on the surface, near to where you are, but higher up. 'Twas altogether odd, but must have forced you to return once more. No matter; time is on our side.", "I sense so much death at the gates of your father's realm, of late, my kin. Now, I know that seems perfectly ordinary on the face of it, except... there's something more. I wonder if you know the reason why...", 'I know your efforts to come here have repeatedly been thwarted, my good kin. However, we have caused such violence in the intervening time, that we must take this as a real victory. Let us continue for however long it takes.', "Surely you've heard rumblings about a war which has erupted on the surface, here? Doubtless you've seen an influx of fallen mortals. It's quite a decent one, I have to say! Though, unlikely to rise to the ranks of the greats. Too few armies involved in it, I fear.", "War's such a wondrous thing, my kin. It solves so many different problems, whilst perpetuating its own inevitability. Let's keep it up, then, hm?", 'Do you ever think to yourself that you were born a bit too late, my kin? For my part, I wish that I could have been there myself when my father and the others waged ferocious war against the Titans. Ah, it must have been a sight!', 'I sense that you have forged a greater bond with your instruments of destruction there, my kin. Then that is very good. And may their altered forms serve you quite well.', 'Why, I believe that is the Frost Fair Blade you bear! I understand it shall become the instrument of choice of yet another god of war, someday. I long to meet him, this fellow student of death.', "Ah, that blade of yours... it looks as though it could relieve a mortal of his head with ease. Excalibur, is it? I've studied all the Fates' designs, and this one is among my favorites.", "The fated bow Sharanga, in your grasp! That is not a form I'd expected you to wield. You have exquisite taste in weaponry, my kin!", 'Is that the fire-eating shield of the great warrior Beowulf, which you have there? I knew the Fates had plans for it, but I did not expect for you to be a part!', 'Those are the gauntlets of the fated king Gilgamesh, are they not? A bringer of destruction, and an agent of the Fates. You are full of surprises, my kin!', "You bear the warring instrument of one called Lucifer, I see. I've little to go on about him, but it is clear he knows a thing or two about destruction, is it not?", "Ah, you bear the Blood-filled Vial which I granted you! The mortal's blood contained therein... I drew it myself! Too seldom am I able to become directly involved in such matters.", 'Know that I admire your Lord Father very much. For his grim work lets me continue mine. I trust that one day you shall settle your dispute.', 'You are the son of Night herself, they say? A fascinating character, ill-liked upon Olympus, although I myself have always longed to meet her.', 'Ah, my favorite Underworld death-dealer. I so look forward to the pain you shall inflict this time around.', 'Would that a sudden scourge of war would help you out of your predicament. Why, I would stir one up for you without a second thought.', 'Ah, my closest kin in all the Underworld, I see you there, I think! What sort of violence shall we sow together this time, you and I?', "There's so much insufferable talk of peace up here, my kin. It is quite the relief to focus on much more important things, with you.", 'You must know I often hunger for destruction, almost uncontrollably at that. Though I am finding you are able to sate that appetite of mine.', 'May all the death you bring become the stuff of legends told in fearful mortal whisperings around the world, my kin.', 'Would that I knew the goddess Nyx, myself, my kin! So many of my wars are waged by night. I am most grateful, and I wish her well.', 'How is your mother Nyx of late, my kin? Have you yet given to her my regards? For I should think that Night and War would share a common ground.', 'How is Nyx of late, my kin? Have you yet given to her my regards? For I should think that Night and War would share a common ground.', "Do tell your mother Night Herself that I am often thinking of her here, although we haven't met. She must believe that there are those upon Olympus who admire her.", 'Do tell Night Herself that I am often thinking of her here. She must believe that there are those upon Olympus who admire her.', "Perhaps once all of this is over, my good kin, you might arrange 'twixt myself and your dark mother, Nyx, some sort of chance to meet? Do think upon it, and declare to her my interest if you please.", "Perhaps once all of this is over, my good kin, you might arrange 'twixt myself and the goddess Nyx some sort of chance to meet? Do think upon it, and declare to her my interest if you please.", "Your mother Nyx and I, we have begun a correspondence, my good kin. I do appreciate you putting us in touch. She is a lovely specimen, if you don't mind my saying so, perhaps?", "The goddess Nyx and I, we have begun a correspondence, my good kin. I do appreciate you putting us in touch. She is a lovely specimen, if you don't mind my saying so, perhaps?", "You shall be pleased to hear that your own mother Nyx and I, why, we intend to meet. I'm quite excited to exchange ideas in the flesh.", "You shall be pleased to hear that Nyx and I, why, we intend to meet. I'm quite excited to exchange ideas in the flesh.", "Please send your mother Nyx my warm regards, won't you, my kin? Would that the others on Olympus knew and understood your kind as I now do.", "Please send the goddess Nyx my warm regards, won't you, my kin? Would that the others on Olympus knew and understood your kind as I now do.", 'You know, my kin, I had misunderstood that Nyx was your mother. But, Persephone? I never took her for the sort to have an interest in your realm. Alas that we never had opportunity to discuss the subject here.', 'Your good mother, Persephone... dread Queen of the Underworld! I certainly misjudged her when we had occasion to interact whilst she resided on Olympus. Perhaps I, too, should consider a life there in your realm...', "You bear Varatha, the Eternal Spear...! I thought it lost! Have you any idea how many lives it drank during your father's glory days?", 'Ah, you wield Coronacht, the Heart-Seeker. It pierced three Titans in one shot back in the war amongst our kind. Please do take care of it!', 'You have the Shield of Chaos, Aegis... quite unlike the one my good sister Athena likes to flash around. You have much better taste.', 'Why, you are wielding Exagryph, the Rail of Adamant! A most fascinating device. Imagine the new face of war, should its secrets someday be revealed, and spread to mortalkind!', "Well if it isn't Malphon, the Twin Fists, bound to your very capable hands! So many weapons are so indirect, I think. With Malphon, you are about as close to the destruction as can be.", "The greatest wars require great alliances, my kin. And so, I shall entrust to you some of the greatest methods of destruction I've devised thus far.", 'The winds of war blow fiercely on the surface now, my kin. Thus I am able to confer upon you even greater power than has been my custom.', 'You seem to be upon the verge of death, my kin. I cannot wait to hear of it! The experience of death, time after time! You are one of a kind!', 'Ah, my kin, but you have suffered terribly to come this far. No matter, for we soon shall pay your enemies in kind.', "So much letting of blood, so much of it, your own. Let's see to keeping you alive and in the fight a while longer, then.", "You're on the verge of yet another brush with death, I see, my hell-born kin. Do send some others down with you, would you?", "A mortal surely would have already succumbed to injuries such as the ones you've suffered, there. Impressive how you carry on, like that.", "You've got quite the fighting spirit in you there, I have to say. Most intriguing, and yet no surprise for someone born in hell itself. You come on out of there, and tell me all about it. I'm a fellow student of death, you see.", 'I must say you deal death rather exquisitely. Though, perhaps I could be of some further assistance in such matters, yes?', 'Ah! I figured that you must have been the source of all that bloodshed underneath the earth. Let me see if I can make your death-dealing a little more efficient.', 'Well, my hell-born kin, my blessing now is yours to do with as you wish; provided you inflict a little suffering for me?', "I've just the thing for you this time, my kin. May I present my instruments of pain?", "I surely hope your bloodshed's going well, and long that there shall be no end to it. I am, as ever, here to serve your benefit.", 'How fares your endless war against the dead? Let it be known that I am happy to take sides in such affairs. Please, I insist!', "Death rears its head in all too many forms, I'm sure you know. Though you may never find them all, I nonetheless encourage you to try.", 'The wretched dead you face perhaps forget themselves. Go, then, remind them of the agony which brought them to your realm.', "Life and death are inextricable, and war is often what connects the two. Don't you agree?", 'This world has a limitless capacity for pain; and so, it truly is no inconvenience to help you to bring out a little more.', 'The living and the dead alike desire what I represent. Their appetite for bloodshed cannot easily be sated. A goal to strive for, no?', 'Perhaps the dead you stand against have long forgotten the experience of anguish and despair. I trust that you shall soon remind them for me?', "Beautiful, isn't it? The strife which follows you. You have a real knack for this, and I for one am happy to assist.", 'Some would question the destruction which you sow, but I shall never do so. I fully understand your impulses. Allow me to indulge them.', 'Not once has your Lord Father thanked me for delivering vast portions of his clientele. Surely you shall be more grateful for my gifts.', 'Do you suppose the dead feel pain unlike the living? This is for me an endless fascination, so go on, and give me more to think about.', 'As you continue waging war against the dead, I gladly lend you my support; family to family, no questions asked.', 'It is a veritable crime your father distances himself from all the rest of us. It is fortunate that you yourself are not so disagreeable.', 'Let us together deal some death, shall we?', 'Shall we continue our campaign against the dead?', "What do you say we bring the dead some pain, for old time's sake?", 'The devastation you have caused has not escaped my notice!', 'We stand before a golden opportunity, to inflict pain. Let us proceed!', 'There is no problem war cannot sort out.', 'Ah there you are, my kin! I have a gift to aid your bloody work.', 'My blessing be with you, and may death follow in your wake.', 'Please spread some suffering down there for me, my kin.', 'I shall empower you to acts of greater violence than before.', "War needn't carry out solely above the earth, my kin.", 'I trust that the destruction which you sow is going well?', 'The recent devastation which you caused, that was impressive work.', "Whenever you bring death, why, you've my full support.", 'How fares the ceaseless slaying of your foes, quite well, my kin?', 'Perhaps my blessing shall let you deliver death still more efficiently.', "Your father's realm shall be quite full, I think, once you and I are through.", 'The finest instruments of death at my disposal shall be yours.', "I'd like to offer you a choice amongst my most exquisite tools which inflict suffering.", 'What say we start our next war with a special flair, my kin?', "I've not seen ample blood spilled recently, so let's please make up for lost time.", 'There are so many types of death... and yet, the sudden, violent kind is unsurpassed, I think.', 'I am quite eager to commence jointly killing your enemies, my kin.', 'What do you say we start another of our famous killing sprees, my kin?', "It's not been long since last I saw bloodshed... but far too long for me, nevertheless.", 'My finest implements of death I now avail to you, my worthy kin.', 'Let us make this blood-letting truly one to remember, then, hm?', 'May you sow such destruction as to shake this mountain to its core, my kin.', 'I shall now give to you the means to wreak such havoc there, my kin!', 'I was quite pleased to hear again from Nyx of late, my kin.', 'May the wondrous goddess Nyx continue to watch over you, and darken the eyes of your foes.', "To think you have the goddess Nyx's aid, as well as mine!", 'I knew that foul boatman would come through, and you would find amongst his wares this gift!', "I give to you this token of respect, buried though it must have been within the boatman's hoard.", 'I trust the river-boatman Charon has been keeping plenty busy lately thanks to me?', "The boatman Charon ought invest into a boat of more substantial size if he's to keep up with my work, my kin.", 'Your boatman there is a reliable deliverer of death, it seems. And that makes three of us, I think.', 'You reject my generous offering of aid? Hahahaha, you must not know me very well. Death shall come, regardless, either to your enemies, or you.', "You would deny such aid as I would offer you? How rather disappointing. You've more to learn about the art of dealing death, it seems.", 'An incorrect decision, there, my kin, to side against me thus. Blood needs be shed, and yours is going to suffice.', 'It seems unwise of you to thus dismiss my offering. Suffer, then, a while by my hand.', 'Your choice leaves much to be desired here, my kin. My temper I shall keep in check, but only barely so.', 'A disappointing choice, my kin, and there are consequences to such choices, every single time.', 'Your course of action here was ill-advised, my kin. For war shall come to you no matter what, as I shall presently reveal.', 'The whims of our kind are unpredictable, my kin. But you shall find responses to such acts to be the definition of consistency.', "I'll not abide such disregard of our past companionship, my kin. In war, one must take sides, and you had best choose mine.", 'War shall be waged here, no matter what, my kin. But even still, I am dismayed you would have sided against me.', 'You wish to have a taste of what a war against me would be like? Well, then, I shall oblige.', "Did I detect some hesitancy on your part just then? Perhaps you knew that you were making a mistake. No matter; you'll learn now.", 'You shall not goad me into anger with a petty insult such as this, you know. Nevertheless, there is a price which must be paid for it.', 'A sacrifice in blood is fully paid, and we are squared away. Though think you twice next time before you cross me, hm?', "Well haven't you withstood my murderous intent! Resilience as this deserves reward, and I am feeling rather generous.", 'It is not often I attempt to kill someone and they survive. Bravo! Our score is settled up for now, so let us carry on as friends.', 'You capably survived my wrath, and I commend you for it. Let us continue on, as friends and kin.', 'I think that we are squared away, for now. Though, do not test my patience further, hm?', "You crossed the fields of death impressively back there. Though, you are fortunate I'm in a giving mood.", 'When blood is spilled and death is dealt, I simply cannot remain discontented for too long.', 'What I could see of that display of violence you just sowed was thoroughly commendable, my kin. Then, here.', 'Your sacrifice to me just now has moved me to forgiveness for the time; thus shall we call a truce.', 'A war can only last so long, my kin. This one is not worth the pursuit, I think, when we can wage a greater one, together.', 'Ah, after a show of violence such as that, how can I possibly remain upset, my kin?', 'Your slight against me is already forgotten; for I was more than pleased to witness such a monstrous show of force.', 'You are a flatterer, my death-inflicting kin. And I am feeling generous, as well, so here! A small token for you of my affection.', 'Such a splendid offering, to me! How very thoughtful, there, my kin. I am taken aback, though I accept!', 'An offering, for me? Indeed! How gracious that you keep me in your thoughts. Know that, likewise, I keep you in mine.', "I do appreciate this gift to me, although you really shouldn't have! The suffering which you inflict is ample compensation in itself.", "Most often when I'm given offerings, it is with wishes that I lend my favor in a coming war. Yet from you, my kin, I sense no such motive. I'm quite taken aback by that, I must admit.", "You're most gracious with me, my kin; and I remain enthralled as ever by your blood-soaked way of life. I trust the violence I have wrought on your behalf has been quite satisfactory?", 'Ah, such an exquisite gift this is, indeed. Yet, the destruction you have sown, the sheer carnage... nothing can surpass that, I should think. Should you ever go to war, my kin... genuinely go to war, I mean... do look me up. I imagine I would take your side.', 'Pain and suffering upon you all!', 'Blood and death, together hand in hand!', 'Death and destruction!', 'Now I am angry.', 'Perish, all of you!', 'Behold the violence!', 'Suffer and die!', 'War is inevitable!', 'Whom do you take me for.', 'You test my patience.', 'Disgusting.', 'How dare you.', 'That was ill-advised.', 'A terrible mistake.', 'A foolish move.', "You must know mercy simply isn't in my nature.", 'What is a war without its tragic losses here and there?', 'It is unwise to side against me in a war.', 'Hail, my kin.', 'Greetings, fellow bringer of death and so on.', 'How is hell treating you today?', 'How fares your war against the dead?', 'Greetings, it is I.', 'This is for you.', 'Perhaps our skillsets once were meant for different purposes, dear Artemis; but who are we to doubt the end result? Observe what shall transpire once we grant our kin our combined might.', 'Why, my dear Artemis, the hunt is but a prelude to a war, is that not so? For if all mortalkind knew naught of hunting, why, they would not be nearly so adept at killing one another.', 'Mortals are so bent on clinging to their lives, that many among them would gladly kill for it. The surge of emotion which they feel... one passion is no different from another, Lady Aphrodite, dear.', 'Why, my Lord Dionysus! I fail to see why such discussion is perceived as unbecoming of a feast. A successfully conducted war is certainly a cause for celebration, is it not?', "Indeed, they have, good Uncle Poseidon. Mortals show great ingenuity when war is concerned; it drives their sense of progress, more than anything at all. Perhaps someday they shall wage war even in Father's skies.", "I do not question that your influence can stir a mortal's impulses toward war, O Goddess Demeter. At least we can agree that our domains are quite compatible!"]

Title: Hades
Dialogues: ['Ah yes, indeed.', "I'm grateful, Zagreus.", 'You have my gratitude.', 'How thoughtful, Zagreus.', 'Why thank you, little sprout.', 'Well done, my little sprout.', 'Reap what you sow!', 'Freeze to death!', 'Wither and die!', 'Ripe for harvest!', "Why, Foster-Brother Zeus! Such an unlikely bit of candor there, from you! Almost as though you felt compelled to speak the truth only whilst I'm directly within earshot.", 'I think that you forget yourself, Lord Ares, sir. For I am much your elder; my famines had already slain the mortals by the tens of thousands by the time such thoughts of doing so first crossed your mind.', "The mortals are resourceful, Artemis. Their one redeeming quality, perhaps! They'll find a way through our long winter here. They ought to, since they brought it on themselves.", "Oh, Aphrodite, dear... you wouldn't know a thing of substance if it offered you a cloak. Your chosen countenance makes plain the full extent of your intentions, and your interests alike.", "I daresay, my Lord Dionysus, that partaking of less wine for some amount of time might do you good. Regardless, you'll not coax a better crop from me.", "Oh, you needn't lavish me with your faint praise, Athena dear. In all your boundless intellect, I'd have expected you would know I see through your intentions, plain as day.", "If you're quite finished blathering, Poseidon, our young Zagreus has more important things to do. He needs your blessings, not your point of view. Don't you, young sprout?", "Well, now, young sprout, you've met the so-called King of the Olympians, and I. Whom do you now suppose is genuinely ruler of this snow-encrusted mountaintop of ours?", 'Ah, little sprout. I was just notifying Lord Poseidon here that all of his domain exists because it pleases me; remember, my good foster-brother, I could freeze your oceans solid if I chose.', "To think, young sprout, our strategist Athena, warrior-goddess, sprang from Zeus' head! I would expect that no high intellect could come from there.", "Young Zagreus, once you arrive, do tell Lord Ares here that his great power's not worth anything without my own. Wars have their causes, among which, many I control.", "Remember something for us, Zagreus. A frozen heart holds no sway over anyone at all. Isn't that right, oh Aphrodite, dear?", "Why, Zagreus, my gentle Artemis here was just saying how concerned she was for your predicament! I'm sure she'd like it if we both could help you in this case.", 'The crops shall wither and decay so long as I may please, young Zagreus. Although we do have those upon Olympus who take issue with my reasoning...', "I see the noble King of the Olympians has reached you prior to me, Zagreus. I wonder which of all his many lies he's told you last.", "My foster-brother's wayward son appears! I, too, once lost a child, Zagreus. I was quite foolish with her from the start. Her father was a baseborn farm-boy; worshiped me! He's gone as well, of course. Only the cold remains.", "My daughter to a baseborn farm-boy, she... why, little sprout, I wasn't very kind to her, I think. Certainly not once her father passed. It was her mortal blood that made her weak! Born to mortals, taken by mortals, I suspect. So now, they pay.", "I don't suppose... no, it is nothing, little sprout, it's just... I hear such wicked rumors now and then, about my daughter, lost to me, and what became of her. Kore, we called her, then. Persephone is what she called herself. Before she vanished utterly, leaving no trace....", 'After my daughter Kore disappeared, I left this mountaintop. Wandered the earth, in search. For naught, of course. It was a necessary journey, I suppose. May yours fare better.', "What's all of this, young Zagreus, a message of some sort, for me, indeed? I... can't decipher it, although... it bears the marks of my two foster-brothers here, and... well! It seems we'd better compare notes!", "Why, little sprout, young Zagreus... my grandson! I can scarce believe it, still! To think that, Kore, or... Persephone, my daughter... she had been with Foster-Brother Hades, all this time! A match I wouldn't have expected... or approved. That's why she left! Our blasted hearts do what they want.", "My little grandson, little sprout, I've thought... if my Persephone's alive, why then... this winter, hasn't it endured for long enough...? It's grown to have a certain stubbornness, but I... I am the goddess of the seasons, Zagreus. Perhaps it's time I changed them once again.", "I've lifted the cold from the earth, much as I said I would, grandson. But, near your father's realm... I have decided it shall stay the way it is. Bereft of warmth. As a reminder to us all, about all this.", 'You bear the blessing of Poseidon, Zagreus? Someday I shall remind him of his place, and freeze his watery domain entirely.', 'Athena has imparted you her wisdom, Zagreus? A simulacrum of the real thing, at any rate. True wisdom only comes with age, I think.', 'All of the love and beauty in the world can wither in a season, Zagreus. Remember that when next the goddess Aphrodite makes her promises.', "Lord Ares already got hold of you, has he? He's good at making mortals kill each other, yes. But he has utterly no knack for subtlety.", "The gentle Artemis already found you, Zagreus? She takes my orders well; one cannot blame her, for she'd have nothing to hunt if not for me.", 'You stumbled into Dionysus, Zagreus? One of these days I shall prevent his vineyards all from ripening; put to the test his carefree attitude.', "The mark of Chaos is upon you, isn't it? A force older than I! Yet one which you ought not trust so readily. No rhyme or reason to that one at all.", "Is that the bloodlike stain of pomegranate on you, Zagreus? A hardy fruit resistant to a winter's chill. How fascinating they survive, down there.", "I don't often divulge such blessings as I am about to, Zagreus. Don't thank me for it, but make certain that you use my power well.", "I have affection for you, little sprout. No need for reciprocity, but now I'll offer you the fiercest of my capabilities.", 'I must admit I have grown fond of you, young sprout; nevertheless, I shall not spoil you like some ill-mannered child.', "My, but you're as determined as my foster-brothers were, when my sisters and I stood with them 'gainst the Titans way back when.", "Our family, why, I think we understand something of loss, now, don't we, Zagreus? Unlike the mortals on the surface. Always begging me for plenty. They'll get none. But as for you, I have a plethora to offer!", 'You are entirely too young to have had meaningful experience with loss, young Zagreus. Pray to me that you never have to learn.', 'You live within the bosom of the earth, and know its warmth. But there is no such warmth up here, young Zagreus. You truly wish to feel the bitter cold of the outside? Then, here.', "Someday, you'll gain the surface, Zagreus; and you shall see firsthand what mortalkind has wrought. You'll find it has some commonality with your domain.", "Motherhood's a curse, young Zagreus. Be thankful you're immune. You sprang from Nyx herself, or so I hear? I sprang from Theia, whoever she was. And I once bore a child, too. Long gone. A mother's work... isn't it such a waste?", "Your father Hades and I share a common fate, each having lost a child fully grown; except that he's a hollow fool, whose child left! Whereas my daughter never would have. Ever!", 'Your father always had a sternness to him that his brothers lacked. Thought him a decent sort, comparatively anyway; though evidently he is no such thing.', "Should you achieve your goal, and see this surface-world, Zagreus, I've but one bit of knowledge to impart: Don't ever fall for mortals. Use them if you must, but do not waste your love on those who waste away.", 'I have a brother, Helios, the Sun. A nonsense-talker with a flaming chariot. Why, he once told me that my Kore, that she went into that Underworld of yours! Preposterous. The clouds now blot him out entirely.', "This land is not unlike your own in certain ways. For, Helios the Sun has not shone down upon it for some time. How long, I really couldn't tell you, little sprout! Long enough for mortals to take notice, certainly.", "My sisters Hestia and Hera surely would assist as well, young sprout. Except they and our foster-brothers haven't been getting along of late. Though as for me? I'll never leave this mountaintop of mine.", "We all are willful children, are we not? I'm daughter to Hyperion, you know; a Titan so obscure and hated that Lord Zeus, he started calling me his birth-sister, so much did he dislike this bit of truth! And to get a rise out of me, too.", "As seasons give to one another, so do generations, I suppose. Hyperion, my father? He'd not a one redeeming quality. My sisters and my foster-brothers and myself; this world owes us a debt for ridding it of him and his kind.", "I ought to warn you that my foster-brother Zeus, he has just a disgusting sense of humor, little sprout. He'd have you think he sired half the countryside! I have to shudder at the very thought.", "There's so much nonsense that the mortals say to one another of our family, Zagreus. How viciously the rumors spread! Whether from that oaf, Zeus, or likely from the mortal drunkard-poets with no better use of their limited time!", "I warn you, Zagreus, best not to make attempts to grow much closer with me, thus. I'm much your elder, after all, and you're my little sprout. What say we keep it that way, hm?", "I... I am so very moved, I... have a daughter once again. And... I've a grandson, too! I thought, I felt something when first I met you, but... I brushed it off. Just like a fleck of snow...", "Someday, my little sprout, you'll gain the surface of your father's realm, and see my handiwork. Until such time, I'll come to your aid as I can. It's quite the entertaining pastime, honestly!", "By the way, we had entirely a lovely time within your father's house, Grandson. And, to see Kore once again, it... warmed my heart. I'm beyond grateful that your mother's safe. And that you've an important job to do. Here, I shall help.", "I meant to tell you something, Grandson... you needn't have deceived the rest of us. You could have sent word that my daughter was with you down there, all along! Ah, but families are a complicated thing. Just swear that you'll be candid with us, next time.", "You must visit us sometime up here, Grandson! I understand the surface hasn't been agreeable with you... though perhaps if not in this age, then the next, we shall have you over. It's brisk up here... but nice enough, I think.", "Young sprout, I cannot fully understand my daughter's choices, such as what she saw in your gloom-filled father to have eloped with him. But if you are the result, then she is clearly wiser than I estimated.", 'I made mistakes raising your mother, sprout. When she was my Kore. I was blind to the possibility that she could have left me, but... I see it now. If you become a parent yourself, someday... may you listen more than I.', 'You tell my Kore... erm, Persephone, that is... the Queen! You tell her that her mother sends her warm regards. You tell her that. And you take care of her.', "Grandson, my daughter Queen Persephone, she sent me the most precious message, courtesy of Hermes, as of late. I'm pleased to hear that you are getting on all right. Though, I know you're at work, so here!", 'The Frostbitten Horn which you bear once overflowed. It holds a certain power still, of course. But never again shall mortalkind take it for granted.', "The heat has risen quite considerably there, is that not so? Then if my foster-brother's tampered with the temperature, I'll have to cool things off.", "The heat of your surroundings must be difficult to bear, my little sprout. It's fortunate I've just the thing for that.", 'That chill sensation I detect must indicate that you are near the surface, Zagreus. If you can overcome the final challenges ahead, you soon shall see the long winter yourself.', "That's Sister Hera's Heart-Seeker you have! The very weapon which she used to put our predecessors down. It hasn't lost its potency I see. Fear not, I shall not mention this to her, if I see her.", "Why, isn't that there Sister Hestia's oddly constructed armament you bear? She always was so predisposed to flame; I thought she'd never give it up! If it's to be in any hands, then may as well be yours.", "I scarcely can see... are those the Twin Fists that you bear, young sprout? I once made ample use of them myself, if you'll imagine it. Wielding the cold since has been adequate for me, but you? May you put them to work as I once did.", "Why, you've the look of one who has endured a terribly long winter, Zagreus! I trust you'll cling to life a little longer, now.", 'I sense your grip on life is coming loose, young Zagreus. Now turn that cold you feel against your enemies.', 'You seem to be in dire need of some assistance, Zagreus. I think perhaps I have a bit to spare.', "You're in the winter of your current stretch of life, aren't you, Zagreus? Do try and live a little longer for me, hm?", 'You waste away just like a common mortal, Zagreus. How rather unbecoming of a god.', 'The flame of life is easily extinguished by the cold, young Zagreus. Surely you feel the warmth within you giving way?', 'Cold comfort for your terrible predicament, young Zagreus, but I am here.', "I understand, young Zagreus, that you would seek to leave that bitter darkness for this bitter cold? Quite honestly I fail to see why. But I'll aid your plight, why not? For I can offer plenty of assistance, and you soon shall grow fond of it, I think.", 'I once had plentitudes of blessings I would offer readily, young Zagreus; but I am feeling not as generous of late.', 'Did you detect perhaps a certain spirit-shaking chill within the air, young Zagreus?', 'Plenty of blessings left to go around; although, only for you, young Zagreus.', 'Your enemies shall have no shelter from the cold whilst I am at your side, young Zagreus.', "There's something to the barrenness, where you reside; perhaps someday it shall be more like that up here.", "Your realm there is much like the wind-swept surface here. Mostly devoid of life, such as it's been of late.", "Olympus must seem like a distant paradise to you, young Zagreus; it is a frozen waste to me. But still, it's home.", "Your foes shall more than catch cold by the time we're through, don't you agree, young sprout?", 'All those who stand opposed to you, why, we shall shatter more than their resolve, I think, young Zagreus.', "One of these seasons I suppose I ought to double-check the mortals haven't gone extinct without my intervention at each step.", "None can endure an everlasting winter's chill, young Zagreus; not even your father's lifeless servants there beneath the earth.", "The seasons have a certain beauty to them, I suppose. Though struggle onward, and you needn't take my word for it.", "I've known your father and his brothers here for many seasons now; they bicker endlessly with me and one another.", 'I have to tell you something, little sprout. I take cold comfort knowing that my foster-brother Hades is no better at his parenting than I.', "I'd gladly scour all your father's realm if doing so would free you from his clutches, Zagreus.", "I'll have you know something, young Zagreus: The bitter cold and frost is just as inescapable as death itself.", 'The seasons turn relentlessly, without regard, and thusly should you doggedly push forward on your path.', 'I shall bring desolation upon those who wrong you, little sprout.', "I hope that you're aware how seldomly I give my blessing as of late, young Zagreus.", "There's no escaping from the bitter cold, you know.", 'Your adversaries soon shall know something of loss, I think.', 'Let us see to it your foes are left with nothing.', 'There shall be only souls for harvesting this day, I think, young Zagreus.', 'My warm regards, and all my blessings to you, little sprout.', 'The bitterness of cold and death go hand in hand, I do suppose.', 'When all is taken away, the cold yet remains, young Zagreus.', 'I am not feeling quite so generous of late, young Zagreus, but nevertheless: Choose.', "Your lifeless foes must foolishly believe they've nothing left to lose.", 'Go with my blessings, Zagreus; though you may take but one.', 'Decay is the inevitable state of things; we are merely helping it along.', 'The cold of Mount Olympus shall bring utter ruin on your enemies.', 'Death and cold, they are irrevocably bound together, Zagreus.', 'The climate in those depths needs cooling, then, I take it, Zagreus?', 'You bring with you the season of decay, young Zagreus.', 'Your foes shall all wither before you like unwatered crops.', 'The frost eventually shall cover everything, young Zagreus.', "You'll find that life gives way quite easily to cold, young sprout.", 'Look carefully upon my blessings, Zagreus, and take no more than one.', 'I trust that harvesting dead souls is not unlike the harvest we have on the surface, Zagreus.', "You're like a little flame there in your father's realm; easy enough to spot.", 'It seems to me your foes are ripe for harvesting, young Zagreus.', 'Any who stand against you soon shall wither from the cold, young sprout.', 'I seldom feel too generous of late, and yet for you, young Zagreus? Why not.', 'I once offered the mortals generosities as this in much more copious supply.', 'It soon shall be exceptionally cold down in the Underworld, I think.', "I'd never give out blessings such as this to merely anyone, I hope you know.", "I've quite the harvest here from which to choose, my little sprout.", 'Soon, the season there shall turn exceptionally cold, young Zagreus.', 'It is particularly cold outside, today; and soon it shall be so in there for you.', "Well, my little sprout, we shall have to get you through this winter's cold.", "A crisp and pleasant winter's evening to you, Zagreus; now, here.", 'My finest winter blessings to you, little sprout.', "Well, Grandson, it's growing rather cold, don't you agree?", "I'm here to ease some of your burdens, my young sprout. That's what we grandmothers are for.", "I trust you're keeping yourself warm enough in all of this, Grandson?", 'When all this is over, please do come and visit us sometime, Grandson.', "I'd tell you not to work too hard, Grandson, although your family is in need of more hard-working sorts.", "Foul weather's on the forecast for your foes, Grandson.", "Don't let my foster-brother bully you about, you hear, Grandson?", "Let's cool down that hot head of yours a bit, why don't we, Grandson?", 'My best regards to Queen Persephone and your lord father, little sprout. You keep it up.', 'I trust your mother Queen Persephone is faring well if she has as fine a son as you, young Zagreus.', 'Your mother sends you all her love from Mount Olympus, Grandson.', 'All the best from Queen Persephone, young sprout. She misses you, you know.', 'Persephone is doing well here on Olympus, Zagreus. You ought to visit, too, sometime.', 'Be thankful that the rivers to your realm have not yet frozen over, Zagreus.', 'I trust your ferry-boatman Charon has no qualms about the freezing temperatures up here?', 'My message comes to you by river-boat this time, young Zagreus. At least that Charon is amenable to our attempts to contact you.', "My blessing's seldom given and ought not be so readily refused, young Zagreus.", 'I am accustomed to such disrespect from all those blasted mortals, Zagreus, but you?', 'If you are so disinterested in my generosity, young Zagreus, then you shall have my wrath.', "I don't recall if I yet warned against this type of attitude, although it doesn't matter either way.", "Do you believe I give my blessings liberally, Zagreus? Well then I've news for you.", "Offend me, and I'll drain the last traces of color from those cheeks of yours.", "That was an ill-advised decision, Zagreus. I'm past quickly forgiving such mistakes.", 'You truly think you can withstand the ravages of winter, Zagreus? That I would like to see.', "A harsh winter is coming for you, Zagreus. And I'm afraid you've brought it on yourself.", 'For that decision, Zagreus, it is about to be a very cold day down there in your Underworld.', "A careless choice you've made, there, Zagreus. As you grow long in years, perhaps you shall learn better judgment as to whom to trust, and whom to never, ever disrespect.", "Perhaps you'll exercise more wisdom in such interactions moving forward, hm?", "It ultimately isn't my intent to leave you in the cold like this, young Zagreus.", "The freezing cold ought to have drained the life from you; but I've allowed it to relent, for now.", "Next time, young Zagreus, perhaps I'll take every last bit of warmth you've left down there.", 'I am the eldest of Olympus, Zagreus. And I expect for you to treat me suitably.', "The harsh of winter's gone for now, young Zagreus; and so take heart, but also you take heed.", "So you survived a little winter's chill, didn't you, there? Be careful, though; next season could be worse.", 'Remember, next time, Zagreus, that on my whim I can take everything from you.', 'I am quite capable of making your life plenty difficult, you do now realize, young Zagreus?', 'Perhaps a few more winter seasons such as that might teach you more of how this world works.', "Enough; I do not hold to grudges, Zagreus. You've my good graces, and my temper's cooled, for now.", "An offering well suited for the season, there, young Zagreus! In turn, as you are honorable and obedient, you'll have from me what the mortals have not.", 'I must acknowledge and accept your thoughtful gift of Nectar, Zagreus; would that the mortals showed deference thus.', 'A conscientious gift, my little sprout; and I am grateful for your generosity. A bit of Nectar cuts straight through the cold, I say.', "I was quite certain that the youth today was lacking any sort of tactfulness, young Zagreus. For once I'm thankful to be proven wrong.", "The everlasting winter means that Nectar's been in rather short supply; that you would think of me for such an offering is duly noted, then.", "You would make further offerings to me? Even though I have made quite clear I've lately not been at my charitable best, young Zagreus? You're either naive or you're much too kind, or both.", "Why, Grandson, how you honor me, with this... I am so very grateful that we've met, and that... you're you, if that makes any sense at all. I have my sisters, but... I'd no one else, for very long, indeed.", "Beware of winter's cold!", 'A wasteland void of life!', 'All shall soon decay!', 'I shall take everything away!', 'They shall have nothing!', 'No comfort from the bitter cold!', 'You beg my favor now?!', 'The limitless audacity of youth!', 'Shiver and rot, for all I care!', 'I have no tolerance for disrespect.', 'I warned you not to side against me, little sprout.', 'Respect your elders next time, Zagreus.', 'My greetings to you, little sprout.', 'I greet you, Zagreus.', 'Hello, young Zagreus.', "A winter's greeting to you, Zagreus.", 'Oh truly?']

Title: Hades
Dialogues: ['Hey thanks!', "You're very kind.", "I'm grateful.", 'Thank you for this.', 'Bless you Zagreus.', "I won't forget this.", 'How nice of you.', 'You chose correctly, Zagreus!', 'Right on the mark!', 'Not much of a choice, admittedly!', "I'd say you made the right decision there!", "Uh-oh, somebody's going to be upset!", "Ah good, you didn't make me mad this time!", 'Yes, Zagreus, in spite of all these perfect, chiseled prospects everywhere about, yearning to marry or embarrass me, for some reason, I prefer to spend my time mostly alone or with my nymph friends in the woods!', 'Tsk, um, Zagreus... rather than greet you as I normally would do, instead, allow me to present you my illustrious, kind, generous lord father, your greatest Uncle Zeus!', "You know my father and my uncle, by now, right, Zagreus? Great!", "Have to say, I had a pretty decent time with everybody at our little visit recently! Met you, Uncle Hades, even great Achilles! Still don't quite appreciate you tricking us, but eh! Look at you, you're hurt there pretty bad, but, just stay focused on the hunt, and it'll help to keep the pain at bay.", "Look, I'm just goddess of the hunt, not medicine, so... Should make for easy targets, right?', "I've never come across a target I couldn't take down. I expect the same of you, you hear me? Hopefully you hear me.", 'Good hunting, Zagreus! The sooner you get out of there the sooner you can save me from my insufferable relatives. Please?', "Hey, Zagreus, good luck out there, this time. I'd tell you 'may your aim be true' but I can guarantee it, actually.", "The hunt requires utter concentration, so, I'll leave you to it, and... just watch your every move in silence over here...", "You want to make it out of there, you... don't have to listen to a word I say, to be quite honest, but... my huntress blessings ought to help.", 'Well, Zagreus, you getting out of there this time, or am I going to have to keep on hunting by myself for the time being? Probably?', "Looks to me like you could use a little help, so I'll just have a look in my big bag of blessings here, and, oh! Here's just the thing.", 'The hunt comes down to kill-or-be-killed. Except for us immortals, who have to live with our shame, which is worse?', "Those wretched things harassing you throughout that Underworld just won't give up, will they? Well, just keep killing them, I guess!", "Need a hunting partner, Zagreus? Not that I'm able to join you myself down there, or even hear you respond for that matter, but, anyway, here.", "Zagreus, it's me! I'm here to join the hunt with you again. Let's show them what we can do.", "Hello again, you ready for this hunt? Me, I've been looking forward since last time, so, let's get on with it.", 'Stay on your guard, tread lightly, and all that.', "Keep a sharp eye out there, won't you?", 'Good hunting down there, Zagreus.', 'What are you hunting this time, I wonder.', "I'll be looking out for you. If you don't mind of course.", 'Remember, Zagreus, kill-or-be-killed.', 'How about I join you for this hunt, OK?', 'Hey, you take care of yourself, all right?', 'Got you something I bet you could use.', "The finer points of hunting are not easy to communicate, though you're learning from experience, at least!", 'My senses sure are going to be sharp if I keep trying to keep up with you like this in all that dark down there.', 'A good, clean shot is all it takes, most of the time!', 'You getting anywhere down there yet, Zagreus?', "What are you waiting for, let's get to hunting, then!", "Not much of a hunt when your prey knows exactly where you are, but it'll do!", 'I hope your every strike cuts to the vital bits of all your prey, there, Zagreus.', 'I brought some hunting gear for you to try, if you could give me your attention, Zagreus?', 'All right, Zagreus, catch your breath, decide, and then what say we get you out of hell maybe?', "What are we hunting this time, Zagreus? Don't tell me wretched dead, again?", 'You see how easily I tracked you down? Unless you went out of your way for me, that is?', "I have a Boon for you, here, Zagreus, though just be sure you don't embarrass me.", 'Well, perfect timing, Zagreus, now stock up and head out.', 'You want to make it out of there, my Boons are just about the only way to go.', "Don't you let your father or let anybody push you around, Zagreus.", "Bet I can help you break out of your father's realm in no time, Zagreus!", 'Decided I would pack you something extra for this hunt, if you can handle it!', 'Enough toying around with our prey, there, Zagreus. What do you say we finish it, this time?', 'I know it must be such a struggle for you, Zagreus, so here! In case this helps.', 'A great hunter ought to have great tools, Zagreus, so here! Please allow me.', "Wish I could hunt with you myself, but here's the next best thing, all right?", "You know how long it took Callisto to become a master of the hunt? I'm sure you can still learn a thing or two!", 'I was about to head out with Callisto for a hunt, though I can spare you a quick Boon, I guess!', "I have to meet Callisto soon, but it won't take me but a moment here to get you on your way!", "Someday perhaps you'll join me and Callisto for a hunt! But as for now...", 'Greetings to you from the forest! Callisto and the woodland nymphs say hi!', "You'd make a real asset on the hunt, I think. Not that Callisto and I need assistance, though.", "You know, one thing I'll say for Charon there? He doesn't talk too much. And since neither do you, I'm letting you have this.", "I guess this means you must have paid the boatman's ransom here, and whatever price he charged you, it was worth it.", "Even there in your Underworld, it seems quality hunting gear doesn't come cheap, apparently!", "If you're quite done with shopping, Zagreus, what say we cut straight to the chase from here?", "You hunted down a real bargain there in Charon's shop, though how about we try a slightly bigger deal on for size right now?", 'Why would you side with...?! Ugh, why do I even bother with some lesser god!', "I thought we had an understanding, Zagreus. But, this wouldn't be the first time I was wrong about someone.", "Huh, so that's your choice! Maybe you're more like my relatives than I'd care to admit.", "Good shot, there, Zagreus! I guess you got me. Now why don't you go take a shot at this.", "Don't be messing with my feelings, Zagreus. My loyalty's hard-won, and quickly lost.", "You really missed an easy shot, here, Zagreus. But I will not. You'll see.", 'Ah, good! Just when I had almost forgotten what an arrow to the back felt like!', 'Am I some kind of pushover to you, Zagreus? Is that what you think?', "Oh, look, turns out it's time for target practice once again! Start running, Zagreus.", "What made you think I'd stand for this, from you?", "Ah-hah, I knew you'd pull this old maneuver, Zagreus. And I am ready for you, now.", "You're getting quite predictable when you betray me like this, Zagreus! Start running, then.", "Oh really, that's the way it's going to be? You Underworld gods are all alike!", "Fine, I'm not angry anymore, not really anyway, but you just watch yourself with me, you got it?", "Oh you're still there I see. Well then, all right, let's call it even for the moment and get on with this.", "All right, all right, I'm going to forgive you now I guess, no need to beg, you just think twice next time OK?", "Got to say you handled yourself pretty well back there. I can't stay mad after a show like that.", "Good hunting just now, Zagreus. You passed my little test, so now we're good, just like it never happened.", 'So you survived, so what. Here, why not take a Boon, and then be off?', "I will admit mistakes were made back there, so you just don't make them again, next time all right?", 'You know what, I decided not to kill you, Zagreus. No sport in cornered prey, so here, get on with it.', "Good thing you're nowhere near our mountaintop or I'd have shot you for that stunt, myself.", "Well, Zagreus, it turns out you need all the help that you can get, so here's a pity Boon for you!", "I could keep hunting you until you're dead, but there's too little meat on you to make it worth my while.", "Hey thank you for this, really. And, I've just the thing to offer in return. It's just a gift, OK?", "Hey wait, this is an offering, for me? I, oh, that's very kind, though, let's get back to hunting, now, OK?", "Look, Zagreus, I don't know what to say, except for... thanks!", "You're being very nice to me, and that makes me suspicious, understand? So, you want more of that... you keep this up.", "What do you know, another gift of Nectar, that's... quite thoughtful of you, Zagreus! Normally don't care much for the stuff, but, every now and then, I mean... why not?", 'Look, I like being worshiped just as much as anybody, Zagreus, though bear in mind that you can always leave the worship of me to the forest nymphs, all right?', "I never felt like I could be myself with everybody on this mountaintop, you know? So much posturing, and bickering, and... I just head out to the woods most of the time. Maybe you understand me better than the rest, I've no idea still. But I appreciate you've made attempts to try.", 'Nowhere to hide from me!', 'Picked up their scent!', "I'll take care of this!", 'Oh hi remember me?', 'I have them in my sights!', 'I hear you, firing!', 'They are as good as dead!', 'All right, taking the shot!', 'How dare you.', 'What is the matter with you.', 'What are you doing?', "I can't believe this.", 'Is this some sort of joke?', "Sure, I don't see why not!", 'Oh let me get right on it, Zagreus!', "Pray I don't accidentally miss my mark!", "You may be good at running, Zagreus, but you're bad at hiding.", "You make me mad, I'll hunt you like a stag. You heard of those?", "Don't anger me next time, won't shoot you dead, is it a deal?", 'How goes it, Zagreus?', "Hey it's me again.", 'Care to hunt with me?', "Glad you're still in one piece.", "Now here's something for you.", "Social graces, she says! Going about like that! I'm sure you know that I can find you when it's necessary, Zagreus. Though, how to get away from Aphrodite, I have no idea.", "That's right, Lord Dionysus, a hunt! Which requires lots and lots of total quiet, and clear-minded focus. So, if you'll excuse me?", "Um, hello, Zagreus... Athena here is grandstanding or trying to prove a point, or something. I don't know. Anyway, nice talking to you.", "Oh, and wouldn't that be such a pity, Uncle Poseidon. I wonder what could be the cause of this sour look that I perpetually have up here? Maybe Zagreus knows.", "Concerned? I don't see anyone concerned, you have this, Zagreus! You don't need anybody's help, and you can get through this all on your own, though just in case, and I mean just in case! Um, here."]

Title: Hades
Dialogues: ['I am most grateful.', 'I thank you, Cousin.', 'How thoughtful, Zagreus.', 'You are most generous.', 'You honor me.', 'Thank you, Zagreus.', 'Wisely decided, Cousin.', 'A strategic choice.', 'Correct decision, Zagreus.', 'I trusted I could count on you.', 'No pleasing all upon Olympus, I suppose.', "Lord Father, would that I could settle even more such matters quickly and discreetly, so that only the most vital of them rise up to the level of your notice, sir. Though, I'm certain Zagreus and I are very grateful you have intervened.", '...Except you see, dear Cousin, that some members of our family are predisposed toward the unspeakable. I caution you around my half-brother, is all. Now carry on.', 'You only do as you see fit, Lord Ares. Mind that you continue pulling in the same direction as us all.', "I wonder, dearest Aphrodite, whether you'd be willing to repeat such things directly to my countenance?", "I'm glad we understand each other, then. It would be most embarrassing to be caught bickering amongst ourselves in front of Zagreus.", 'Perhaps Lord Dionysus here is the true god of strategy, as it appears he is uncannily aware of my next move, Cousin. Although, be that as it may, I shall attempt to remain focused on your situation. Not his feast.', "Noble cousin, my lord father has taken keen interest in your journey and your plight, and now seeks to aid you with the thunder of heaven itself. And you've my support, as well, of course.", 'When I first notified Lord Father Zeus and other members of our family of your existence, Zagreus, it was Uncle Poseidon here who first leapt up, and pledged his power over sea and earth to you. Is that not so, Uncle?', 'Your predicament has pulled our family together, united in a desire to assist you, Cousin. Even those who typically do not think much of those other than themselves.', 'The world is not all lies and deceit as you make it out to be, Aphrodite. Sometimes, a lending of assistance is no more than it appears to be. Now either back up Zagreus, or stand aside.', "If you've a moment, Zagreus? One of my relatives has claimed that I usurp your time. So I invited her to contact you.", "Well, I suppose that's settled, then. I am afraid such interactions aren't uncommon here amongst my family; but what's a family without flaws?", 'Some members of our family do not yet fully understand just how precarious your situation is, Cousin. My Lord Dionysus here, he goes about as though this is a festive matter of some sort!', "I bring to you the Lady Demeter, Cousin. I've asked that she please rest assured knowing we have your matter well under control. Though, in her infinite compassion, she has taken up your cause, nevertheless!", 'The biting cold surrounding you must mean the Goddess of Seasons decided to take an interest in your struggle, Zagreus? I did not count on Demeter being a part of this. Take heart, though use discretion around her.', 'Is this some kind of offering for me? No, hold a moment, this appears to be a message! Part of one. Then, can this mean...? I have to notify the others. I trust they also have received something from you, or shortly shall.', "It was my privilege to have visited your father's House, and briefly had a chance to meet you, Zagreus. Nyx and your mother each are very shrewd; perhaps you've taken after both of them. As for your new responsibilities... exposing weak points in defenses is my specialty.", "I understand you've been in contact with my father. Your uncle Zeus, I mean. He's taken interest in your plight; you should feel honored!", "You've met the master of the seas, Poseidon, haven't you? Our uncle's affable but quick to anger. Be on your guard with him, is my advice.", "Cousin, you've met Aphrodite, no? She likes beguiling others with her charms; but her intentions with you I believe are pure. You'll find our strengths are complementary.", "My warlike brother Ares reached you, didn't he. I've always found his conduct quite disturbing. At least it seems he's helping you for now.", "I'll tell you something, Cousin: If even Artemis is aiding you, it's proof your cause is just. She doesn't often take an interest in family affairs.", "Did Dionysus truly visit you before? He tends to seek out revelry, not conflict. I'm pleased to know he's making himself useful here.", "You arrived sooner than anticipated, Cousin, and my estimations seldom are inaccurate. All for the best, of course. Perhaps you're simply faster than I thought.", 'Zagreus, perhaps it is a fancy of imagination, but it seems almost as though, this time, you bear the blessing of... your own father! If Lord Hades is assisting you in any way in this, then I shall hold out hope that your relationship yet has capacity to heal, to some extent at least.', "So you've another blessing from Lord Hades, then. Zagreus, I'm under no delusion you and your father shall become the closest friends, from here. Neverthless, I do believe it's possible to move forward even such a relationship as yours. Believe me... I know.", "I so look forward to our meeting face to face amongst the gods, dear Cousin. Olympus shall be merrier and wiser once you're here.", 'Hail and good tidings to you, noble Cousin. May you be swift and thorough vanquishing the dead who dare oppose you.', 'Remain relentless in your effort to escape, dear Cousin. In spite of all our differences, perseverance is a quality we all possess.', 'You can always count upon assistance from me, Zagreus. I always shall prioritize the needs of our family above everything else.', 'Let my voice be a glimmer in the darkness, noble Cousin; though, may the blessing I am about to provide be even more than that.', "You've met your distant relatives by now. We don't all share the same demeanor, nor see eye to eye. Though, all of us, I think, wish you the best.", 'The one called Nyx... she is your mother, as I understand? We Olympians rarely consort with the chthonic gods. Though Nyx herself reached out to me about your plight, and I was spurred to act.', 'Please send the goddess Nyx my kind regards. That she supports you in your effort to escape her own domain suggests a selflessness I would not have expected.', "It's such a cruelty that your father hid the knowledge of your birth and life from us, my cousin. It's unacceptable.", 'Your father Hades and my father Zeus have not communicated in some time, and Zeus refuses to explain. Something transpired between the two of them. Perhaps you know better than I.', "There's something that I've wished to tell you, Zagreus: There is no shame in your upbringing. Many of us on Olympus, we likewise were born and raised under the strangest circumstances. Someday I'll have to tell you about mine.", "You're nothing like your father, Zagreus. I mean that as a compliment. He cut himself off from the rest of us. Many times have we attempted peace, to no avail.", "It comforts me to see how far you've come, Cousin. And I am confident that you shall make your way, eventually. I shall look forward to our conversations then.", 'You reached the flames of Asphodel, well done! You may have quite a distance still to go, but having crossed through Tartarus is no small step, Cousin.', "I see you've made it all the way to hallowed Elysium, Cousin? A significant way toward the surface, and if you could get there the one time, surely you have what it takes to do it again, and overcome the dangers that await therein.", 'I understand you nearly reached the surface lately, Zagreus. My confidence remains unshaken that you shall get out of there, eventually. No matter what sorts of unknown horrors lie shrouded beyond the boundary there.', 'Were you not close to having reached the surface lately, Cousin? Then, this can only mean some unforeseen impediment prevented your escape.', 'There must be some unconquerable force or foe awaiting you, just at the border of your realm and ours. We cannot even see it through a shroud of darkness, there. I shall make certain that your family knows it may take considerable time to surpass... so fear not, for we are patient, here.', "Despite whatever difficulties you've encountered, dear Cousin, again and again, you have never yielded. I must admit, your strength of will is quite inspiring. For, even I have doubts, from time to time. It's all the clearer to me why the goddess Nyx spoke so highly of you.", "It's fortunate your troubles with your mother were resolved. Persephone, I mean! To think I led all of my family to believe your mother was the goddess Nyx, instead. It seems I was an unwitting accomplice to a bit of a deception, there. But Nyx, I know she merely tried to help.", 'You bear my Owl Pendant, noble Cousin! Wherever it should go, I faintly see its shimmer from afar. Even where you reside! For owls see in total darkness, after all.', "I have grown closer than expected with the goddess Nyx in all of this, Cousin. It is quite evident to me how much she cares for you. I must admit I envy your relationship, sometimes. For I've made do without a mother's presence in my life.", 'Lord Ares has suggested he and goddess Nyx have grown much closer to each other, in all this. Nothing untoward, if you must know. Ares and I have often disagreed, about so many things, and yet we share a fondness for the Night herself, it seems.', 'Sometimes I think about the goddess Nyx, and how I long for her to be the mother that I never had, Cousin. Is it improper that I say such things to you? One would expect I would already have somebody on Olympus, yet... it often feels as though I am the mother, here.', "The goddess Nyx has indicated you possess a list of prophecies from the Three Fates. I've such a list upon Olympus, here! It seems to be connected to your own, as several prophecies already are fulfilled. Isn't it such an honor to urge Fate along?", "You cannot withstand your father's legions, Zagreus. But if you possess one of my greatest blessings, things may unfold differently, I think.", 'Dear Cousin, would that I could give to you everlasting, tireless resolve. Though, come to think of it, this may be suited as a counterpart.', "Supporting you through your ordeal, Cousin? It's reminiscent of the thrill of doing battle by the side of those whom I hold dear. I may be safe upon our mountaintop, though I am with you there, as well... for every well-earned victory, and bitter loss.", "You brandish the Eternal Spear we call Varatha...! So then it wasn't lost during the war. A magnificent weapon, in deserving hands.", 'Why, you wield Coronacht the Heart-Seeker...! I never took you for an archer, though the power of that bow is undeniable. Use it wisely!', "You bear Aegis, the original itself...! My own shield was forged much later, in its image. You'll have to tell me someday how you found it.", 'You got your hands on Malphon, the Twin Fists, I see. No ordinary weapon. Prone to fits of savagery quite unbecoming of a well-trained warrior. Then watch yourself, and throw not caution to the wind.', 'The Rail of Adamant, itself, has found its way into your hands, Cousin? A malignant thing, if you were to ask me, and not one I would ever use, myself. Unless, perhaps, I had no other choice. I suppose it must have been that way for you.', "You're badly injured aren't you, Cousin? I wish that I could will the pain away, though at the least I can provide you this.", "Look at you, Zagreus, you're barely fit to fight from all the injury that you've sustained! I'll try to keep you going for as long as possible.", "It seems to me that you've sustained life-draining injuries already, Zagreus. But don't lose hope. We can sustain you in a proper fighting shape.", 'You may have suffered many wounds but shall not perish imminently, Cousin. Not if I have anything to say about it. Here.', "Oh, Zagreus... your recent battles evidently haven't gone as hoped. Nevertheless, always strive onward, while you still draw breath.", 'For you, my cousin Zagreus, I wish to offer the most potent of the blessings I am able to bestow. Make wise your use of this, and rise toward us!', 'The circumstances spur me now to offer you the greatest of my powers, Cousin. Take my strength, and strike the darkness down!', "Hail, noble Cousin. Now, let's get you from that miserable place. I'll see that all of us upon Olympus do our part, beginning here with me.", "Keep fighting, Cousin. Fight from out of that eternal gloom. I trust that you'll be joining us upon Olympus shortly.", 'I have your back, Cousin. Rise now to your rightful station with my blessings!', "May the light and fury of Olympus guide you from the dark, Cousin. I've a token of it for you here.", 'Push forward, noble Cousin. I shall be keen to see you circumvent the perils that the Fates arranged for you this time.', 'Vanquish all who stand against you, noble Cousin. I and your relatives upon Olympus shall assist you in so doing.', "Sometimes I think about what you've endured, to have been living in that loathsome squalor, Cousin. I swear, you'll have your justice.", "Do not fear your father's cruel legions, Cousin! Their lives are long since forfeit, and they cannot stand against one of your birthright, nor against my power.", 'Yours is a brazen plan of action, Zagreus, and I admire it. The boldest strategy often prevails. Especially with my support.', 'Take heart, Cousin; for you have found me even in the suffocating darkness of the Underworld. May my power be of some assistance.', 'Your struggles have not gone unnoticed, Cousin, so take heart. Eternity awaits you once you finally break free.', 'Here on Olympus is the opposite of everything about that lifeless squalor you reside in, Zagreus. Fight on and come to us!', 'Cousin, I grow angry merely thinking of your situation. May what power I can offer be of service as you struggle towards your fate.', 'Your father chose to sever ties with all of us, and stew alone within his land beneath the earth. But you are not beholden to his actions. Fight!', 'Your labors make you stronger, noble Cousin. And, the blessings I now offer ought to make you stronger still.', "I've found you once again, dear Cousin, and my strength is yours; so much of it as I can send there to the bowels of the earth.", "I'm here again to lend to you my power, noble Cousin. Though your own strength of will is how you'll finally break free of that cruel place.", "I'm pleased to see your father's stubbornness is manifest in you as such determination, Zagreus. My blessing be with you.", 'What wretched fools dare stand against you, Cousin? Punish them, so that they learn something they ought have learned in life.', 'Hold fast to your resolve, Cousin, and climb on toward the surface. No matter how often your foothold falters, I am here.', 'I shall not keep you, Zagreus, except to offer you some of my power to improve your chances of escape. Now quickly choose, and go.', 'May wisdom and good fortune guide you toward the light of day this time, Cousin.', "The Underworld's wretched dead shall fear you yet, Cousin.", 'Strength and wisdom guide you from the darkness, Zagreus.', 'The low cunning of your lifeless enemies is not a match for your divine might.', 'Remember I am always watching over you, dear Cousin.', "You'll have your justice in due course, Cousin. I promise you.", 'The might and fury of Olympus courses through you, noble Cousin.', "I take it you've a plan in mind this time for how you're going to escape, don't you, Cousin?", 'I shall not keep you, Zagreus, except to offer you my power to improve your chances of escape.', 'Remain relentless in your effort, Zagreus. For perseverance is a quality we all possess.', 'I and your family on Olympus all stand ready to support you in your efforts, noble Cousin.', 'Remember, doubt and hesitancy are your real enemies, Cousin.', 'I know that you are more than capable even without my power, Cousin. But just in case...', 'Envision your success, and choose the means by which you shall achieve it, Zagreus.', 'I shall not offer empty words, dear Cousin; I shall instead offer you this.', "With our ferocity combined, Cousin, what chances do your father's forces even have?", 'My support alone is not enough to see you through this, Zagreus; but it certainly shall help.', 'Your foes shall soon find it impossible to overcome your strength, combined with mine.', "I've every confidence that you shall imminently put my blessing to good use.", 'Let not your sense of purpose waver, Zagreus. Visualize the outcome you desire.', 'Make not the same mistake twice, and you shall always grow wiser, no matter what else.', 'I shall do everything within my power to defend you from the perils of your journey, Zagreus.', "Take heed against your father's legions, Zagreus. And take also my power.", 'Do not forget that changing strategy can be the key to victory, Cousin.', 'I cannot glean the details of your predicament right now, Cousin. Though maybe this shall help.', 'The might and honor of Olympus shield you against the darkness and the dead, Zagreus.', 'I take it having an impenetrable defense against your enemies may be of some use, Cousin?', "I'm not in any mood to trifle with your father's nonsense this time, Zagreus. So, use this.", 'These are among the mightest defenses I can offer, Zagreus. Choose wisely, then.', "I've readied several of my most potent blessings so your victory can be achieved, Cousin.", 'Observe, dear Cousin, for this time I offer you uncommonly superior protection.', "It feels unseemly to make contact from that most-unpleasant boatman's stash of ill-gotten wares. Nonetheless, this was an opportunity.", "You're difficult to track there in the depths, Cousin; though, the boatman Charon thankfully is proving of some help.", "The river-boatman Charon is beholden to your father's realm, but seems agreeable enough, for a fair price.", "A shrewd expenditure of wealth is sometimes all that stands between a victory and sore defeat, isn't that right, Cousin?", "We cannot effectively communicate with Charon from Olympus, but he is amenable to certain trades, and seems unfettered by your father's influence.", 'I thought we were on better terms, Cousin. I ask only for your cooperation, yet still you turn your back...?', "I'm disappointed you would spurn me like this, Cousin. Know that I retaliate not out of spite, but by necessity.", "You'd choose one of my relatives, instead of me...? Though I myself was first to contact you? Alas, I must respond to you in kind.", "Upon Olympus, I'm your closest confidant. You'd best remember this before you spurn me again.", 'We Olympians, we are a prideful family, Cousin. You cannot simply choose a favorite without spurring one of us to wrath.', "I understand you've made your choice, Cousin. And I, in turn, now have my family's reputation to uphold.", 'If you had given due consideration to this matter, then I doubt you would have chosen this outcome.', 'No one in our family can avoid taking sides forever, Zagreus. But you can take the more sensible side, at least.', 'A senseless, punishable choice. But if you wish to face the consequences, so be it.', 'You could have avoided this outcome any number of ways, yet still you risk incurring my wrath.', 'Are you testing the limits of my patience with you, Zagreus? Then, I shall test your limits, in turn.', 'I knew there was a possibility that you would side against me once again, but your doing so never ceases to amaze, Cousin.', 'If this is your idea of humor, Zagreus, then I shall make it clear to you again that I am unamused.', 'I think we understand by now that when you test my patience, I shall test your ability to survive.', "Oh, let's continue on, already, Zagreus. There isn't any point in feuding, and there's much to do before your quest is done.", 'Now then! I hope we can move past this little incident, and keep our focus on the task at hand.', "I'm satisfied we understand each other better, now, don't we.
