What do you say we carry on, and get you from this place?", 'All is forgiven, Zagreus, and I take no offense. Exacting vengeance is just something we Olympians all do from time to time.', "I'd say I've bickered with you quite enough for now, Cousin. Let us continue down a more productive path.", "We've better things to do, I think, than fight amongst ourselves over a matter such as this.", 'I would very much prefer to think we both know better than to let old grudges stew forever, Zagreus.', "You see I have my father's temper, Zagreus. I am able to keep it in check, though I expect you to do your part.", 'Conflict between the members of our family is inevitable, Zagreus. All we can do is learn and grow from it.', 'I see no benefit to staying angry, Cousin. I promised Nyx that I would help rather than hinder you.', 'Your father also made some questionable choices, Zagreus. But all of us are family, after all.', "Well it simply isn't in my nature to allow such offerings to go unanswered, noble Cousin. In turn, I wish for you to have this, with my compliments.", 'This is an unexpected gesture, Cousin! I do appreciate it, though please do not feel obliged. I offer you my friendship, not a loan to be repaid.', 'You are most gracious, Cousin, to extend this offering. You honor me, yet I would ask you think of your well-being for the time, not mine.', "My, how very generous of you, to offer me this gift! I'm very grateful, though I ask that you not go out of your way on my account. Let's please stay focused, here?", "I know there isn't much that you can do to show your gratitude at present, Zagreus. But I would ask that you save it for when your task is complete. You've more important matters to attend to now!", "I know there isn't much that you can do to show your gratitude at present, Zagreus. But I would ask that you save it for a better time. You've more important matters to attend to, now!", "Perhaps there really is no time quite like the present when it comes to showing thanks to one another, my dear Cousin. You've opened my eyes to the possibility, though I remain steadfast in my resolve to fight for you.", "Zagreus? When Nyx revealed herself to me and I first learned of you, I saw it as an opportunity to bridge the great divide between Olympus and your father's realm. But, having had all these glimpses into who you are, it is an even greater honor to have forged this partnership with you.", 'The fury of Olympus!', 'Behold our power!', 'I shall protect you, Cousin!', 'As you wish.', "You're under my protection!", 'You are untouchable for now, Cousin!', 'Just let them try and stop you!', 'Become unstoppable!', 'I strongly disapprove.', 'Have you gone mad, Cousin?', 'I ought not help you thus!', 'You ask me now to aid you, is that so?!', 'Are you quite serious about this, Zagreus?!', 'Perhaps next time you shall cooperate with me again.', 'Wound the pride of an Olympian, and pay the price.', 'Know that this could have been avoided, Zagreus.', 'I greet you, Cousin.', "I've come to offer my support.", 'Wisdom guide you, Cousin.', 'My blessing be with you.', 'I commend you for your efforts.', "Surely my cleverness comes from your brother and yourself, Lord Uncle Poseidon. And I would only add, my feeling is we've more than enough children in this family, thus no further need for more of them, for now.", "Please do not mind the Lady Demeter's good-natured sense of humor, Zagreus. She and my father often like to jest with one another, even in the most difficult times."]

Title: Hades
Dialogues: ['I am most grateful.', 'Why, I am honored!', 'This pleases me.', 'Thanks to you, young man.', 'I shall remember this, Nephew.', 'Bless you, Zagreus.', 'How very kind of you.', 'Wisely decided, there, young man!', "Now wasn't that a simple test, Nephew?", 'Oh I feel very proud!', "Not the hardest choice you've ever made!", 'Congratulations, you made the right choice!', "Ah, young man, you hurt somebody's feelings!", 'Why, look, Zagreus, here comes brave Athena, first to reach you among all my kin, in all her shrewdness. So proactive, you contacted Zagreus prior to even telling me, my dear!', "Nephew! By my divine authority, my oft-misunderstood son, Ares, now shall lend you a small token of his power. I'll make him helpful yet!", "Young man, I know you'd like to get to know the comely Aphrodite face to face, or I don't know, you can decide once you arrive at last! He can decide, isn't that right, my Lady Aphrodite, hm?", "Now, Zagreus, once you arrive, we'll have to find for you a suitable mate, won't we? Fine young man such as yourself! Normally, there's much to choose from around here, with some exceptions, of course... such as my cunning daughter, Artemis. Willfully uninclined to take a mate, at all!", "Now, now, young man, whatever you have heard about good Demeter, I'm here to clear the air. She's like a sister to me, yes, but only thus. Although her Titan parents and my own met the same fate.", "Have you encountered Exagryph and said to it the waking-phrase I gave to you, young man? Why, I'd tell Exagryph myself! Remember, it's I see your prideful fall down from the heavens to the flames.", "Now that is an entirely unusual design, even for Exagryph! So then the waking-phrase has worked. That aspect's bearer, Lucifer, was it? Struck his own lord father! Tried to, anyway. A not uncommon story it would seem.", "I gather Lady Demeter's already got her frigid hold on you, certainly not the warmest member of the clan, now, is she? But do be patient with her, she's been through a lot.", 'My good sister Demeter already tried to poison you against me, as I understand, young man? Oh, foster-sister she prefers I say, loath as she is to accept her role as part of our great family.', 'You must forgive the Lady Demeter her scornfulness, Nephew, for she is still recovering after the sudden disappearance of her daughter, though it was quite some time ago the girl, poof! Just vanished. I try to lighten up the mood around it every now and then, but no, a sore spot, still!', "Poor Demeter, young man. We still wonder what became of her fair daughter. Ran away with mortals, there, perhaps? Some of the tales, even more preposterous. Don't go believing everything you hear, and do be sensitive about the subject, hm? Demeter, she's been through quite enough.", "The Lady Demeter still prattles on about her missing girl, Zagreus. But I want you to understand something, all right? She's gone. We all have grieved. Perhaps Demeter shall finally accept what has occurred, and we can move forward, having grown stronger as a family.", "My, what is this you have for me, young man? Appears to be a message of some sort, bearing my thunder sigil! Though, there's one for everybody on Olympus? Have they as yet received their own? I must know what it says... it's from your father, who else could it be? I'd better check on this!", "I eagerly await learning some more about the contents of that fascinating message you had sent up here, Nephew! How mysterious, indeed. I'll be keeping an eye on all the others that come in!", "I have to tell you, Zagreus, that it was wonderful to meet with you, at last! We were so pleased to learn Persephone was safe! And Nyx, why, she's as stunning as they say. Shouldn't have lied to us about your parentage, but, I know things get complicated, here, and that what's done is done!", 'Poseidon sought you out already, hm? My boastful brother gets on with Lord Hades even worse than I, so let me put a little spark into his storms for you!', 'My brave daughter Athena beat me to you this time, has she? No matter, with her blessing and my own, you shall be nigh unstoppable!', 'Has lovely Aphrodite put you in a trance already, Zagreus? Or might I offer you the blessing of Olympus to intensify her catastrophic power with my own?', "So my elusive Artemis has shown you favor, has she? The little scamp, she seldom shows respect to anyone, not even me! But I'll enhance her blessing nonetheless.", 'Getting along with Ares, are you, Nephew? Heh. Would that you were my son instead of he, but no, I jest, I jest! Here, take my blessing, please!', 'It pleases me to know, young man, that you and Dionysus have been getting on so well. He could use a level-headed friend, and you could use my blessing!', "Hmm! You've traveled rather quickly to this point... which reminds me, I've not seen swift Hermes anywhere of late! The rascal's likely dallying about!", 'Nephew, I have somewhat of a favor I must ask. You tell your father, if you so happen to run into him again, that his brother Zeus forgives him, and would like to reconnect, and welcome him into the family again. You tell him for me, hm?', "So you are son to Hades by that Nyx, the night-goddess, is that correct, Nephew...? Well I suppose she's closest to a queen as your lord father's like to find down there. I tried to match him up with some more wholesome types, but no, and here we are.", 'After we learned about your plight and your existence from the goddess Nyx, all of us on Olympus rallied to assist you just as best we could. A family such as mine protects its own!', "My brothers Hades and Poseidon once fought bravely by my side, you know that, don't you, Nephew? We prevailed against the Titans and established law upon the earth. Your father then descended to the land of death, and we've not seen much of each other since.", "Your father must have told you that his governance over the Underworld is due more to the weaving of the Fates than by his choice. Admittedly, he got the short end of the stick. Whereas Poseidon and myself, why, we've been doing rather well indeed.", "My brother Hades always was a lonesome man, you know. I pitied him! But I could never quite extract him from his thorny shell. Now he stews resentfully down there. You needn't bear the brunt of his frustrations.", "Old Hades has continued to ignore my every effort to reach out to him, young man. Ah well, but he is obstinate, indeed. You are wise to seek your family's better half.", "By the way, Nephew, I hear-tell your mother Nyx is quite the catch! If you'll forgive my saying so, of course. Your father's never had much of a sensibility around companionship, though perhaps this concubine of his brought something out in him, at last!", "If and when you reach the surface, Zagreus, you call upon me then and there, all right? I'll personally see to it that you'll be escorted up to Olympus, and your quest shall be complete!", 'I know just how much you must want out of there, young man. And I want that as well! Heh. Good thing for you, as I get what I want around here. Ask anybody!', "You fight your father's legions with Varatha, the Eternal Spear? The irony must not escape him, for he long ago stood by my side against the Titans, with that thing in hand!", "It seems the bow called Coronacht is safe and sound there in your hands, young man. I've not seen that old thing in quite some time!", "That shield of yours, called Aegis, why, in fact, it's mine from long ago, young man! I've no more need of it, of course, though how you found it, you shall have to tell me once you're here!", "Well, if it isn't the one and only Rail of Adamant in your possession, there! To strike one's enemies from afar is really the only way, I think, and it's about as good a substitute for lightning bolts as you're likely to find!", "Now, isn't that Malphon the Twin Fists there in your possession, Zagreus? Last god I saw bedecked in those old gloves was Demeter herself, oh, way back when! She was a real fighter at the time, not just a naysayer!", "Ah, now that's the Aegis that I know and love! Or used to love, at least, the dear old thing! Now I quite love these shocking bolts of mine. Though I am proud you've given Aegis a good home, and bear it in my name!", "Hark, young man, for I've a vision I must share with you! A waking-phrase for Exagryph, to be precise. Please beseech the weapon thus: I see your prideful fall down from the heavens to the flames. An odd connection to a past or future bearer, apparently one who defied a god!", "Nephew, I wanted to mention, it was odd how by every account you'd come quite close to breaking free from there at last, of late... only to be abruptly cut off from our contact! I suppose having suffered some ill fate? Perhaps your realm's guardian, Cerberus, is even deadlier than reputed!", "Your dear mother Persephone is a shrewd woman, Zagreus. More than an equal to your mighty father! I'm pleased to know you've made amends with her, and taken new responsibilities within your House! Naturally, I'll continue to pitch in. And, I hope that we'll meet again, someday!", "I must say, Nephew! Although it pleases me that we, here, reconnected with your father's realm... just between us, it pleases me even more that you are able to keep sticking it to him! You keep that up, all right?", "Zagreus, you have a clever mother in Persephone! A very clever mother. And a lordly father! They make quite the team, that's evident! True rivals for Hera and me!", "The lord and ruler of Olympus and the world, why, he needs a healthy sense of humor, no, young man? Now there's an awful lot of spoil-sports out here, can't take even a little joke, well, I know all their mothers, fie on all of them, I say! Let's joke away!", "I suppose even down in the Underworld, you would have heard such tales of me, young man. They're all untrue, hahaha! Except the tales of my bravery. Those are completely accurate, though all too modest, in most cases, I must say.", 'Ah, must be my gleaming Thunder Signet that I transferred to you! Why, I could feel its call from all the way up here!', "Why you look positively dreadful, Zagreus. That place is doing you no favors, I can tell! Luckily, I'll do you favors aplenty!", 'You seem in dire need of some assistance, Nephew. So, of course, I dropped what I was doing and then sought you out as quickly as I could!', 'Zagreus, you must have left most of your lifeblood back the other way, hahahaha! Oh, I jest, I jest! But you look terrible.', 'No, no one likes to die, young man! But since you seem about to any moment now, you keep your head held high, do you hear me?', "Well, let's face it, Zagreus, you are as good as dead right now. But you'll just slosh right back out of the River Styx, and give it a good try again, won't you?", "Remember, young man, dying is for mortals. So don't go making a habit of it, there! But if you have to do it, do it fighting, like a hero would!", "I wonder, Nephew, whether you're prepared as yet to harness the surpassing power I shall grant you now? Don't take this blessing lightly, and may you use it well.", "How about, young man, we cease with all the trifling down there and cause a real storm for once? Take now the fiercest of my powers, and you show your no-good father what you're made of!", "Greetings there, young man! Look, your father's always been rather difficult, and he's not so much as called in quite some time. You'll have a better home where you belong, here on Olympus! And to help you on your journey, have my blessing.", "We meet again, young man! Yours isn't my affair, I know, and yet I cannot help but take an interest in your plight. Your father cast his lot; he need not take his anger out on you.", "Hello, young man, and might I offer you a little taste of the heavens themselves? Though, don't go telling your old sulky father I've been spoiling you rotten!", "I and all of us upon Olympus are anticipating your success, dear Nephew! Now let me see if I can't help spur you along.", "Well, my nephew, you're admittedly in quite a bind down there, but what is life without its struggles, hm? You'll make it here, eventually, I'm certain.", "I like the fire in you, Zagreus, and I have every confidence you'll someday clamber from the shadows there into the light!", "Here on Olympus, Nephew, we take care of one another and support each other, quite unlike how it must be there in your father's grim domain. No wonder you intend to leave!", "I'd ask you offer my respects to your lord father, Zagreus, but I suspect you won't have such a chance anytime soon, considering how far you'll come with my support!", "Remember you've as many chances as it takes, young man, to fight your way out of the dark and join us in the splendor of Olympus!", "Your grim-faced father's such a spoilsport, Nephew, the way he keeps impeding your escape. Ah, well, just keep at it, hm?", 'My greetings, young Nephew, and more importantly, my blessing and my strength be with you as you journey towards your rightful home.', 'Faith and courage, Zagreus, for each and every one of us upon Olympus is behind you all the way throughout this whole affair.', 'What can I say, young man? You may not make your father very proud, but it is just the opposite with me! Now go, get out of there!', 'Now, Nephew, how about we put both of our backs into this one, and see to it that you go farther through those depths than you have ever managed yet!', "Know that many mortals ask me for my blessings constantly, and I mean all the time, young Nephew, but for you! You needn't ask at all!", "Far be it from me to raise my hand against your father, dear Nephew! Although I do suppose old Hades has it coming, doesn't he.", "I've every confidence in you, young man! Now you remember that, and take my blessing here, and fight your way on out of there for me!", "Nephew, I want you to go and show that surly Hades everything you're made of! And, I've arranged for you a little bit of help along the way!", "How is old Hades doing, anyway, Nephew? I suspect he's every bit as prickly as ever, whereas you are nothing of the sort!", 'I eagerly anticipate getting to meet you face-to-face someday, dear Nephew, just as soon as you can up and out of there!', "Good Nephew, I return once more to lend to you my power! I'd like to see your discontented father try and stop you now!", 'It is my solemn wish, dear Zagreus, that eventually we settle up our differences with your lord father. But for now, we fight!', 'Hail, my most honorable, beloved nephew, and I bring to you the blessing of Olympus, so that you might finally get out of there, already!', "I just know you'll reach the surface here eventually, Zagreus! And I look forward to our meeting when you do!", "We'll keep you safe here from your father, Zagreus! But while you're still inside that Underworld, there's only so much we can do.", "You've a good head on your shoulders, Zagreus, so stay positive, stay healthy, and let nothing stand between you and your goal!", 'I wish you well in your continued quest, and offer my sincerest blessings, and of course my power, there, Nephew!', "You've seen the sheer destructive power of the heavens! Just imagine what it's like above the surface of the earth!", "Someday when we'll be resting easy on these heights, why, we'll look back at this and laugh, I'm sure of it!", "Ahh, but if it isn't my most favored nephew! Striving always toward the surface of my world. Your father cannot possibly believe he can contain you, can he?", 'You have my blessing now as ever there, young man.', 'I trust you shall be getting out of there in due course, Nephew.', 'I shall be watching over you, young man, though it is dark down there!', 'May the might of Olympus guide you through the shadows, Nephew.', "Don't let your father get to you, young man, and climb on out from there.", "Zagreus, we won't be giving up on you, so you keep at it, hm?", 'I shall make the heavens themselves now aid your ascent, Nephew.', "You'll watch yourself down there, won't you, young man?", "All of us, we're here for you, young man!", 'Please do be careful not to make your situation any worse, Nephew!', "I'm here for you, young man, so you take heart, and more than that, take this!", 'All of us believe in you, though certainly no one so much as I!', "Here's something I can do to help, young man!", 'You just take all the time you need in terms of fighting your way out of there, young man!', "Now, don't lose heart, young man, and we'll keep at it with you here, as well!", 'As my kin, you are a born fighter, Zagreus! So put your back into it, and you climb right up!', 'It shall be glorious, indeed, the day you finally burst from that oppressive den into the light!', 'I know you have it in you to surpass your father, Zagreus. Assuming you are anything like me!', 'How fares your lovely mother? Things still good with her and Hades, hm?', 'You tell your good lord father that his brother Zeus shall be always watching over you!', "I trust your good lord father's treating you all right?", "I know you're busy, Zagreus, though someday you shall have to visit us!", "I'm never quite so busy that I can't make time for family, young man!", "We're all in this together, aren't we, Nephew?", 'I see the boatman of the Underworld has found the means to reach you with my blessing, Nephew. Such strange alliances we forge these days!', 'Why here I am, young man, in such strange circumstances I might add! Luckily the boatman Charon is much easier to get ahold of than your father!', "Ah, so then the boatman Charon came through for us after all, did he? Whatever means we have to reach you, we'll employ!", 'Your Charon there must drive quite a hard bargain, Zagreus, if he would keep you from your victory just for a bit of coin!', 'I thought that ferryman would be content to transfer souls across the River Styx, not rob you on your journey to the surface, there, Nephew!', "My blessing isn't good enough for you, is that the way of it, young man? How impetuous of you. Oh, I never!", "It isn't wise to go against me, Nephew, both in matters large and small. I am not known for being charitable to the insolent.", "Perhaps you have defied me here in jest, young man. Though in such cases pertinent to my authority, you'll find I lack a sense of humor.", 'Audacity runs in our family, Zagreus, but my advice to you is that you keep it carefully suppressed in your relationship with me.', 'What have I done, good Nephew, to deserve such scorn? Your lapse in judgment here is not so easy to forgive, yet easily punished.', "Your father likewise turned his back on me before, Nephew, and we both know what has become of him. I'd caution you against this.", 'Apparently, the consequences of displeasing me have slipped your mind, young man. A harsh reminder is in order, then.', 'I did not restore order to this world, and claim the heavens for myself, only to be insulted by my own nephew!', "Why, Nephew, is this all some sort of jest to you? It isn't one that I appreciate!", 'Nephew, when presented with a choice to side against me or not to be such a fool, do be sure to choose the latter next time, hm?', "Don't say I didn't warn you, young man! I only wish that I could say you didn't insult me!", "This is outrageous, Zagreus! Even your father would agree that actions such as that can't go unpunished.", "Young man, I don't know why you would do this to me, though I trust you're going to think twice, next time!", 'You overstep your bounds with me, Nephew! But I shall make you fall right back in line.', 'Ah, very well, good show, young man! And I think I shall let you off the hook, and take you back under my wing, for now.', "Commendable of you to live through that, and I suspect you shall think twice next time before so brazenly defying me, won't you?", 'Now, now, no need to hold such grudges any longer I suppose, but you just mind yourself around your Uncle Zeus.', "Do not spurn me again like that, do you hear me, young man? I think you do, so let's put this to bed and move along.", "Oh Nephew, but I simply can't stay wrathful toward you, much as I might try! Though, better not to tempt me, just in case.", "All right, all right, let's call the score between us settled up for now. Just don't go spurning me again, you understand?", 'All right, this is becoming unproductive, Zagreus. As you were!', "Oh, I don't have the heart to keep exacting vengeance on you, Nephew.", "I say, such petty squabbles. Aren't we better than this, Zagreus?", "Well, young man, I'd say it's best we put this little slight behind us, wouldn't you?", 'Pah! All is forgiven and forgotten, Zagreus. What were we even going on about back there?', "Hahaha, that is quite enough, that's quite enough, I say! You're still alive, aren't you?", "Goodness, Nephew, that's an offering, indeed! I'm thankful for your piety to me, and as a show of generosity to you, in turn, I present this!", 'You honor me, young man, as well you should, for I am ruler of Olympus, am I not? Such courtesies are shown me constantly, yet I appreciate them all.', "Why, that is rather generous of you, and I'm grateful for it, Nephew! How good of you to make attempts at reciprocity!", 'So fine a gift again, my dear Nephew? Would that my sons and daughters on Olympus here would show me such respect from time to time!', "I'm very pleased to see a show of such respect and admiration for your uncle, Zagreus. You'll go quite far here on Olympus with an attitude like that! Not everyone's as mannered, nor as wise.", "Ah, most splendid of an offering, young man. And while we've yet to even meet in person, I already feel as though the two of us are close, why, closer than you must be even with your father! Oh, hahaha! Perhaps we ought go telling everybody I'm your real father, am I right?", "Ah, most splendid of an offering, young man. I already feel as though the two of us are close, why, closer than you must be even with your father! Oh, hahaha! Perhaps we ought go telling everybody I'm your real father, am I right?", "Now, now, Nephew, you are most generous, indeed, in showing all this deference to me. But we must keep some distance, shouldn't we? Lest all the others here, why, they would be most jealous if they caught me playing favorites! Even though you are my favorite! Presently, at least.", 'Olympus smite you!', 'It shall be so.', 'That can be arranged!', 'Easily achieved.', 'Now is the time to strike!', 'Hoh, you watch this, young man!', "I'll strike them down right now!", 'I can take care of that!', "Don't be a fool, young man.", 'How dare you, young man.', 'Best not to make me angry, my nephew.', 'The sheer audacity!', 'I ought to strike you down!', 'Have you gone daft, Nephew?!', 'Now you ask my favor, Zagreus?', 'A swift death is a mercy of a retribution.', 'I did not become ruler of Olympus by forgiving trespasses, young man.', "You can't run from heaven.", 'Struck down.', 'How do you do, young man.', 'My blessings, Nephew!', "How fares my brother's son of late?", "Well I don't see why not.", "I've something for you here.", 'Erm, thank you for the introduction, Daughter! Now, you run along, go frolic with your nymphs, or something! Leave me to assist my nephew, here. Bestow on him your faint blessing, if you must.', "Come now, Zagreus, the only thing Lady Aphrodite has under control is her long list of salivating suitors, am I right? Aphrodite, how about you bestow your blessing and be off, and I'll take it from here.", 'That Dionysus, always much too kind with introductions, though at least he shows me suitable respect. Perhaps someday he can instruct you in the customs of Olympus here.', 'I thank you for the generous introduction, fair Athena, and I always rest assured when you are close at hand. I trust with our combined might, our good Zagreus is virtually certain to succeed!', "Now, Brother... you know better than to say such things about me, I should think. I know that tact does not come easily to you, though I'd be careful what you say to our good nephew, there.", "Oh, hah-hah-hah, Lady Demeter! Your wit is just as dry as the earth lying quite fallow in your care! Perhaps you should go tend to that again, though let's we go ahead and help our young man first!"]

Title: Hades
Dialogues: ['Hey cheers man!', 'What, for me, Zag, wow...!', 'Hey now that is something, yeah!', "I can't say no to that!", 'I owe you one man!', "Cheers, I'll take it man!", 'Oh yeah I dig it man!', "Hahaha, don't you know it, man!", 'Oh we are going to have a feast tonight!', "Ooh you're in a real heap of trouble, Zag!", "Yeaaah, man, you know what it's all about!", 'Hah, cheers to you, then, man!', 'That definitely was a good decision, man!', "Yeah, yeah, Ares, I will hand it to you, man. There's nothing like a feast after a war, all right! Provided you're on the surviving side, that is! Otherwise I guess they'll be feasting with you down there, Zag!", "Eh, tells me I'm being awful loud, and to back off, all sorts of nasty stuff like that, what can you do, though, right?", "Ah, haha, no need to flatter me like that, there, Lady Aphrodite! Beauty's almost entirely within the mind, I'm sure! And in the muscles and the jawline and the winning smile and, well, who am I to tell you, yeah?", "Hey Zag, my Dad, he's here and wants to have a word, be cool man, go along with what he says, OK?", "Uh, Zag, erm... your uncle's passing through. Not Dad, erm, the other one I mean, and he just wanted to check in, see how you're doing, so...", "Oh, anyway we're here, man, waiting up for you! We know you're going to make it, I would say eventually?", "Hey, Zag, when you arrive, it's going to be a real scene, I'll tell you now! Even Athena here will cut loose for a bit, let down her hair, you know, put on something more comfy, yeah, it's going to be great!", 'You know, Zag, maybe once you get here, you could get old Ares to just lighten up a little, you know, man? Always dragging down the mood, with talk of blood, and nastiness, all sorts of stuff like that!', "Look, Zag, you should know by now that when it comes to feasting, it's Yours Truly here who puts on the best performance. But I do have Lady Aphrodite's help!", "Zag, man, I was just attempting here to get our good friend Artemis to finally make an appearance at one of my feasts, it's just... wouldn't you know, she's all preoccupied, something about a hunt?", "Hey Zag, got a favor here I mean to ask, could you maybe persuade the Lady Demeter to ease up on the whole 'not let anything grow' thing she's been going on about?", "Whoa, hold just for a moment, Zag, now, I can recognize an invite when I see one, man! And this is definitely almost certainly some sort of invite, one for me, and... one for everybody else, it looks like, here? Hoh, I'm excited, that is something really special, I can tell!", "Look, Zag, I don't entirely recall what happened at that feast you threw for all of us down there, but let me tell you, I am under the impression it went smashingly! It was amazing, man! Let's have another one sometime, all right?", "So Zag, you met my dad by now, your uncle Zeus? He's cool and loves a feasting, just... be sure to keep him in your thoughts. OK?", "Hoh-ho, no way Zag, looking like you got yourself a gift from old Poseidon there? He's quite the catch, but here, hope you saved some room for more!", "Hey man, I heard Athena had a word with you already yeah? She's cool, though, once you get to know her. Here! I got something that ought to suit her style.", 'Whoa, hey, you must have had a run-in with the lovely Aphrodite, am I right, or am I right, there Zag? But I have just the thing to go with her!', "Hey, Zag, got to tell you, I cannot believe that little Artemis is hanging out with you! She doesn't hang with anybody, man! But I digress, take this!", "You hanging out with Ares, are you, Zag? He's quite the chap, I'll give him that, I'll give him that, and now, I'll give you this!", "Felt a shiver in the air just now, and that can only mean that chilly Demeter decided to give you a little help, there, huh? Or maybe it's just cold, I mean, this is a mountaintop!", "Hey, Zag, uh... I may just be losing it or something here, but isn't that your dad's own blessing that you've got? That's something, man, I didn't know that he was helping you!", "Now how's my favorite Underworld god surviving, Zag, you holding up or what? Right better momentarily, I bet!", 'Man oh man, Zag, someday you will be the guest of honor at the biggest feast that you have ever seen! Though I know you have got your hands full for the time, so, first things first!', "Sometimes I have to wonder, man, what's going through your head, I mean, I know you hear me and the others but it's so damn dark down there I can't hear you at all!", "Let me tell you something, Zag, I know your dad he's got to be a real handful, I relate to that, you understand me, mate? So you get out of there, and you'll be more than welcome here, with us!", "I've got a feeling this time, man, like things are really going to take a turn for you, and I mean for the better, almost certainly, I think!", 'The key to any halfway decent feast is lots and lots of preparation, man. Or maybe just having to improvise, you know?', "I got to hand it to you, Zag, you don't back down, you don't ever back down, what is this, like the twentieth time that you've attempted to escape?", "You're getting somewhere, getting somewhere, man, I understand you made it up to Asphodel before, now that is progress, keep it up, you keep on going, yeah?", "Heard you wrestled with some Satyrs near the surface, Zag! Nice work making it that far, and I just want to let you know that they are definitely not my crew, man! Satyrs I know aren't like that at all!", "Ah, Zag, what happened last time, man? It seemed like you were rather close, but then, we couldn't see you anymore from here, and now you're back? Well, give another go!", "Want you to know something, here, man. It's been a bit of a long haul, but you are getting closer to the surface, and you'll get there someday, and we're with you, however long it takes, OK?", "Hey, back when we had that feast, there, man, I, I hope I didn't, you know, make for any inconveniences or anything down there, did I...?", "Zag, I cannot believe your mom's Persephone, that's something else, I got to tell you, man! I never took her for the sort to be all into Underworld stuff!", "Say, isn't that the Overflowing Cup I handed down to you, I'm glad you like it, man! I guess it's overflowing still, because I figure otherwise I couldn't tell at all!", 'You, man, must be mates with just about everybody down there, by now, yeah? Doling out Nectars left and right, just livening the place right up!', "Say, let me just point out you've got a lot of Nectar on you, man! Oh, I can tell, I like the stuff a lot, myself, but even I don't pack that much, and I mean, wow!", "Say, man, if I'm not mistaken, I think you got yourself a bottle of Ambrosia, there? I'd no idea you could get that stuff downstairs! Do me a solid, though, hang on to any more you find, or better yet, give it away! I'd hate to think even a drop has gone to waste!", "Well, would you just look at yourself, Zag! You are like a walking stockpile of Ambrosia, aren't you? Taking the best care of it, at that. I knew I could count on you, but... <Sniff> I didn't know I could be just so proud of you, you know, man?", "Zag, turns out I am quite the judge of character, and you, man, have an awful lot of it, I mean, you've given out how much Ambrosia now? To all your mates, and more?!", 'You got to let me in on something, Zag, how did you gather up so much Ambrosia, there? I mean, sometimes I think the stuff is plentiful up here, but you are positively swimming in it, man!', "You are the talk of the mountain, you know that, man? Good on you, getting on just about everybody's good side up here, I mean, that is a feat, all right!", "Hey Zag, ever see a fellow by the name of Orpheus down there, you ever heard of him? I bet you have, and I have had a funny thought, a little jest that maybe we could try, if you'd be up to have a little harmless fun?", "...That chap comes up with the most smashing songs, so I was thinking, maybe we could spin him a tall tale, something like how maybe you and I, like, we're connected or something? He'll buy it, tell him, tell him for me, yeah?!", "Hahaha, Zag! I heard you got to Orpheus, he's got this whole entire ballad now, about how you are really me, or maybe it's the other way around, I've no idea, hahahaha! Here!", "Zag, I heard that Orpheus, he found his missing bride, why, isn't that the sweetest thing, isn't it, man? I'll drink to that, and I think so should you!", "Erm, hey, man, you been having some bad run-ins with that Fury, Megaera, is that her name? Now isn't she a real firebrand! Maybe this'll help you out next time you meet!", "Whoa, Zag, heard you're hanging with the Fury Megaera of late, well cheers to that, man, bet she's something else, but you just watch for that whip of hers, OK?", "Hey man, I'm hearing up here that you got in good with Megaera, the Fury, is that right, I mean, I hope it is, because, hahaha, yeow, know what I mean? They say she's something else!", "Hey, you're in good with Thanatos, isn't that right? A real broody sort, sometimes I think maybe I ought to just invite him to a feast, but then, what if he cools the whole thing down, makes everybody kind of ehhhhh, you know?", "Heard that you took care of Theseus down in Elysium of late, there, Zag! Nice work, never liked that one, between us. There's this nice lass helped him out one time, and he just dumped her rotten, I don't like that, man!", "Whoaa Zag, man, you look positively knackered, you be sure and take it easy if you can out there, all right? Here, maybe this'll help!", "Oof, Zag, look, I know you're not in a good spot right now, you must be really out of sorts! Though maybe this might numb the pain a bit!", "Eugh, you're a proper mess right now, got to be candid with you, man, you're bleeding everywhere, get it together, yeah?", "Now what's the matter, down there, Zag, it's like you've been up feasting day and night, you're barely standing, everything OK?", "Ooh, you're in no shape to be going off, what happened to you, there? Well, here, you know what? Let me see if we can get you back into it, man!", 'Oh-hoh, Zag, have I got something special here for you, I mean this here is top-notch stuff, even among the top-notch stuff I have to give, just look at this!', "Look, man, I am feeling generous right now, know what I mean? And so, here's something extra potent for you, ought to keep you going for a while longer than you're used to, there!", "Heeey, there, Zag, man, how's it going? Look, you have got to get here with the rest of us already, we've been saving you a spot! Let me see what I can do, make life a little sweeter for you in the meantime!", "Looks like this feast is getting started still, am I not right about that, Zag? Come on, let's show everybody a good time.", "Just getting warmed up down there, yeah, Zag? Here, I've a fine selection of my blessings, just for you!", 'Whooaa, Zag, I bet you could use a little pick-me-up right about now, and I am here to offer you whichever one you please!', "Hey Zag, how is life, you hanging in there, yeah? I reckoned maybe we could raise a glass here, to your health, but then I thought, 'No, wait! I can do a little more than that!' So, here we go!", 'Hey, how you living life down there right now, all right I take it, yeah? No, wait, though, I have just the thing!', "Why, hello, Zag! Fancy running into you, though there's no need to work yourself so hard, you hear me, yeah? I reckon this should take the edge right off!", 'How goes it this time, man, everything fine? Though hold that thought, I wager we can make things finer yet!', "That Underworld of yours, place is a real pit, isn't it Zag, a shame you're stuck down there. But we are going to get you out of there, together, you and I!", "Soon as you get up to Olympus, man... it's going to be a feast like you have never seen, you mark my words! Now take this, and good luck!", 'You give those musty shades and corpses a fair fighting chance down there, you hear me, Zag? Though just in case you need a hand...', "You got this, man! I so believe in you, it's almost like the Greeks believe in me! And they believe in me an awful lot, you know!", "Time for another go at getting out of there, eh, Zag? Well not to worry, we'll make something happen, let's hop to it then!", "Now listen up here, Zag, 'cause this time I have got something for you that's going to put some extra fire in your step, you ready, man?", "You wait for just a moment, Zag, 'cause I got just the thing for this occasion, you are going to love it, get a load of this!", "Now, Zagreus, I'm certain everything is going fine for you right now, but just in case, but just in case! I got a little something, just for you!", "It's me, Zag, hey, I know you haven't got a lot of time to listen to me prattle on like this, and so, I'm cutting to the chase here, look!", "Hey again as ever Zag, now you keep at it like you have been and I bet we'll all be hanging out up here in no time flat! I'm with you all the way!", "Oh, hey, let's see, man, I am thinking that this time around this smattering of my concoctions ought to do you right!", "Here's to an interesting time, how about that, yeah?", "I'd like to make a toast, to you of course my friend! Good luck out there!", 'All right, man, I have got your back, and you have got this, go!', 'Hey, hey, have I got just the thing for this particular occasion, man!', 'Hey, Zag, what is going on, you going to get out of here this time? Why, yes, I think you are!', "OK Zag. You and me. We're getting through this, now or never, ready, yeah?", "Oh hey, Zag, here's a toast to your success, so... clink! Cheers and all that!", "Here's something for you man, grab it and go!", 'I got you, Zag, got just the thing, right here!', 'Ah there you are, man, I got what you need!', "I know you're busy, man, so here you go, get on with it, all right?", "It's good to kind of see you down there man, now here, take this!", "Sure is dark there, Zag, I hope you're hanging in there, yeah?", "You getting anywhere, yet, man? 'Cause if you're not, it's cool, we've all got time!", 'Got something that is going to knock you off your feet, here, man!', "You ready for this, Zag, now here's a good one, courtesy of me!", "It's going to be a real feast here once you make it, man!", "Only the best for you, man, now check this out, you'll see!", 'This here, Zag, is among the best I have to offer, it is good!', "I'm feeling really good right now, and thought I'd pass that right along!", "Here's something extra special for you, man, now cheers!", 'Past time we got things going for you there, what do you say, you ready for this, man?', 'I got to make it to a feast in just a little bit, here, man, but quickly, take this, yeah?', "I know it's been tough times of late, but look, you just keep going, and you'll make it, man!", "This time for sure, I mean, I know you're going to make it to the top, together with me, man!", "Hey I propose a toast to you, there, man, and may you always kill whatever's in your path, and on and on!", 'A toast, man, to your health! Or to the lack of it, for anybody who gets on your bad side, yeah?', 'Have I got just the thing for you, here, man, you ready? Here we go!', 'What do you say we go all out this time, how about it, Zag, you with me, man, or what?', "Been saving something for the right occasion, though I figure it's as good a time as any, yeah?", 'Hey, cheers to you, and everything you do, there, Zag! Only the best from me to you, man!', "Heeey, what's, uh, with that Charon, man, he's sort of, I-don't-know, though I am glad he's been of service!", "Ah-hah, you found me holing up in Charon's nasty stash there did you man, well good, good, here!", 'Looks like you are stocked for one hell of a night down there, man! I knew Charon would hook you up with what you need!', 'Hey, cheers for picking up the tab, there, Zag, now, I cannot exactly pay you back, though I could give you this!', 'I bet that Charon has to be the life of every feast you have down there, with such a personality, am I not right about that, man?', "Oh, come on, Zag, and here I thought that we were cool. You hurt my pride, there, man. I guess I'm going to have to hurt yours....", 'Ohhh man, that was definitely not a thing to do, I mean, are we best mates, or not...? You think on that, while I do this.', "Look Zag, I'm not going to lie, you hurt my feelings here, I thought we had a thing! A close familial bond! I'm really mad now that I think on it!", "What, you wouldn't hang with me given the choice? I thought I had you sorted, man, but maybe you just don't appreciate the finer things!", "Ah, come on, Zag, now that was not the choice I would have made, you messing with me, man? All right! I'll mess with you.", 'Ohh, we all make mistakes from time to time, man, and you ought to know! You made one there just now!', 'Why do it to me like that, Zag, man, I thought we were close as grapes upon the vine, but I was wrong?', 'Did I do something to deserve this, man, because I thought that we were getting on just fine, better than fine, but this?', "It's not that I'm upset or anything, here, Zag, you know I'm not, but truthfully I am a bit annoyed, a little bit, and so, I got to send the message, man.", "Really, man? After everything we've been through together, this is the gratitude I get?", 'Well, way to spoil the feast, there, Zag, I mean come on, I thought I was your mate? Was I mistaken, man?', "Zag, I can take a jest, ask anybody, but when it comes to competition here, it's not a laughing matter! Do you understand me, man?", "All right, all right, all right, we're cool, we're cool, no need to get all hot and bothered any longer, here!", "OK, let's say we're settled up now, Zag, and go on being best mates just like before, yeah?", "You know, Zag, you are not so bad, just had a little lapse in judgment, happens to me all the time, now let's get on with it!", 'Hey, now, that was quite a sight, I got to hand it to you, man, and you deserve this, here!', "Know what, man, I'm not even angry after that. What was I even going off about, do you recall...?", "OK, all right, it's fine already, Zag, you win this time and I am good as grapes.", "Appreciate your understanding, there, man, so let's just avoid this type of little shake-up next time, yeah?", 'Hahahahahah, OK, thanks for a good laugh, there, Zag, what was it I was going on about, before...?', "Oh I just can't stay mad about you, Zag, and to be honest, why, I wasn't that mad to begin with, I just thought I'd shake your branches up a bit!", "You're all right, man, you're all right, don't even worry about the rough patch we just crossed back there, we're stronger than all that!", "I figured this time I'd stay mad at you for sure, man, but you know what, I just couldn't! No matter how hard I tried.", "It's like I always say, Zag, you have got to permit yourself a bad time every now and again to really appreciate all the good times, yeah?", "Know what, man, just forget about what happened, yeah? 'Cause I already did, I mean, it happens, right?", 'Now that is something, a right princely gift, there, Zag, and just so happens I got something here I have been meaning to give you!', "Hoh-oh, what, is that for me, really, I mean, cheers man, that is awful generous of you, I'm much obliged!", "What, is that for me, why Zag, I mean you really shouldn't have, you know I can't get enough of this stuff, right?", 'Why Zag, how positively thoughtful, man, I mean I love it, positively love this stuff, and I am very moved that you would think of me for it!', "Ah, this is the greatest, Zag! This feast I'm headed to? I was getting a little concerned I wasn't going to have quite enough to go around for everyone. Well, you just saved my evening, man! Too bad you couldn't be there, yeah?", "Oh, you're really too much for me sometimes, you know that, man? Got to tell you, I don't think I ever felt so close to somebody so damn far away. But through the gift of drink? It's like we're with each other in spirit, all the time, you know?", "Zag, I cannot believe what you are offering to me! Ambrosia, man, for me? And talk about a bottle that has seen some wild days and nights, I mean if it got all the way to you down there, only to come back up! Know what? I'm saving it, till we can share it, here!", 'You want to tangle with us?!', "Here, this one's on me!!", 'Drink up, mates!!', 'Positively man!', 'Oh absolutely!', 'Have I got just the thing for you!', 'Time for a real feast!', 'Something for everyone!', 'You got it, man!', 'Come on already man.', 'You serious right now?', 'You kidding me with this?', "I can't believe this man.", "What can I say, man, it's a shame all right.", "I'm absolutely gutted man.", "Now that's a crying shame.", "Didn't have to be like this, man! We were having such a good time!", 'Hate to sour the occasion like this, Zag. What was I supposed to do?', 'Eugh, I feel bad all of a sudden, man, I mean, what happened, there?', 'Oh hey man, what is new?', 'Hey you hanging in there yeah?', 'You still in one piece, man?', "Hoh yeah I'm into it!", "Here this one's for you!", "Oh, come on, Athena girl, you really mean to tell me that discovering a long-lost relative isn't a cause for celebrating right away, I mean, you can't be telling me a thing like that? Because if Zag isn't a cause for feasting, I don't know what is!", "Erm, yeah, milady, I take issue here! I mean how are the grapes supposed to grow and wine supposed to flow when you are so uptight, now, just ease up a little there, let's see what we can do!"]

Title: Hades
Dialogues: ['I knew your heart was true!', "I knew you'd come around.", 'What choice was there, really?', 'Always trust your heart.', 'Your heart shall never carry you astray.', 'Wisely decided, dearest.', "I'm grateful, dearest.", 'How thoughtful.', 'Why thank you, love!', "You really shouldn't have!", "I won't forget this, not anytime soon!", 'I very much appreciate it.', "I'm positively moved!", 'Why, I never, Lord Zeus! That sounded rather like a crass remark, from you! How shocking that the golden standard for the rest of us should have such words for me!', "There are at least a few of us who share such interests here, isn't that so, Lord Ares? As for you, dearest, you take all the time you need!", "Oh, Lord Ares, truly there isn't the need to cloud our little godling's thoughts and judgment with such comments, is there, hm? Let's give him what he wants, and we can carry on in private, about that.", "Why, Artemis, you're absolutely tongue-tied! Due to our little godling in the Underworld, or a little due to me? Hm-hm, you shall figure it all out I'm sure!", "Oh, come now, Artemis! I'm sure you're very capable of hiding from a common beast, but I can see you plain. Why not be honest with yourself, next time?", 'Dearest, your lord uncle wishes to address you from our mountaintop, although I had assured him that the two of us, we had everything well under control!', 'The thing to know about this family, dearest, is that, each of us, we have our little quirks. Although, we always stick together and our love for one another perseveres!', "Oh, feel free to stay, Poseidon! I was just explaining what an idiot you are, though you're able to articulate this best! Anyway, dearest, what was I on about...?", 'You must forgive us, little godling, meaning our extended family here upon Olympus! Some of us are terribly stuck up, and must be making matters much more complicated than they have to be.', 'Oh, you must know full well that I would do much more than that directly to your countenance, Athena dear! Quite frankly, you could use a lot of work!', "Dearest, you must know, Goddess Athena and myself, we don't always share a common view, perhaps because she overthinks things constantly, while my heart leads me on!", "I think for many of us, dearest, it can come as a surprise to learn that love and war often go hand in hand. Opposite forces, yet this connects them, doesn't it. The fiercest passions of gods and mortals! Isn't that right, Lord Ares?", 'Oh dearest! I have brought you keen-eyed Artemis, who, in her focus on the hunt, has not developed social graces suitable enough to come to you herself!', "My powers, dearest, oft go hand-in-hand with those of Dionysus, with his power to persuade the mind to find such beauty where it isn't, really!", "The venerable goddess of the seasons, Demeter, chooses to look as stately as can be, can you believe it, dearest? Although, why one would mark so many fine lines upon their face, I wouldn't know.", 'Why, this is something, dearest! Such an enigmatic message you have sent. How positively captivating; I must know what it says. It bears the marks of others on Olympus, so... perhaps we ought to share some common knowledge on the subject, hm?', "Oh, dearest, you've no idea what a delightful time I had while visiting you recently! So many new sights and sounds and smells, why, it was wonderful! And you are burdened with a big responsibility, aren't you? Mind if I lend my graces to you still from time to time...?", "Lord Zeus has made acquaintances with you? Oh I sometimes forget that he's your uncle! His favor's well worth having, I assure you.", "That oaf Poseidon spoke to you already, didn't he? All bluster, muscles, and bravado, that one. I'm glad you're not the type.", "You've met Athena, dearest, so you know not all the ladies on Olympus are alike. And I, for one, am grateful to our forebears for that!", "I sense the mark of my Lord Ares on you, love. He's poorly understood among the gods, yet surely you can see fair qualities in him, and me?", "The sullen Artemis reached out to you, did she? Oh, that's adorable, dearest! Just don't make any sudden movements with her, hm?", 'You are so fortunate to have received the Boon of Dionysus prior to my own! He, the most noble and important of us all, the god of wine, himself!', 'Why, did sorrowful old Demeter get all the way to you before I did? She stubbornly refuses me when I offer to help! Unlike you, little godling!', "How I love to have these unexpected little run-ins with you, love! You are just so spontaneous, and I've a liking for that sort of thing!", "Keep following that heart of yours, dearest! It's good enough a guide, believe you me. Mine tells me you are going to succeed!", "You do know that I'm married, don't you, love...? I'd forgive you if you didn't, for my husband, he's always... busy with his work. I'm grateful that you're there for me to talk to.", "You're going to love it on Olympus, little godling. The air is beautiful and brisk, the gardens lush, the feasting plentiful...! Why, it must be the opposite of everything to which you are accustomed!", "What shall we do here once you finally arrive? Perhaps we could go out and meet some mortals! I know all too many maidens and/or noble gentlemen who'd absolutely love to get to know you.", "A little bird once told me that the shade of the great hero called Achilles now resides within your father's residence, dearest? I always wished to meet with him someday...", 'You met Achilles after all, godling. He was quite instrumental in a war of my design. Still, he resisted my attempts to sway his actions. You tell him, simply, I admire him.', "The great hero Achilles, he continues to ignore my polite outreach, doesn't he? Why, I've attempted to reach out at least several times! Your father's realm is really quite a lot. How terribly frustrating it must be!", "You've had a brush with Megaera, the Fury, haven't you? Oh I know a thing or two about that one. Though, lately we Olympians no longer mingle with those living in the Underworld. You're the only exception!", "A little birdy told me recently that you and Megaera the Fury, why, you've grown quite close! Now do be careful around her, and, try not to get attached, there, hm?", "Why, you have my Eternal Rose, don't you? I am so very touched that you'd think first of me among my mighty kin. It pleases me to know I'm in your thoughts!", "Oh what is going on down there, dearest? I thought for certain you would make it out, but seems that nasty place has kept you grounded, hasn't it. But don't despair, and you take heart, won't you?", 'Something has stirred within your heart, dearest! Oh, I can always tell! A certain kind of love, for family? Yes, that must be it, I think! What could have transpired with you, hm?', "To think your father and that sweet Persephone, they were together down there, all along! I was so certain that your father's heart was cold. That's just the thing with love, dearest! That, sometimes, it surprises even me!", 'My dearest little godling, how fares everything with you of late? I love to have these little interactions with you, simple as they are, for they have brightened many of my evenings here.', "Little godling, you must know the seven types of love by now, don't you? It's quite a complicated field, though several types intrigue me most of all. In fact, why, I have several types of love for you, right here!", "Dearest, why... I sense your heart is very full, indeed! You positively emanate with love. You must have grown quite close to many dear to you. Perhaps so you may do the same with me...? I'm so delighted to have seen your spirit shine.", "Oh, my, dearest! I have to say, your heart is positively bursting with such love for so many you have come to care about! Your dearest friends, your burning passions, family, everyone! Why, you're like a living testament to my entire body of work!", 'I cannot help but wonder, dearest, why Lord Hades would have kept your mere existence hidden from us all this time. Perhaps he knew that, once you met us, you would stop at nothing to come seek us out!', "I sense you finally acted on your pent-up passion for the Fury Megaera, yes, little godling? These types of things, they don't escape my notice, and they're always so enjoyable to see!", "How's fearsome Megaera the Fury treating you of late, hmm, dearest? I know her type so very well, indeed. She acts as though there's nothing that can get under her skin, isn't that right?", "Mmm, so my heart tells me that you've developed quite the bond with moody Thanatos, haven't you, there? I always figured that his brooding quality was just an act!", "Little godling, would that I knew every last detail of how you and Thanatos are getting on of late! The notorious incarnate of death, and the newly discovered son of Hades, fraternizing? It's positively scandalous I think!", "Erm, dearest? If my perfectly developed senses are correct, then you appear to be quite smitten with a little gorgon that you've met down there...? Why that must be adorable, if rather strange!", "Why, something's changed about the beating of your heart, dearest! Oh, it's the little gorgon, isn't it. You Underworld dwellers and your complicated feelings! I can never get enough. My blessings to the both of you, then, hm?", "Oh, look at you, you poor, poor thing, you're hurt! Though, let me see if I can make it better.", "Tsk, you're in no condition for an outing with me, dearest. Though, perhaps you might recover from your hardships with my aid?", "Dearest, why, your heart rate's fluctuating wildly! Has it really been that bad up to this point? I'll try to help however much I can.", "Oh, you're just in an awful situation, aren't you. Yet, I can tell your proud heart keeps on beating, for the moment anyway! Don't die just yet!", "Ah, little godling, you're about to die! Why, none of us want that, because if so, you won't get to enjoy my blessings here!", "I have been waiting for a special moment to confess my great appreciation for your deeds... this moment's special enough, isn't it?", "My loveliest of blessings is reserved only for those who've earned my deepest adoration. So, congratulations, love! And here you go!", 'Sometimes, our hearts become so full that they could burst! If only you could see how much I care. I would do anything to aid you in your plight! My heartfelt blessings be with you, dearest.', 'Little godling, you must know that the heart has infinite capacity for empathy. And I so feel for you there, that I have mustered for you some of the most beautiful of blessings I can offer!', "Why hello, hello, there, little godling. I have to say you're quite the specimen, and so, I've decided I shall aid you for the moment. You interested?", "Did you miss me, little godling, hm? I thought I'd steal away a bit and that together we might make up for lost time.", "Hello again, there, little godling, let's get to it, hm? I want what you want; there's no further need for words.", "Oh, boo, looks like you've rather got yourself into a bind, there, haven't you. Though, not to worry, dearest. I can pull some strings.", "There, there, dearest, you'll tell me all your troubles just as soon as you arrive, so let's just get you out of there for now.", "What is it, love, are you still having problems with the dead? I swear, you'd think they had enough of me in life!", "What did I miss since last time, anything of interest, hm? You'll have to fill me in once you break free, dearest.", 'Well, look at you, there, love! So well-prepared to take on any danger that may come! But, I must wonder, are you well-prepared for this?', "Ready yourself, dearest, because you and I? We're going to have ourselves a little outing I expect that neither one of us shall soon forget.", 'Would you by any chance have room, there, in your heart for a most-gentle blessing from a goddess such as me?', "Don't lose heart, now, little godling! I won't have you giving up before you get to see me in the flesh among the gardens of Olympus here...!", "Dearest, I've known many gods and godlings through the ages. And, I have to say, you're quite intriguing, even for our kind.", "Oh, dearest, I suspect we'll have ourselves a most exciting time together, you and I! Just do your best and it'll all be fine!", 'I am always here, or close enough, to help you through whatever troubles you may face, my little godling. So do not hesitate to call upon me, hm?', "I'd ask you show me a good time, there, love, although I almost can't imagine a good time where you reside! So dreary, constantly!", "I missed you terribly, my little godling! All that I ask is that you do not die on me again, why, I don't think that I can take it anymore!", 'How you must yearn to reach the surface, little godling! It likewise stirs in me a yearning to assist you, by all means at my disposal!', 'No need to worry any longer, dearest! I bring you strength and comfort, and I shall be watching every step of yours most carefully.', 'Ah, how I long to see you face-to-face! Until such time, however, this old means of keeping touch shall have to do. So you take care, now, hm?', "You know I would do anything to have you here among us, don't you, love? Oh, I just hope my blessings are enough...!", "Love tends to blossom in the strangest places at the strangest times, you know that, don't you, dearest? All one can do is entertain the chance.", "Don't work yourself too hard down there, you promise, little godling? We need you in good shape and spirits on Olympus here.", 'What do you say we skip the chat and get right to it, hm?', 'Oh, would you look at whom I found, all by his lonely self.', "Let's see what mischief we can make, between the two of us!", 'You want my blessings, dearest, here they are!', "I hope I didn't keep you waiting very long, did I?", 'Even immortal hearts can break, my little godling.', 'What do you say we go and make new friends together, hm?', 'You seem like you could use a helping hand, there, love.', 'The bond of love is strong enough to suffer any hardship, dearest.', 'Times of adversity make love grow even stronger, little godling.', 'I hate to see you struggling, dearest! Please do be careful, hm?', "Love conquers everything, you see that, don't you, dearest?", 'Think of all those you love, and may they spur your courage, little godling.', 'Your passion to achieve your goal is quite inspiring, I have to say!', "It's such a pity I can barely see you in that awful darkness, little godling.", "Love spurs the heart to greater acts of valor, doesn't it, dearest?", 'Take heart, now, little godling. And how about you take this from me, as well.', "I'd love to help you however best I'm able, my little godling.", 'I have the loveliest selection of my blessings for you this time, dearest!', "I think I'll give you something very special this time, little godling.", 'Is not the purest act of love to aid somebody in their time of need?', "I'm feeling wonderful of late, dearest, so here, enjoy the benefits!", "Looks like we meet again, dearest, here among the foul detritus of the boatman's wares! You truly take me to the best of places!", "At first I didn't know how to get through to that odd river-boatman, Charon. Turns out he lusts for coin, and now I understand him well!", "You spent your hard-earned wealth on my account, dearest? Why if that isn't just the sweetest thing!", "One cannot put a price on love, but on my blessings, from the boatman, for my dearest? I'd say we're settled up.", 'And here I was beginning to think that we had something special going, no...? Look here, little godling, let me save you lots of future suffering: I happen to be the jealous type.', "You'd best not take for granted my affection, godling. Yes, I've lots of it to go around; but I can just as easily rescind such privileges.", "They say a lot of things about me, dearest; and they'll tell you, in your dealings with me, ample caution is in order. Let me show you why.", "Don't ever take me for some thoughtless nymph to be manipulated, dearest. I expect reciprocal devotion from you. Do you understand?", "Oh, really? You shall find I don't take such rejections lying down. And you shall find it out the hard way.", "If it's your wish to test the limits of the fine relationship we've built, why then... I can confirm you're testing them, all right!", "Now, dearest... surely there's no way that could have been one of the wiser choices that you've lately made?", "Dearest, just in case it hasn't been made clear as crystal lately, let me tell you: When presented with the opportunity, don't ever reject me.", "You'd spurn my love this easily, dearest? You are about to find the consequences are much harder to dismiss without a second thought.", "I must admit I'm unaccustomed to rejection, love. But you must be accustomed to swift death! Here comes one for you now.", "Oh, but this is such a heartbreak, dearest! Why would you do that? You know that I won't take this lying down.", "You dare to play with my heart, little godling? I'll just take yours, and shatter it to pieces, then, I think!", "Sometimes I think that you're quite different than most all the others here, darling. And then, you go and do something like this.", "You think you can brush me aside like that? Well, I think I can crush you into tiny, little bits! Let's see who's right, shall we?", "Let's say we kissed and made up, dearest. Just, do not anger me again, or I might come down and kill you there myself!", "Alas that passion sometimes drives me into vengeance, dearest! Yet, who among us isn't without vices, hm?", "Oh, how I hate to fight with you like this! Let's forgive each other and forget, go back to how things used to be?", "I'm not angry with you any longer, dearest! Though, might I suggest you take some extra steps to keep it that way, hm?", "A loving heart is a forgiving heart, don't you agree? So I shall let this little matter slide, and you've my loving heart to thank for it, hm-hm!", "The truth is I'm a lover, not a fighter, dearest. So how about we call this matter put to bed, and get on with our lives?", "I'd say this little squabble can be put to bed, for now. I'm better for the moment, but I was very angry with you, love!", "I cannot bring myself to stay upset with you forever, little godling, so let's move along from that small misunderstanding there.", "There is no common sense with love, godling, so... why don't we pretend your indiscretion there did not occur.", 'It is through times of difficulty that the love we share is tested and reforged. But you just watch yourself when testing it like that.', "Love and jealousy go hand in hand, don't they, dearest? Although the former's much more pleasant, isn't it.", "Oh, all this fighting! It's just not like us at all, dearest! Let's say we kissed and then made up, all right?", 'Lasting relationships are built on reciprocity. So if you lavish me with gifts, why, what am I to do but give you something in return?', "Why, dearest, such a wonderfully thoughtful gift, for me? I love it, and I would be lying if I said you shouldn't have!", "My, but if this isn't such a treasure to behold, and I accept it as a sign of your affection! Of something even more, perhaps...?", 'Ah, dearest, but it stirs my heart to know you care so deeply for our wonderful relationship! To celebrate it with such princely gifts!', "My, but don't you come on rather strong, there, little godling! Though, I can take much more of your affections, you shall see!", "You know, dearest, I am more worshiped than perhaps anybody else upon Olympus! You'd think getting such praise would roll right off my back by now, but no! I love receiving it. Especially from you.", "My little godling. I'd say you've honored me more times than I could count, but that would be a lie, now, wouldn't it. I so admire your devotion and your perseverance! If ever you do reach us on Olympus, I should very much enjoy getting to know you even better, then.", "You're going to love this!", 'Who dares threaten my little godling?', 'Just leave it to me, dearest!', 'Would be my pleasure!', 'I like the sound of that.', 'When shall they ever learn?', "I'll pierce them through the heart!", "Let's complicate things, hm?", 'Oh it shall be my pleasure!', 'Pure passion, coming up!', 'Of all the nerve, dearest!!', 'You call upon me now?', "I'll break your heart next!", 'Best not to anger me.', 'You are impossible!', 'What has gotten into you?', 'You truly dare?', 'Such utter foolishness.', "You don't want to make me angrier.", 'You break my heart, I break your body, little godling.', 'You ought to worship me, rather than anger me.', "Don't you refuse my good graces like that again.", 'Lovely to see you, hm?', 'Well look at you, hm-hm.', 'Oh good, we meet again!', "You're such a sweetheart.", 'How lovely.', 'Wine does have a rather special way of making everybody look even more beautiful than ever, Dionysus dear! And from such beauty, why, long-lasting love is born! And also shorter-lasting love, much of the time.', "Oh, if only I had wisdom such as yours, Athena dear, so that I was more capable of picking up on subtle jabs and insults such as that! You're not fooling anybody with your feigned benevolence, you know.", "Oh, I don't know, my dearest Demeter! The frozen heart has tendency to thaw, and then begin to beat with renewed vigor after that. I trust your time shall come! It can never be too late, except for mortals, the poor things."]
